012853:   function shuffleArray(a){
012854:     for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){
012855:       const j = Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
012856:       [a[i],a[j]] = [a[j],a[i]];
012857:     }
012858:     return a;
012859:   }

013154: 				upgrades: [],
013155: 				features: [],

013163: 				}

013169: 					unlocks.features.push({ key, ...data });

013175: 				if (data.unlockedAtLevel === level && (!data.unlockedAtWorld || world >= data.unlockedAtWorld)) {
013176: 					unlocks.upgrades.push({

013178: 						...data, 
013179: 						upgradeData: UPGRADES[key] 
013180: 					});

013183:

013185: 		},
013186: 		isUpgradeUnlocked: function(upgradeId, currentLevel, world = 1) {
013187: 			const u = this.upgrades[upgradeId];
013188: 			if (!u) return false;
013189: 			if (u.unlockedAtWorld && world < u.unlockedAtWorld) return false;
013190: 			return u.unlockedAtLevel <= currentLevel;
013191: 		},
013192: 		isCategoryUnlocked: function(category, currentLevel) {
013193: 			return this.cardCategories[category] && this.cardCategories[category].unlockedAtLevel <= currentLevel;
013194: 		},
013195: 		isFeatureUnlocked: function(featureId, level, world = 1) {
013196: 			const feature = this.features && this.features[featureId];
013197: 			if (!feature) return false;
013198: 			if (feature.unlockedAtWorld && world < feature.unlockedAtWorld) return false;
013199: 			if (feature.unlockedAtLevel && level < feature.unlockedAtLevel) return false;
013200: 			return true;
013201: 		}
013202: 	};

013205: 	function hasUpgrade(upgradeId) {
013206: 		// Back-compat: old saves used 'compactCards'. It now maps to miniPack34.
013207: 		if (upgradeId === 'miniPack34') return !!(UPGRADES.miniPack34?.purchased || UPGRADES.compactCards?.purchased);
013208: 		if (upgradeId === 'compactCards') return !!(UPGRADES.compactCards?.purchased || UPGRADES.miniPack34?.purchased);
013209: 		return UPGRADES[upgradeId]?.purchased || false;
013210: 	}

013212: 	function isUpgradeAvailable(upgradeId, levelOverride = null, worldOverride = null) {
013213: 		const lvl = Number(levelOverride ?? (typeof currentLevel !== 'undefined' ? currentLevel : 1)) || 1;
013214: 		let world = worldOverride;
013215: 		if (!Number.isFinite(Number(world))) {
013216: 			try {
013217: 				if (typeof currentWorld !== 'undefined' && Number.isFinite(Number(currentWorld))) world = currentWorld;
013218: 			} catch (e) {}
013219: 		}
013220: 		if (!Number.isFinite(Number(world))) {
013221: 			try {
013222: 				world = Number((typeof getWorldAndSubLevel === 'function' ? getWorldAndSubLevel(lvl)?.world : 1) || 1);
013223: 			} catch (e) { world = 1; }
013224: 		}
013225: 		if (!UNLOCK_PROGRESSION || typeof UNLOCK_PROGRESSION.isUpgradeUnlocked !== 'function') return false;
013226: 		return !!UNLOCK_PROGRESSION.isUpgradeUnlocked(upgradeId, lvl, Number(world) || 1);
013227: 	}

013229: 	function isWorld2Upgrade(upgradeId) {
013230: 		const meta = UNLOCK_PROGRESSION?.upgrades?.[upgradeId];
013231: 		if (!meta) return false;
013232: 		if (meta.unlockedAtWorld) return Number(meta.unlockedAtWorld) >= 2;
013233: 		const lvl = Number(meta.unlockedAtLevel) || 1;
013234: 		const info = (typeof getWorldAndSubLevel === 'function') ? getWorldAndSubLevel(lvl) : { world: 1 };
013235: 		return Number(info?.world || 1) >= 2;
013236: 	}

013238: 	function getEffectiveUpgradeCost(upgradeId) {
013239: 		const base = Number(UPGRADES?.[upgradeId]?.cost) || 0;
013240: 		if (Number(currentWorld || 1) >= 2 && isWorld2Upgrade(upgradeId)) return base * 2;
013241: 		return base;
013242: 	}

013342: 	function placePortalsForLevel() {
013343: 		// Verwijder oude portals
013344: 		clearPortals();
013345: 
013346: 		const candidateZoneIds = ['yellow-grid', 'purple-grid', 'blue-grid', 'green-grid'];
013347: 		const availableZones = candidateZoneIds
013348: 			.map(id => ({ id, el: document.getElementById(id) }))
013349: 			.filter(z => z.el);
013350: 		if (!availableZones.length) return;
013351: 
013352: 		const zonesWithCells = availableZones
013353: 			.map(({ id, el }) => ({
013354: 				id,
013355: 				el,
013356: 				cells: Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('.cell:not(.void-cell):not(.active)'))
013357: 			}))
013358: 			.filter(z => z.cells.length > 0);
013359: 
013360: 		if (!zonesWithCells.length) return;
013361: 
013362: 		const chosen = [];
013363: 
013364: 		// Eerst 1 per zone (als het kan) om spreiding te krijgen
013365: 		const shuffledZones = zonesWithCells.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
013366: 		for (const z of shuffledZones) {
013367: 			if (chosen.length >= 2) break;
013368: 			const picked = z.cells[Math.floor(Math.random() * z.cells.length)];
013369: 			if (picked) chosen.push({ cell: picked, id: z.id });
013370: 		}
013371: 
013372: 		// Als we nog geen 2 portals hebben, vul aan uit overgebleven cellen
013373: 		if (chosen.length < 2) {
013374: 			const allCandidates = zonesWithCells.flatMap(z => z.cells.map(cell => ({ cell, id: z.id })));
013375: 			const remaining = allCandidates.filter(c => !chosen.some(ch => ch.cell === c.cell));
013376: 			const shuffledRemaining = remaining.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
013377: 			for (const item of shuffledRemaining) {
013378: 				if (chosen.length >= 2) break;
013379: 				chosen.push(item);
013380: 			}
013381: 		}
013382: 
013383: 		chosen.forEach(({ cell, id }) => {
013384: 			setupPortalCell(cell, id);
013385: 			portalCells.push(cell);
013386: 		});
013387: 
013388: 	}
013389:

014918: 	function getObjectiveById(id) {
014919: 		if (!id) return null;
014920: 		// Primary lookup: the generated OBJECTIVES list (one randomly selected objective per level).

015025: 		function progress(scores) {

015028: 			if (wantsTotal || colors.length === 0) {
015029: 				const total = computeTotalFromScores(s);

015486: 		function stripObjectiveSymbols(text) {
015487: 			if (text == null) return '';
015488: 			let t = String(text);
015489: 			// Remove common emoji/symbol ranges + variation selectors.
015490: 			try {
015491: 				t = t.replace(/[\uFE0E\uFE0F]/g, '');
015492: 				t = t.replace(/[\u200D]/g, '');
015493: 				t = t.replace(/[\u2600-\u27BF]/g, '');
015494: 				t = t.replace(/[\u{1F000}-\u{1FAFF}]/gu, '');
015495: 			} catch {
015496: 				t = t.replace(/[\uFE0E\uFE0F\u200D\u2600-\u27BF]/g, '');
015497: 			}
015498: 			return t.replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ').trim();
015499: 		}

015501: 		function normalizeObjectiveProgress(progressText) {
015502: 			let p = stripObjectiveSymbols(progressText);
015503: 			if (!p) return '';
015504: 			// If progress starts with "n/m ...", keep only "n/m".
015505: 			const m = p.match(/^\s*(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)(?:\s+.*)?$/);
015506: 			if (m) return `${m[1]}/${m[2]}`;
015507: 			return p;
015508: 		}

015510: 		// Objective-driven bonus bias:
015511: 		// If the current objective focuses on a color (e.g. "Scoor 15 punten in rood"),
015512: 		// increase the chance that bonus symbols of that color appear across the grids.
015513: 		function computeObjectiveDrivenBonusColorChances() {
015514: 			try {
015515: 				const colors = ['blue', 'green', 'red', 'purple', 'yellow'];
015516: 				const defaultChances = colors.map(c => ({ color: c, weight: 1 }));
015517: 				const getObjectiveText = () => {
015518: 					// Prefer a loaded custom objective when present.
015519: 					try {
015520: 						if (window && window.loadedCustomObjectiveCompiled) {
015521: 							return String(window.loadedCustomObjectiveCompiled.description || window.loadedCustomObjectiveCompiled.short || '').trim();
015522: 						}
015523: 					} catch (_) {}
015524: 					const obj = (typeof getObjectiveById === 'function' ? getObjectiveById(currentObjectiveId) : null)
015525: 						|| (typeof getObjectiveForLevel === 'function' ? getObjectiveForLevel(currentLevel) : null);
015526: 					return obj ? String(obj.description || obj.short || '').trim() : '';
015527: 				};
015528: 
015529: 				const raw = getObjectiveText();
015530: 				if (!raw) return null;
015531: 				const s = raw.toLowerCase();
015532: 
015533: 				// If objective is explicitly "all colors" / rainbow / multicolor: do NOT bias.
015534: 				if (/(?:alle\s+kleur|alle\s+kleuren|elke\s+kleur|regenboog|multikleur)/i.test(s)) return null;
015535: 
015536: 				// Detect mentioned colors (Dutch base + common adjective forms).
015537: 				const mentioned = new Set();
015538: 				const patterns = [
015539: 					{ key: 'yellow', re: /\b(?:geel|gele)\b/i },
015540: 					{ key: 'red', re: /\b(?:rood|rode)\b/i },
015541: 					{ key: 'green', re: /\b(?:groen|groene)\b/i },
015542: 					{ key: 'purple', re: /\b(?:paars|paarse)\b/i },
015543: 					{ key: 'blue', re: /\b(?:blauw|blauwe)\b/i }
015544: 				];
015545: 				for (const p of patterns) {
015546: 					if (p.re.test(s)) mentioned.add(p.key);
015547: 				}
015548: 
015549: 				// If objective is diagonal/column-based and no color is mentioned (fallback): assume yellow.
015550: 				if (mentioned.size === 0 && /diagona|kolom|segment/i.test(s)) {
015551: 					mentioned.add('yellow');
015552: 				}
015553: 
015554: 				// No clear color focus (e.g. total score / coins / collect bonuses): keep uniform.
015555: 				if (mentioned.size === 0) return null;
015556: 				// If it's basically "many colors", biasing is not helpful.
015557: 				if (mentioned.size >= 4) return null;
015558: 
015559: 				const boost = (mentioned.size === 1) ? 3 : (mentioned.size === 2) ? 2.3 : 1.8;
015560: 				const weights = {
015561: 					blue: 1,
015562: 					green: 1,
015563: 					red: 1,
015564: 					purple: 1,
015565: 					yellow: 1
015566: 				};
015567: 				for (const k of mentioned) {
015568: 					if (weights[k] != null) weights[k] = weights[k] * boost;
015569: 				}
015570: 
015571: 				const out = defaultChances.map(entry => ({ color: entry.color, weight: weights[entry.color] || 1 }));
015572: 				// Sanity clamp
015573: 				return out.map(e => ({ color: e.color, weight: Math.max(0.01, Number(e.weight) || 1) }));
015574: 			} catch (e) {
015575: 				return null;
015576: 			}
015577: 		}
015578: 
015579: 		function refreshObjectiveDrivenBonusBias() {
015580: 			try {
015581: 				const chances = computeObjectiveDrivenBonusColorChances();
015582: 				if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
015583: 					window.__objectiveBonusColorChances = Array.isArray(chances) ? chances : null;
015584: 				}
015585: 			} catch (_) {
015586: 				try { if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.__objectiveBonusColorChances = null; } catch (e) {}
015587: 			}
015588: 		}

016854: 		const zoneOrder = preferred === 'yellow'
016855: 			? ['yellow', 'blue', 'green']

016860: 		const pickCandidateCell = (gridId, { preferTop = false } = {}) => {
016861: 			const grid = document.getElementById(gridId);
016862: 			if (!grid) return null;
016863: 			const candidates = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.cell:not(.void-cell)'))
016864: 				.filter(cell => cell.dataset.disabled !== 'true')
016865: 				.filter(cell => !cell.classList.contains('active'))
016866: 				.filter(cell => !cell.classList.contains('bold-cell'))
016867: 				.filter(cell => !cell.classList.contains('gold-cell'))
016868: 				.filter(cell => !cell.classList.contains('trap-cell'))
016869: 				.filter(cell => !cell.querySelector('.symbol'));
016870: 			if (!candidates.length) return null;
016871: 			if (!preferTop) return candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)];
016872: 
016873: 			let bestCell = null;
016874: 			let bestScore = { y: Infinity, x: Infinity, idx: Infinity };
016875: 			const scoreCell = (cell, idx) => {
016876: 				const y = Number(cell.dataset.y);
016877: 				const x = Number(cell.dataset.x);
016878: 				return {
016879: 					y: Number.isFinite(y) ? y : Infinity,
016880: 					x: Number.isFinite(x) ? x : Infinity,
016881: 					idx
016882: 				};
016883: 			};
016884: 			candidates.forEach((cell, idx) => {
016885: 				const score = scoreCell(cell, idx);
016886: 				if (!bestCell || score.y < bestScore.y || (score.y === bestScore.y && (score.x < bestScore.x || (score.x === bestScore.x && score.idx < bestScore.idx)))) {
016887: 					bestCell = cell;
016888: 					bestScore = score;
016889: 				}
016890: 			});
016891: 			return bestCell || candidates[0];
016892: 		};

017191: 	 // ---------- CREATE GRID (general) ----------
017192: 	function createGrid(containerId, rows, cols, options = {}) {
017193: 		options = Object.assign({
017194: 			boldBottom: false,
017195: 			goldCells: false,
017196: 			symbols: false,
017197: 			symbolChance: 0.3,
017198: 			minSymbols: 0,
017199: 			maxSymbols: 0,
017200: 			coinChance: 0.0,
017201: 			maxCoins: 0,
017202: 			trapChance: 0,
017203: 			maxTraps: 0,
017204: 			blackHoleChance: BLACK_HOLE_DEFAULT_CHANCE,
017205: 			rowLengths: null,
017206: 			rowOffsets: null,
017207: 			voidCells: null,
017208: 			boldRows: [],
017209: 			randomBoldCount: null,
017210: 			includeDefaultBlueBold: true,
017211: 			colorChances: null,
017212: 					pointsPerWidthMap: null,
017213: 					pointsPerColumn: null,
017214: 					avoidAdjacentBold: false,
017215: 					diagonalShading: false,
017216: 					diagonalLegend: false,
017217: 					ringShading: false,
017218: 					columnShading: false,
017219: 					fixedBoldCells: null,
017220: 					outerRingShade: false,
017221: 					trimLeft: false,
017222: 					trimRight: false,
017223: 					randomBoldMinEdgeDistance: 0,
017224: 					ensureAdjacentBoldPair: false
017225: 		}, options);
017226: 
017227: 		const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
017228: 		if (!container) return;
017229: 
017230: 		const normalizedRowLengths = [];
017231: 		const normalizedRowOffsets = [];
017232: 		const hasCustomRowLengths = Array.isArray(options.rowLengths) && options.rowLengths.length;
017233: 		const hasCustomRowOffsets = Array.isArray(options.rowOffsets) && options.rowOffsets.length;
017234: 
017235: 		let usedMaxCols = 0;
017236: 		for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
017237: 			const lengthSourceIndex = hasCustomRowLengths
017238: 				? (i < options.rowLengths.length ? i : options.rowLengths.length - 1)
017239: 				: -1;
017240: 			const offsetSourceIndex = hasCustomRowOffsets
017241: 				? (i < options.rowOffsets.length ? i : options.rowOffsets.length - 1)
017242: 				: -1;
017243: 
017244: 			const rawLength = lengthSourceIndex >= 0 ? options.rowLengths[lengthSourceIndex] : cols;
017245: 			const normalizedLength = Math.max(0, Number(rawLength) || 0);
017246: 			normalizedRowLengths.push(normalizedLength);
017247: 
017248: 			const rawOffset = offsetSourceIndex >= 0 ? options.rowOffsets[offsetSourceIndex] : 0;
017249: 			const normalizedOffset = Math.max(0, Number(rawOffset) || 0);
017250: 			normalizedRowOffsets.push(normalizedOffset);
017251: 
017252: 			if (normalizedLength > 0) {
017253: 				usedMaxCols = Math.max(usedMaxCols, normalizedOffset + normalizedLength);
017254: 			}
017255: 		}
017256: 
017257: 		let maxCols = Math.max(cols, usedMaxCols);
017258: 
017259: 		// Optional: trim empty leading columns when using rowOffsets.
017260: 		// Useful for World 2 blue path, where generation starts at offset>0 (otherwise you get lots of empty space on the left).
017261: 		let workingVoidCells = options.voidCells;
017262: 		if (options.trimLeft && hasCustomRowOffsets) {
017263: 			let minOffset = Infinity;
017264: 			for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
017265: 				if (normalizedRowLengths[r] > 0) {
017266: 					minOffset = Math.min(minOffset, normalizedRowOffsets[r]);
017267: 				}
017268: 			}
017269: 			if (Number.isFinite(minOffset) && minOffset > 0) {
017270: 				for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
017271: 					normalizedRowOffsets[r] = Math.max(0, (normalizedRowOffsets[r] || 0) - minOffset);
017272: 				}
017273: 				maxCols = Math.max(1, maxCols - minOffset);
017274: 				if (workingVoidCells && workingVoidCells instanceof Set) {
017275: 					const shifted = new Set();
017276: 					for (const key of workingVoidCells) {
017277: 						const parts = String(key).split(',');
017278: 						if (parts.length < 2) continue;
017279: 						const x = Number(parts[0]);
017280: 						const y = parts[1];
017281: 						if (!Number.isFinite(x)) continue;

018636:   // ---------- GENERATE ROOTS (green + red variants) ----------
018637: 	function generateRoots(gridId, rows = 12, cols = 12, branchCount = 5, splitChance = 0.25, coinChance = 0.05, minSymbols = 3, maxSymbols = 6, maxCoins = 5, isRed = false, trapChance = 0, maxTraps = 0, blackHoleChance = BLACK_HOLE_DEFAULT_CHANCE, options = null) {
018638: 	  const container = document.getElementById(gridId);
018639: 	  
018640: 	  // Check of container bestaat
018641: 	  if (!container) {
018642: 		console.warn(`⚠️ Grid element with ID "${gridId}" not found, skipping generation`);
018643: 		return;
018644: 	  }
018645: 	  
018646: 	  container.innerHTML = '';
018647: 
018648: 	  // Bepaal huidige world voor world-specifieke tuning
018649: 	  let worldNum = 1;
018650: 	  try {
018651: 		const info = (typeof getWorldAndSubLevel === 'function') ? getWorldAndSubLevel(typeof currentLevel !== 'undefined' ? currentLevel : 1) : null;
018652: 		worldNum = Number(info?.world || 1) || 1;
018653: 	  } catch (e) {}
018654: 
018655: 	  // Red determinism: enforce a predictable number of active cells AND fixed points per subgrid.
018656: 	  // Note: points are NOT derived from cells; red subgrids award fixed points when fully filled.
018657: 	  const redTargetsById = {
018658: 		'red-grid1': { tier: 'klein', cells: 12, points: 20 },
018659: 		'red-grid2': { tier: 'midden', cells: 16, points: 35 },
018660: 		'red-grid3': { tier: 'groot', cells: 20, points: 45 },
018661: 		'red-grid4': { tier: 'mega', cells: 24, points: 58 },
018662: 		// World 3 uses 6 red grids; reuse the mega tier unless overridden.
018663: 		'red-grid5': { tier: 'mega', cells: 24, points: 80 },
018664: 		'red-grid6': { tier: 'mega', cells: 24, points: 80 }
018665: 	  };
018666: 	  const opts = (options && typeof options === 'object') ? options : null;
018667: 	  const preset = redTargetsById[gridId] || null;
018668: 	  let resolvedRedTargetCells = isRed
018669: 		? (Number(opts?.targetCells) || Number(preset?.cells) || 0)
018670: 		: 0;
018671: 	  let resolvedRedTargetPoints = isRed
018672: 		? (Number(opts?.targetPoints) || Number(preset?.points) || 0)
018673: 		: 0;
018674: 	  // Back-compat: if only points are provided, infer a cell target (legacy 2pt/cell rule).
018675: 	  if (isRed && !(resolvedRedTargetCells > 0) && (resolvedRedTargetPoints > 0)) {
018676: 		resolvedRedTargetCells = Math.max(1, Math.round(resolvedRedTargetPoints / 2));
018677: 	  }
018678: 	  const baseRedCells = resolvedRedTargetCells;
018679: 	  const baseRedPointRatio = (resolvedRedTargetCells > 0 && resolvedRedTargetPoints > 0)
018680: 		? (resolvedRedTargetPoints / resolvedRedTargetCells)
018681: 		: 2;
018682: 	const redDensityBoost = isRed && (worldNum <= 2 || worldNum === 3);
018683: 	  let redTargetActiveCells = (isRed && resolvedRedTargetCells > 0)
018684: 		? Math.max(1, Math.floor(resolvedRedTargetCells))
018685: 		: 0;
018686: 	if (redDensityBoost && redTargetActiveCells > 0) {
018687: 		const densityFactor = worldNum <= 2 ? 0.15 : 0.08;
018688: 		const extra = Math.max(2, Math.round(redTargetActiveCells * densityFactor));
018689: 		redTargetActiveCells += extra;
018690: 		if (baseRedPointRatio > 0) {
018691: 		  resolvedRedTargetPoints = Math.max(resolvedRedTargetPoints, Math.round(redTargetActiveCells * baseRedPointRatio));
018692: 		}
018693: 	  }
018694: 	  if (isRed && redTargetActiveCells > 0) {
018695: 		const maxCapacity = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rows) * Math.floor(cols));
018696: 		redTargetActiveCells = Math.min(redTargetActiveCells, maxCapacity);
018697: 		if (!(resolvedRedTargetPoints > 0)) resolvedRedTargetPoints = redTargetActiveCells * 2;
018698: 		try {
018699: 			container.dataset.redTargetCells = String(redTargetActiveCells);
018700: 			container.dataset.redTargetPoints = String(resolvedRedTargetPoints);
018701: 			if (preset && preset.tier) container.dataset.redTierName = String(preset.tier);
018702: 		} catch (e) {}
018703: 	  }
018704: 	container.dataset.rows = String(rows);
018705: 	container.dataset.cols = String(cols);
018706: 	  container.style.position = 'relative';
018707: 	  container.style.width = `calc(${cols} * var(--cell-size))`;
018708: 	  container.style.height = `calc(${rows} * var(--cell-size))`;
018709: 	
018710: 	  const toIndex = (r,c)=> r*cols + c;
018711: 	  const isInside = (r,c)=> r>=0 && r<rows && c>=0 && c<cols;
018712: 
018713: 	  const clusterSet = new Set();
018714: 	  const clusterMap = {};
018715: 	  const dirs = [{r:-1,c:0},{r:1,c:0},{r:0,c:-1},{r:0,c:1}];
018716: 
018717: 	  const defaultColorChances = [
018718: 		{ color: 'blue', weight: 1 },
018719: 		{ color: 'green', weight: 1 },
018720: 		{ color: 'red', weight: 1 },
018721: 		{ color: 'purple', weight: 1 },
018722: 		{ color: 'yellow', weight: 1 }
018723: 	  ];
018724: 	  const objectiveColorChances = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window && Array.isArray(window.__objectiveBonusColorChances))
018725: 		? window.__objectiveBonusColorChances
018726: 		: null;
018727: 	  const colorChances = objectiveColorChances || defaultColorChances;
018728: 	  const totalWeight = colorChances.reduce((s, o) => s + (Number(o.weight) || 0), 0) || 1;
018729: 
018730: 	  const centerR = Math.floor(rows/2);
018731: 	  const centerC = Math.floor(cols/2);
018732: 	  const centerIdx = toIndex(centerR, centerC);
018733: 	  container.dataset.startX = String(centerC);
018734: 	  container.dataset.startY = String(centerR);
018735: 
018736: 	  // WORLD 2 green: special generator (mega root in center -> 4 arms with World 1-like branching).
018737: 	  const isWorld2Green = !isRed && gridId === 'green-grid' && (rows >= 24 || cols >= 24);
018738: 
018739: 	  // Fallback for tall-green variants (older tuning): fewer, longer continuous branches.
018740: 	  const isTallGreen = !isWorld2Green && !isRed && gridId === 'green-grid' && rows >= 40;
018741: 	  let growthBudget = Math.max(0, Math.floor(branchCount));
018742: 	  const branchAttempts = isTallGreen ? Math.max(18, Math.floor(growthBudget / 10)) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(branchCount));
018743: 	  const minBranchLen = isTallGreen ? 8 : 2;
018744: 	  const maxBranchLen = isTallGreen ? 18 : 5;
018745: 
018746: 		function makeCell(r,c,isCenter=false, isVoid=false){
018747: 		  const el = document.createElement('div');
018748: 		  el.classList.add('cell','root-cell');
018749: 		  if(isVoid) {
018750: 			el.classList.add('void-cell');
018751: 			el.style.opacity = '0';
018752: 			el.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
018753: 		  }
018754: 		  if(isCenter && !isRed && !isVoid) el.classList.add('bold-cell');
018755: 		  el.style.position = 'absolute';
018756: 		  el.style.left = `calc(${c} * var(--cell-size))`;
018757: 		  el.style.top  = `calc(${r} * var(--cell-size))`;
018758: 		  el.style.zIndex = isCenter ? 10 : 1;
018759: 		  // Sla r/c op als data-attributes — dit is cruciaal voor de edge-detectie
018760: 		  el.dataset.r = String(r);
018761: 		  el.dataset.c = String(c);
018762: 		  el.dataset.x = c; // kolomindex
018763: 		  el.dataset.y = r; // rijindex
018764: 		  el.dataset.zoneId = gridId;
018765: 	
018766: 		  if(!isVoid) {
018767: 			// World 2 green UX: allow dragging/panning the grid without accidentally toggling cells.
018768: 			// We toggle on pointerup and ignore it if the zone was drag-scrolled.
018769: 			if (gridId === 'green-grid' && (rows >= 24 || cols >= 24)) {
018770: 				el.addEventListener('pointerup', (e)=>{
018771: 					const zoneEl = container.closest('#green-zone');
018772: 					if (zoneEl && zoneEl.dataset.dragScrolling === 'true') return;
018773: 					e.preventDefault();

018775: 				});
018776: 			} else {
018777: 				el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e)=>{ e.preventDefault(); toggleCell(el, gridId); });
018778: 			}
018779: 		  }
018780: 		  return el;
018781: 		}
018782: 
018783: 
018784: 	  // center
018785: 	  const centerCell = makeCell(centerR, centerC, true, false);
018786: 	  if (!isRed) centerCell.classList.add('bold-cell');
018787: 	  container.appendChild(centerCell);
018788: 	  clusterSet.add(centerIdx);
018789: 	  clusterMap[centerIdx] = centerCell;
018790: 
018791: 	  // build branches first to determine which cells are active
018792: 	  // Verbeterde logica: creëer bredere, speelbaardere gebieden
018793: 	  const endpoints = [{r:centerR,c:centerC}];
018794: 	  
018795: 	  // Helper functie om naburige cellen toe te voegen (voor breedte)
018796: 	  const addWidthCell = (r, c, dir) => {
018797: 		// Voeg een cel toe perpendiculair aan de richting voor breedte
018798: 		const perpendicular = [
018799: 		  {r: dir.c, c: -dir.r},  // 90 graden gedraaid
018800: 		  {r: -dir.c, c: dir.r}   // -90 graden gedraaid
018801: 		];
018802: 		const chosen = perpendicular[Math.floor(Math.random() * perpendicular.length)];
018803: 		const newR = r + chosen.r;
018804: 		const newC = c + chosen.c;
018805: 		if (isInside(newR, newC)) {
018806: 		  const idx = toIndex(newR, newC);
018807: 		  if (!clusterSet.has(idx)) {
018808: 			clusterSet.add(idx);
018809: 			if (isTallGreen && growthBudget > 0) growthBudget -= 1;
018810: 			return true;
018811: 		  }
018812: 		}
018813: 		return false;
018814: 	  };
018815: 	  
018816: 	  // Voor groen grid: zorg voor exact 8 eindpunten
018817: 	const targetEndpoints = !isRed ? 8 : Math.max(1, Math.floor(branchCount * splitChance));
018818: 	  
018819: 	  if (isWorld2Green) {
018820: 		// 1) Build a thick center "mega root" (2-3 wide).
018821: 		const thickness = Math.random() < 0.6 ? 2 : 3;
018822: 		const halfA = Math.floor((thickness - 1) / 2);
018823: 		const halfB = thickness - 1 - halfA;
018824: 		const top = Math.max(0, centerR - halfA);
018825: 		const bottom = Math.min(rows - 1, centerR + halfB);
018826: 		const left = Math.max(0, centerC - halfA);
018827: 		const right = Math.min(cols - 1, centerC + halfB);
018828: 		for (let rr = top; rr <= bottom; rr++) {
018829: 			for (let cc = left; cc <= right; cc++) {
018830: 				clusterSet.add(toIndex(rr, cc));
018831: 			}
018832: 		}
018833: 
018834: 		// 2) Create 4 arms that branch like World 1.
018835: 		const armStarts = [];
018836: 		if (isInside(top - 1, centerC)) armStarts.push({ r: top - 1, c: centerC, primary: { r: -1, c: 0 } });
018837: 		if (isInside(bottom + 1, centerC)) armStarts.push({ r: bottom + 1, c: centerC, primary: { r: 1, c: 0 } });
018838: 		if (isInside(centerR, left - 1)) armStarts.push({ r: centerR, c: left - 1, primary: { r: 0, c: -1 } });
018839: 		if (isInside(centerR, right + 1)) armStarts.push({ r: centerR, c: right + 1, primary: { r: 0, c: 1 } });
018840: 		armStarts.forEach(s => clusterSet.add(toIndex(s.r, s.c)));
018841: 
018842: 		const armBranches = Math.max(10, Math.floor(branchCount / 8));
018843: 		const chooseDirForArm = (primaryDir) => {
018844: 			// Bias outward + sideways, avoid going back toward the center.
018845: 			const weighted = [];
018846: 			for (const d of dirs) {
018847: 				let w = 1;
018848: 				if (d.r === primaryDir.r && d.c === primaryDir.c) w = 5;
018849: 				else if (d.r === -primaryDir.r && d.c === -primaryDir.c) w = 0.5;
018850: 				else w = 2;
018851: 				weighted.push({ d, w });
018852: 			}
018853: 			const total = weighted.reduce((s, x) => s + x.w, 0);
018854: 			let roll = Math.random() * total;
018855: 			for (const item of weighted) {
018856: 				roll -= item.w;
018857: 				if (roll <= 0) return item.d;
018858: 			}
018859: 			return primaryDir;
018860: 		};
018861: 
018862: 		for (const arm of armStarts) {
018863: 			const armEndpoints = [{ r: arm.r, c: arm.c }];
018864: 			for (let b = 0; b < armBranches; b++) {
018865: 				const len = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
018866: 				const start = armEndpoints[Math.floor(Math.random() * armEndpoints.length)];
018867: 				let r = start.r;
018868: 				let c = start.c;
018869: 				const dir = chooseDirForArm(arm.primary);
018870: 				const makeWide = Math.random() < 0.20;
018871: 				for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
018872: 					r += dir.r;
018873: 					c += dir.c;
018874: 					if (!isInside(r, c)) break;
018875: 					const idx = toIndex(r, c);
018876: 					if (clusterSet.has(idx)) continue;
018877: 					clusterSet.add(idx);
018878: 					if (makeWide || Math.random() < 0.12) addWidthCell(r, c, dir);
018879: 					if (armEndpoints.length < targetEndpoints && i > 0 && Math.random() < splitChance) {
018880: 						armEndpoints.push({ r, c });
018881: 					}
018882: 				}
018883: 			}
018884: 		}
018885: 	  } else {
018886: 		for(let b=0;b<branchAttempts;b++){
018887: 		  if (isTallGreen && growthBudget <= 0) break;
018888: 		const len = minBranchLen + Math.floor(Math.random() * (maxBranchLen - minBranchLen + 1));
018889: 		  const start = endpoints[Math.floor(Math.random()*endpoints.length)];
018890: 		  let r = start.r, c = start.c;
018891: 		  const dir = dirs[Math.floor(Math.random()*dirs.length)];
018892: 		  
018893: 		const redWideBias = isRed && (worldNum <= 2 || worldNum === 3);
018894: 		const redWideChance = isRed ? (worldNum === 3 ? 0.35 : 0.55) : 0.25;
018895: 		// 25% kans op breedte voor niet-rood; voor wereld 1/2 (en milder bij 3) rood ook bredere takken
018896: 		const makeWide = (!isRed && Math.random() < 0.25) || (redWideBias && Math.random() < redWideChance);
018897: 
018898: 		  for(let i=0;i<len;i++){
018899: 			if (isTallGreen && growthBudget <= 0) break;
018900: 			r += dir.r; c += dir.c;
018901: 			if(!isInside(r,c)) break;
018902: 			const idx = toIndex(r,c);
018903: 			if(clusterSet.has(idx)) continue;
018904: 
018905: 			clusterSet.add(idx); // Markeer deze cel als actief (niet void)
018906: 			if (isTallGreen && growthBudget > 0) growthBudget -= 1;
018907: 			
018908: 			// Maak de tak breder op deze positie
018909: 			if (makeWide || Math.random() < 0.1) {
018910: 			  addWidthCell(r, c, dir);
018911: 			}
018912: 
018913: 			// Voeg eindpunt toe als we er nog niet genoeg hebben (voor groen grid)
018914: 			if (!isRed && endpoints.length < targetEndpoints && i > 0) {
018915: 			  if (Math.random() < splitChance) endpoints.push({r,c});
018916: 			} else if (isRed && Math.random() < splitChance) {
018917: 			  endpoints.push({r,c});
018918: 			}
018919: 		  }
018920: 		}
018921: 	  }
018922: 	  
018923: 	  // Red determinism: enforce a fixed number of active (non-void) cells.
018924: 	  if (isRed && redTargetActiveCells > 0) {
018925: 		try {
018926: 			const distFromCenter = (idx) => {
018927: 				const r = Math.floor(idx / cols);
018928: 				const c = idx % cols;
018929: 				return Math.abs(r - centerR) + Math.abs(c - centerC);
018930: 			};
018931: 			const neighborIdxs = (idx, set) => {
018932: 				const r = Math.floor(idx / cols);
018933: 				const c = idx % cols;
018934: 				const out = [];
018935: 				for (const d of dirs) {
018936: 					const rr = r + d.r;
018937: 					const cc = c + d.c;
018938: 					if (!isInside(rr, cc)) continue;
018939: 					const nIdx = toIndex(rr, cc);
018940: 					if (set.has(nIdx)) out.push(nIdx);
018941: 				}
018942: 				return out;
018943: 			};
018944: 			const neighborCount = (idx, set) => neighborIdxs(idx, set).length;
018945: 			const isConnectedSet = (set) => {
018946: 				if (!set.size) return true;
018947: 				const it = set.values();
018948: 				const start = it.next().value;
018949: 				const q = [start];
018950: 				const seen = new Set([start]);
018951: 				while (q.length) {
018952: 					const cur = q.pop();
018953: 					for (const n of neighborIdxs(cur, set)) {
018954: 						if (seen.has(n)) continue;
018955: 						seen.add(n);
018956: 						q.push(n);
018957: 					}
018958: 				}
018959: 				return seen.size === set.size;
018960: 			};
018961: 			const canRemove = (idx) => {
018962: 				if (idx === centerIdx) return false;
018963: 				if (!clusterSet.has(idx)) return false;
018964: 				if (clusterSet.size <= 2) return false;
018965: 				const tmp = new Set(clusterSet);
018966: 				tmp.delete(idx);
018967: 				return isConnectedSet(tmp);
018968: 			};
018969: 			const frontierCells = () => {
018970: 				const frontierSet = new Set();
018971: 				clusterSet.forEach(idx => {
018972: 					const r = Math.floor(idx / cols);
018973: 					const c = idx % cols;
018974: 					for (const d of dirs) {
018975: 						const rr = r + d.r;
018976: 						const cc = c + d.c;
018977: 						if (!isInside(rr, cc)) continue;
018978: 						const nIdx = toIndex(rr, cc);
018979: 						if (!clusterSet.has(nIdx)) frontierSet.add(nIdx);
018980: 					}
018981: 				});
018982: 				return Array.from(frontierSet);
018983: 			};
018984: 			const pickFrontierToAdd = () => {
018985: 				const frontier = frontierCells();
018986: 				if (!frontier.length) return null;
018987: 				// Prefer further-out cells to avoid overly square blobs.
018988: 				frontier.sort((a, b) => distFromCenter(b) - distFromCenter(a));
018989: 				const pickPool = frontier.slice(0, Math.min(frontier.length, 6));
018990: 				return pickPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pickPool.length)];
018991: 			};
018992: 			const pickInteriorToRemove = () => {
018993: 				const candidates = Array.from(clusterSet).filter(i => i !== centerIdx);
018994: 				// Prefer interior (higher degree), then closer-to-center (creates holes), then random.
018995: 				candidates.sort((a, b) => {
018996: 					const d = neighborCount(b, clusterSet) - neighborCount(a, clusterSet);
018997: 					if (d) return d;
018998: 					const dc = distFromCenter(a) - distFromCenter(b);
018999: 					if (dc) return dc;
019000: 					return Math.random() - 0.5;
019001: 				});
019002: 				for (const idx of candidates) {
019003: 					if (canRemove(idx)) return idx;
019004: 				}
019005: 				return null;
019006: 			};
019007: 
019008: 			clusterSet.add(centerIdx);
019009: 			// Shrink to target (connectivity-safe)
019010: 			while (clusterSet.size > redTargetActiveCells) {
019011: 				const rem = pickInteriorToRemove();
019012: 				if (rem === null) break;
019013: 				clusterSet.delete(rem);
019014: 			}
019015: 			// Grow to target (prefer outward frontier)
019016: 			while (clusterSet.size < redTargetActiveCells) {
019017: 				const add = pickFrontierToAdd();
019018: 				if (add === null) break;
019019: 				clusterSet.add(add);
019020: 			}
019021: 
019022: 			// Make the red shape more interesting: carve a few "holes" via swap operations
019023: 			// (remove an interior cell, add a frontier cell) while keeping connectivity.
019024: 			let swapAttempts = Math.max(3, Math.min(14, Math.floor(redTargetActiveCells * 0.8)));

019676: 		if (!trap) return null;
019677: 		try {
019678: 			const cell = trap.cell;
019679: 			const zone = normalizeZoneId(String(trap.zoneId || cell?.dataset?.zoneId || cell?.closest?.('.grid')?.id || ''));
019680: 			const x = cell?.dataset?.x;
019681: 			const y = cell?.dataset?.y;
019682: 			if (x !== undefined && y !== undefined) return `${zone}|${x}|${y}`;
019683: 			if (trap.id) return `id:${trap.id}`;
019684: 			if (cell?.dataset?.trapInstanceId) return `inst:${cell.dataset.trapInstanceId}`;
019685: 			if (cell) return `cell:${zone}|${cell}`;

019700: 	function pruneTrapPenaltyByKey() {
019701: 		try {
019702: 			if (!(trapPenaltyByKey instanceof Map)) return;
019703: 			const toDelete = [];
019704: 			trapPenaltyByKey.forEach((_, key) => {
019705: 				try {
019706: 					const parts = String(key || '').split('|');
019707: 					if (parts.length < 3) { toDelete.push(key); return; }
019708: 					const zoneId = parts[0];
019709: 					const x = parts[1];
019710: 					const y = parts[2];
019711: 					const grid = document.getElementById(zoneId);
019712: 					if (!grid) { toDelete.push(key); return; }
019713: 					const selector = `.cell[data-x="${String(x)}"][data-y="${String(y)}"]`;
019714: 					const cell = grid.querySelector(selector);
019715: 					if (!cell || !cell.classList.contains('active') || cell.dataset.trapTriggered !== 'true') {
019716: 						if (cell) {
019717: 							delete cell.dataset.trapPenaltyApplied;
019718: 							delete cell.dataset.trapColorKey;
019719: 							delete cell.dataset.trapPenaltyKey;
019720: 						}
019721: 						toDelete.push(key);
019722: 					}
019723: 				} catch (e) { toDelete.push(key); }
019724: 			});
019725: 			if (toDelete.length) toDelete.forEach(k => trapPenaltyByKey.delete(k));
019726: 		} catch (e) {}
019727: 	}

019812: 	function decorateTrapCell(cell, options = {}) {
019813: 	  if (!cell) return 'pit';
019814: 	  const { forceType = null, blackHoleChance = BLACK_HOLE_DEFAULT_CHANCE } = options;
019815: 	  const hasExistingBlackHole = blackHoleTrapPlaced || !!document.querySelector('.cell.trap-cell[data-trap-type="blackHole"]');
019816: 	  let trapType = forceType;
019817: 	  if (!trapType) {
019818: 		const chance = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(blackHoleChance) || 0));
019819: 		trapType = chance > 0 && Math.random() < chance ? 'blackHole' : 'pit';
019820: 		if (trapType === 'blackHole' && hasExistingBlackHole) trapType = 'pit';
019821: 	  } else if (trapType === 'blackHole' && hasExistingBlackHole) {
019822: 		trapType = 'pit';
019823: 	  }
019824: 	  cell.classList.add('trap-cell');
019825: 	  cell.dataset.trapType = trapType;
019826: 	  if (trapType === 'blackHole') {
019827: 		cell.dataset.blackHole = 'true';
019828: 		delete cell.dataset.trap;
019829: 	  } else {
019830: 		cell.dataset.trap = 'true';
019831: 	  }
019832: 	const shouldRevealTrap = trapType !== 'blackHole' || hasUpgrade('blackHoleAccess') || isUpgradeAvailable('blackHoleAccess');
019833: 	if (shouldRevealTrap) {
019834: 		const symbol = document.createElement('div');
019835: 		symbol.classList.add('symbol', 'trap-symbol');
019836: 		if (trapType === 'blackHole') symbol.classList.add('trap-symbol--black-hole');
019837: 		else symbol.classList.add('trap-symbol--pit');
019838: 		cell.appendChild(symbol);
019839: 	}
019840: 	if (trapType === 'blackHole') blackHoleTrapPlaced = true;
019841: 	  return trapType;
019842: 	}

020129: 	   World 2+: Getrapte schaal:
020130: 	     - 0-50 punten: 1 coin per 10 punten (max 5)

020132: 	     - 150+ punten: 1 coin per 50 punten
020133: 	*/
020134: 	function calculateCoinsForScore(score, isWorld2Plus = false) {
020135: 	  if (!isWorld2Plus) {
020136: 		return Math.floor(score / 10);
020137: 	  }
020138: 	  // World 2+ tiered system
020139: 	  let coins = 0;
020140: 	  if (score <= 50) {
020141: 		coins = Math.floor(score / 10);
020142: 	  } else if (score <= 150) {
020143: 		coins = 5 + Math.floor((score - 50) / 25);
020144: 	  } else {
020145: 		coins = 5 + 4 + Math.floor((score - 150) / 50);
020146: 	  }
020147: 	  return coins;

023738: 	// Bouw shapePool dynamisch op basis van upgrades
023739: 	function buildShapePool() {
023740: 		const pool = [];
023741: 		const weights = { ...SHAPE_CATEGORY_WEIGHTS };
023742: 		const effectiveLevel = Math.max(1, Number(currentLevel) || 1);
023743: 		
023744: 		// Pas weights aan op basis van upgrades
023745: 		if (hasUpgrade('miniPack34')) {
023746: 			weights.mini = 0.65;  // Meer mini kaarten
023747: 		}
023748: 		
023749: 		// Voeg alleen unlocked categories toe aan pool
023750: 		Object.entries(CARD_BLUEPRINTS).forEach(([category, cards]) => {
023751: 			if (category === 'golden') return; // Skip golden, die worden apart toegevoegd
023752: 			
023753: 			// Check of category unlocked is
023754: 			if (!UNLOCK_PROGRESSION.isCategoryUnlocked(category, effectiveLevel)) {
023755: 				return; // Skip niet-unlocked categorieën
023756: 			}
023757: 			
023758: 			cards.forEach(card => {
023759: 				const categoryWeight = weights[category] ?? 1;
023760: 				pool.push({
023761: 					name: card.name,
023762: 					category: category,
023763: 					weight: card.weight * categoryWeight,
023764: 					matrix: card.matrix
023765: 				});
023766: 			});
023767: 		});
023768: 
023769: 		// Extra grote 7-blok vormen zijn upgrade-gated en zeldzaam.
023770: 		if (hasUpgrade('extraLargeBlocks')) {
023771: 			EXTRA_LARGE_7_SHAPES.forEach(card => {
023772: 				pool.push({
023773: 					name: card.name,
023774: 					category: 'large',
023775: 					weight: card.weight,
023776: 					matrix: card.matrix
023777: 				});
023778: 			});
023779: 		}
023780: 
023781: 		// XL 6-blok vormen zijn upgrade-gated.
023782: 		if (hasUpgrade('xlBlocks')) {
023783: 			XL_6_SHAPES.forEach(card => {
023784: 				pool.push({
023785: 					name: card.name,
023786: 					category: 'large',
023787: 					weight: card.weight,
023788: 					matrix: card.matrix
023789: 				});
023790: 			});
023791: 		}
023792: 		
023793: 		return pool;
023794: 	}

023799: 	function getRandomShapeEntry() {
023800: 	  const totalWeight = shapePool.reduce((sum, entry) => {
023801: 		const categoryWeight = SHAPE_CATEGORY_WEIGHTS[entry.category] ?? 1;
023802: 		return sum + entry.weight * categoryWeight;
023803: 	  }, 0);
023804: 	  let target = Math.random() * totalWeight;
023805: 	  for (const entry of shapePool) {
023806: 		const categoryWeight = SHAPE_CATEGORY_WEIGHTS[entry.category] ?? 1;
023807: 		const adjustedWeight = entry.weight * categoryWeight;
023808: 		if (target < adjustedWeight) return entry;
023809: 		target -= adjustedWeight;
023810: 	  }
023811: 	  return shapePool[shapePool.length - 1];
023812: 	}

024022: 	function world4Mulberry32(seed) {
024023: 		let t = (seed >>> 0) || 1;
024024: 		return function() {
024025: 			t += 0x6D2B79F5;
024026: 			let r = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), 1 | t);
024027: 			r ^= r + Math.imul(r ^ (r >>> 7), 61 | r);
024028: 			return ((r ^ (r >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
024029: 		};
024030: 	}
024031: 
024032: 	function shuffleWithRng(list, rng) {
024033: 		const arr = Array.isArray(list) ? list.slice() : [];
024034: 		for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
024035: 			const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
024036: 			[arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
024037: 		}
024038: 		return arr;
024039: 	}

024041: 	function getWorld4ActiveColorsForLevel(level) {
024042: 		const lvl = Math.max(1, Number(level) || 1);
024043: 		// World 4 is a designed campaign: use its explicit start palette when available.
024044: 		try {
024045: 			const cfg = window.LocusWorld4?.getLevelConfig?.(lvl);
024046: 			if (cfg && Array.isArray(cfg.startColors) && cfg.startColors.length) {
024047: 				return cfg.startColors.slice();
024048: 			}
024049: 		} catch (_) {}
024050: 		// Fallback keeps older/custom World 4 levels compatible.
024051: 		if (world4ActiveColorsByLevel.has(lvl)) {
024052: 			return world4ActiveColorsByLevel.get(lvl).slice();
024053: 		}
024054: 		const rng = world4Mulberry32(0xA5A5A5 ^ (lvl * 7919));
024055: 		const pick = shuffleWithRng(WORLD4_ALL_COLORS, rng).slice(0, 3);
024056: 		world4ActiveColorsByLevel.set(lvl, pick);
024057: 		return pick.slice();
024058: 	}

024111: 	function getWorld4ActiveZoneCompletionRatio() {
024112: 		const zones = getWorld4ActiveZoneIds();
024113: 		let totalCells = 0;
024114: 		let activeCells = 0;
024115: 		zones.forEach(id => {
024116: 			const zone = document.getElementById(id);
024117: 			if (!zone) return;
024118: 			const cells = zone.querySelectorAll('.cell:not(.void-cell)');
024119: 			const active = zone.querySelectorAll('.cell.active:not(.void-cell)');
024120: 			totalCells += cells.length;
024121: 			activeCells += active.length;
024122: 		});
024123: 		return totalCells > 0 ? (activeCells / totalCells) : 0;
024124: 	}

024126: 	// Helper functie om world en subLevel te bepalen
024127: 	function getWorldAndSubLevel(level) {
024128: 		const numericLevel = Number(level) || 0;
024129: 		if (numericLevel <= 0) return { world: 1, subLevel: 1, intro: true };
024130: 		if (numericLevel <= 10) return { world: 1, subLevel: numericLevel };
024131: 		if (numericLevel <= 20) return { world: 2, subLevel: numericLevel - 10 };
024132: 		if (numericLevel <= 30) return { world: 3, subLevel: numericLevel - 20 };
024133: 		return { world: Math.floor((numericLevel - 1) / 10) + 1, subLevel: ((numericLevel - 1) % 10) + 1 };
024134: 	}
024135: 
024136: 	function isAtLeastWorldAndSubLevel(targetWorld, targetSubLevel, level = currentLevel) {
024137: 		const info = getWorldAndSubLevel(Number(level) || 1);
024138: 		const world = Number(info?.world || 1);
024139: 		const subLevel = Number(info?.subLevel || 1);
024140: 		if (world > targetWorld) return true;
024141: 		if (world < targetWorld) return false;
024142: 		return subLevel >= targetSubLevel;
024143: 	}

024147: 		return isAtLeastWorldAndSubLevel(1, 7, level);
024148: 	}

024268: 	function instantiateBlueprint(blueprint) {
024269: 		const safeColor = cloneColor(blueprint.color);
024270: 		// Backward compatible: old saves might mark golden on the color object.
024271: 		// Golden is a card modifier, NOT a block color.
024272: 		const isGolden = !!(blueprint && (blueprint.isGolden || blueprint.color?.isGolden));
024273: 		if (isGolden) safeColor.isGolden = false;
024274: 		const isEchoUpgrade = !!(blueprint.isBonusEcho || blueprint.isBonusEchoUpgrade);
024275: 		return {
024276: 			id: nextCardInstanceId(),
024277: 			blueprintId: blueprint.blueprintId,
024278: 			shapeName: blueprint.shapeName,
024279: 			matrix: cloneShape(blueprint.matrix),
024280: 			category: blueprint.category,
024281: 			color: safeColor,
024282: 			isGolden,
024283: 			isBonusBoost: !!blueprint.isBonusBoost,
024284: 			isBonusEcho: isEchoUpgrade,
024285: 			bonusEchoVariant: blueprint.bonusEchoVariant || 'replay',
024286: 			bonusEchoReplaysAvailable: Number(blueprint.bonusEchoReplaysAvailable || 0),
024287: 			isBonusEchoUpgrade: !!blueprint.isBonusEchoUpgrade
024288: 		};
024289: 	}

024317: 	function buildStandardDeckBlueprint() {
024318: 	  const standardShapes = shapePool.filter(entry => entry.category === 'standard');
024319: 		  const desiredCount = 6;
024320: 	  
024321: 	  // Als shapePool leeg is of geen standard shapes heeft, rebuild de pool
024322: 	  if (standardShapes.length === 0) {
024323: 		console.warn('⚠️ No standard shapes in pool, rebuilding shapePool');
024324: 		shapePool = buildShapePool();
024325: 		const retryStandardShapes = shapePool.filter(entry => entry.category === 'standard');
024326: 		if (retryStandardShapes.length === 0) {
024327: 		  console.error('❌ Still no standard shapes after rebuild!');
024328: 		  // Fallback: gebruik alle shapes als laatste redmiddel
024329: 			  return shapePool.slice(0, desiredCount).map((entry, idx) => {
024330: 			const color = NON_WILDCARD_COLORS[idx % NON_WILDCARD_COLORS.length];
024331: 			return createCardBlueprint(entry, color);
024332: 		  });
024333: 		}
024334: 	  }
024335: 	  
024336: 	  const shuffled = shuffleArray([...standardShapes]);
024337: 		  const picks = shuffled.slice(0, desiredCount);
024338: 		  // If too few standard shapes are available, top up with other unlocked shapes.
024339: 		  if (picks.length < desiredCount) {
024340: 			const already = new Set(picks.map(p => `${p.name}|${JSON.stringify(p.matrix)}`));
024341: 			const pool = shuffleArray(shapePool.filter(entry => {
024342: 				const key = `${entry.name}|${JSON.stringify(entry.matrix)}`;
024343: 				return !already.has(key);
024344: 			}));
024345: 			for (const entry of pool) {
024346: 				if (picks.length >= desiredCount) break;
024347: 				picks.push(entry);
024348: 			}
024349: 		  }
024350: 	  const baseColors = [...NON_WILDCARD_COLORS];
024351: 	  let colorIndex = 0;
024352: 	  return picks.map(entry => {
024353: 		const color = baseColors[colorIndex % baseColors.length];
024354: 		colorIndex += 1;
024355: 		return createCardBlueprint(entry, color);
024356: 	  });
024357: 	}

024362: 		}

024367: 	function createGoldenCardBlueprint() {
024368: 		const shapeEntry = getRandomGoldenShape();
024369: 		const palette = [...NON_WILDCARD_COLORS];
024370: 		const baseColor = palette.length ? palette[goldenColorRotation % palette.length] : { name: 'multikleur', code: 'rainbow' };
024371: 		goldenColorRotation = palette.length ? (goldenColorRotation + 1) % palette.length : goldenColorRotation;
024372: 		// Golden card = golden frame; keep the block color the base color.
024373: 		return createCardBlueprint(shapeEntry, baseColor, { isGolden: true, category: 'golden' });
024374: 	}

024398: 
024399: // Return a coin count usable by objective checks/progress.
024400: // Priority: explicit `scores.coins` or `scores.coinsCollected` if provided,
024401: // then DOM `getSpendableCoinCount()`, then fallback to deriving from
024402: // bonus points (1 coin per 3 bonus points) if available.
024403: function getCollectedCoinCount(scores) {
024404: 	if (typeof coinsCollectedThisLevel === 'number') return coinsCollectedThisLevel;
024405: 	if (scores && typeof scores.coins === 'number') return scores.coins;
024406: 	if (scores && typeof scores.coinsCollected === 'number') return scores.coinsCollected;
024407: 	if (typeof getSpendableCoinCount === 'function') return getSpendableCoinCount();
024408: 	if (scores && typeof scores.bonusesCollected === 'number') return Math.floor(scores.bonusesCollected / 3);
024409: 	return 0;
024410: }

024438: 	function updateBuyPlacementButton() {
024439: 	  const btn = document.getElementById('buy-placement-btn');
024440: 	  const preview = document.getElementById('purchased-block-preview');
024441: 	  if (!btn) return;
024442: 	  
024443: 	  // Als er een gekochte plaatsing actief is, toon preview en verberg knop
024444: 	  if (window.hasPurchasedPlacement) {
024445: 		btn.style.display = 'none';
024446: 		if (preview) preview.style.display = 'flex';
024447: 		// Ensure preview cell matches zoomed cell size when zoomed

024449: 			if (document.body.classList.contains('zoomed-in')) {
024450: 				const cellSize = Math.round(getActualCellSize(typeof activeZoomZone !== 'undefined' && activeZoomZone ? activeZoomZone : null));
024451: 				const cellEl = preview.querySelector('.purchased-block-cell');
024452: 				if (cellEl && Number.isFinite(cellSize) && cellSize > 6) {
024453: 					cellEl.style.width = cellEl.style.height = `${cellSize}px`;
024454: 					cellEl.style.borderRadius = `${Math.max(2, Math.min(6, Math.round(cellSize / 6)))}px`;
024455: 				}
024456: 			} else {
024457: 				// restore default CSS sizing
024458: 				const cellEl = preview.querySelector('.purchased-block-cell');
024459: 				if (cellEl) {
024460: 					cellEl.style.removeProperty('width');
024461: 					cellEl.style.removeProperty('height');
024462: 					cellEl.style.removeProperty('border-radius');
024463: 				}
024464: 			}
024465: 		} catch (e) {}
024466: 		return;
024467: 	  }
024468: 	  
024469: 	  // Anders toon knop en verberg preview
024470: 	  btn.style.display = 'flex';
024471: 	  if (preview) preview.style.display = 'none';
024472: 	  
024473: 	  const coins = getSpendableCoinCount();
024474: 	  const cost = 2;
024475: 	  btn.disabled = coins < cost;
024476: 	  btn.title = coins < cost

024478: 		: 'Koop bonusblok (2 munten)';

024502: 	function onPurchasedBlockPreviewClick(event) {
024503: 	  if (!window.hasPurchasedPlacement) return;
024504: 	  const isMobileLayout = window.innerWidth <= MOBILE_BREAKPOINT;
024505: 	  const isTouchDevice = ('ontouchstart' in window || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0);
024506: 	  const isPointerDown = !!(event && typeof event.type === 'string' && event.type.indexOf('pointer') === 0);
024507: 	  const preferDirectDrag = !!(event && event.type === 'pointerdown' && event.pointerType === 'mouse');
024508: 	  
024509: 	  // Als er al een purchased placement drag actief is, doe niets (voorkom toggle)
024510: 	  if (activeBonusPlacement && activeBonusPlacement.colorKey === 'purchased') {
024511: 		return;
024512: 	  }
024513: 	  
024514: 	  // Cancel eventuele actieve bonus plaatsing
024515: 	  cancelActiveBonusPlacement({ updateInventory: false });
024516: 	  
024517: 	  // Maak een 1x1 multikleur blok en start het slepen
024518: 	  const shape = [[1]];
024519: 	  const colorObj = { name: 'multikleur', code: 'rainbow' };
024520: 	  
024521: 	  // Stel de geselecteerde vorm in
024522: 	  selectedShape = shape;
024523: 	  selectedColor = colorObj;
024524: 	  
024525: 	  const previewEl = document.getElementById('purchased-block-preview');
024526: 	  // Touch devices and mobile: always use direct drag (no hover mode)
024527: 	  // Desktop mouse can also use direct drag for purchased blocks (simpler UX)
024528: 	  // Skip hover-follow mode for purchased placement entirely.
024529: 
024530: 	  if (!isMobileLayout && !isTouchDevice) {
024531: 		activeBonusPlacement = {
024532: 			colorKey: 'purchased',
024533: 			pointerId: null,
024534: 			sticky: false,
024535: 			shape: cloneShape(shape),
024536: 			purchasedPlacement: true,
024537: 			desktopHover: true
024538: 		};
024539: 		lastZone = null;
024540: 		lastBaseX = null;
024541: 		lastBaseY = null;
024542: 		startDesktopHoverDragFromSelection(previewEl || document.getElementById('purchased-block-preview'), shape, colorObj);
024543: 		return;
024544: 	  }
024545: 
024546: 	  // Touch: direct drag behavior - blok volgt de vinger
024547: 	  const block = makeDraggable(shape, colorObj);
024548: 	  block.classList.add('bonus-draggable', 'purchased-placement');
024549: 	  const overlay = document.getElementById('drag-overlay');
024550: 	  if (overlay && !overlay.contains(block)) overlay.appendChild(block);
024551: 	  if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'block';
024552: 	  
024553: 	  draggedBlock = block;
024554: 	resetDragBlockGap();
024555: 	  draggedShape = block._shape || shape;
024556: 	  draggedColor = colorObj;
024557: 	  
024558: 	  // Start de pointer drag tracking
024559: 	  beginPointerDrag({ clientX: event.clientX, clientY: event.clientY, pointerId: event.pointerId || null });
024560: 	  
024561: 	  // Positioneer het blok bij de pointer positie (met touch offset)
024562: 	  const startX = event.clientX || window.innerWidth / 2;
024563: 	  const startY = event.clientY || window.innerHeight / 2;
024564: 	  const touchOffsetY = getFingerLiftOffsetY(event);
024565: 	{
024566: 		const m = getDragBlockCellMetrics(draggedBlock);
024567: 		({ offsetX, offsetY } = computeShapeCenterOffsets(draggedShape, m));
024568: 		setElPos(draggedBlock, startX - offsetX, startY - offsetY - touchOffsetY);
024569: 	}
024570: 
024571: 	// Ensure the purchased draggable immediately measures zoomed cell size
024572: 	// (in case zoom/lift just occurred). Re-render on next frame.
024573: 	requestAnimationFrame(() => {
024574: 		try {
024575: 			renderBlock(block, block._shape || shape, colorObj);
024576: 			const mAfter = getDragBlockCellMetrics(block);

025126: 	function buildRewardChoices({ count = 3, filterFn = null, color = null, colorsPalette = null, blueprintOptions = null } = {}) {
025127: 		const fallbackColor = color || { name: 'grijs', code: '#a0a0a0' };
025128: 		const palette = Array.isArray(colorsPalette) && colorsPalette.length ? colorsPalette : null;
025129: 		const candidates = shapePool.filter(e => {
025130: 			if (!e || !e.matrix) return false;
025131: 			if (typeof filterFn === 'function' && !filterFn(e)) return false;
025132: 			return true;
025133: 		});
025134: 		const pool = candidates.length ? shuffleArray([...candidates]) : shuffleArray([...shapePool]);
025135: 		const picks = pool.slice(0, Math.max(1, count));
025136: 		return picks.map(entry => {
025137: 			const chosenColor = palette ? cloneColor(palette[Math.floor(Math.random() * palette.length)]) : fallbackColor;
025138: 			const extras = blueprintOptions ? { ...blueprintOptions } : undefined;
025139: 			if (extras && extras.isBonusEcho && !extras.bonusEchoVariant) {
025140: 				extras.bonusEchoVariant = pickBonusEchoVariant();
025141: 			}
025142: 			const blueprint = createCardBlueprint(entry, chosenColor, extras || undefined);
025143: 			return { blueprint, card: instantiateBlueprint(blueprint) };
025144: 		});
025145: 	}

025209: 	function buildFixedShapeRewardChoices(shapes, count = 3) {
025210: 		const list = Array.isArray(shapes) ? shapes.filter(s => s && s.matrix) : [];
025211: 		if (!list.length) return buildRewardChoices({ count });
025212: 		const palette = NON_WILDCARD_COLORS.length ? NON_WILDCARD_COLORS : colors;
025213: 		const pool = shuffleArray(list.map(entry => ({
025214: 			name: entry.name,
025215: 			matrix: cloneShape(entry.matrix),
025216: 			category: 'large'
025217: 		})));
025218: 		const picks = [];
025219: 		while (pool.length && picks.length < count) picks.push(pool.shift());
025220: 		while (picks.length < count) {
025221: 			picks.push(list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)]);
025222: 		}
025223: 		return picks.map(entry => {
025224: 			const baseColor = palette[Math.floor(Math.random() * palette.length)] || { name: 'grijs', code: '#a0a0a0' };
025225: 			const color = cloneColor(baseColor);
025226: 			const blueprint = createCardBlueprint(entry, color);
025227: 			return { blueprint, card: instantiateBlueprint(blueprint) };
025228: 		});
025229: 	}

025248: 	function startMini34RewardSequence() {
025249: 		const steps = 3;
025250: 		let step = 1;
025251: 		const colorPalette = NON_WILDCARD_COLORS.length ? NON_WILDCARD_COLORS : colors;
025252: 		const pickColor = () => {
025253: 			const base = colorPalette[Math.floor(Math.random() * colorPalette.length)] || { name: 'grijs', code: '#a0a0a0' };
025254: 			return cloneColor(base);
025255: 		};
025256: 		const filterMini34 = (e) => {
025257: 			if (!e || !e.matrix) return false;
025258: 			const blocks = (typeof countShapeBlocks === 'function') ? countShapeBlocks(e.matrix) : null;
025259: 			if (!Number.isFinite(blocks)) return (e.category === 'mini' || e.category === 'standard');
025260: 			return blocks <= 3;
025261: 		};
025262: 		const showStep = () => {
025263: 			const choices = buildRewardChoices({
025264: 				count: 3,
025265: 				filterFn: filterMini34,
025266: 				colorsPalette: colorPalette
025267: 			});
025268: 			showRewardPickerModal({
025269: 				titleText: `🧩 Kies je mini-kaart (${step}/${steps})`,
025270: 				subtextHtml: 'Je koopt een <strong>mini pakket</strong> (max. 3 blokjes). Kies 3 kaarten (telkens 1 uit 3).',
025271: 				choices,
025272: 				onPick: ({ blueprint, card }) => {
025273: 					grantPickedBlueprintReward({ blueprint, card });
025274: 					step += 1;
025275: 					if (step > steps) {
025276: 						closeGoldenUnlockModal();
025277: 						restoreGoldenUnlockModalCopy();
025278: 						return;
025279: 					}
025280: 					setTimeout(showStep, 60);
025281: 				}
025282: 			});
025283: 		};
025284: 		showStep();
025285: 	}

025400: 	function generateBlackHoleCards(count = BLACK_HOLE_CARD_COUNT) {
025401: 	  const cards = [];
025402: 	  const randInt = (min, max) => (min + Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)));
025403: 	  // 1 Black Hole
025404: 	  cards.push({ type: 'blackhole', value: 0, label: '⚫' });
025405: 	  
025406: 	  // 2 Multipliers
025407: 	  cards.push({ type: 'multiplier', value: 2, label: 'x2' });
025408: 	  cards.push({ type: 'multiplier', value: 2, label: 'x2' });
025409: 	  
025410: 	  // Remaining are small rewards: mostly 1-10 points, sometimes 1-3 coins.
025411: 	  const remaining = count - 3;
025412: 	  for (let i = 0; i < remaining; i++) {
025413: 		const roll = Math.random();
025414: 		if (roll < 0.18) {
025415: 			const coins = Math.random() < 0.65 ? 1 : (Math.random() < 0.85 ? 2 : 3);
025416: 			cards.push({ type: 'coins', value: coins, label: `<span class="coin-symbol">🪙</span>+${coins}` });
025417: 		} else {
025418: 			const points = randInt(1, 10);
025419: 			cards.push({ type: 'points', value: points, label: `+${points}` });
025420: 		}
025421: 	  }
025422: 	  
025423: 	  return shuffleArray(cards);
025424: 	}

025485: 	function getBlackHoleStakeMultiplier(stake) {
025486: 		const s = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, Number(stake) || 0));
025487: 		// Map 0..10 stake -> 1..5 multiplier (0 means no stake).
025488: 		// 0-2 => x1, 3-4 => x2, 5-6 => x3, 7-8 => x4, 9-10 => x5
025489: 		if (s <= 2) return 1;
025490: 		return 1 + Math.floor((s - 1) / 2);
025491: 	}

025495: 		const mult = getBlackHoleStakeMultiplier(stake);
025496: 		if (blackHoleStakeInput) blackHoleStakeInput.value = String(stake);
025497: 		if (blackHoleStakeValueEl) blackHoleStakeValueEl.textContent = String(stake);
025498: 		if (blackHoleStakeMultEl) blackHoleStakeMultEl.textContent = String(mult);
025499: 	}

025517: 			? 'Game Over'

025532: 	function handleBlackHoleCardClick(index) {
025533: 	  if (blackHoleState.gameOver) return;
025534: 	  if (typeof index !== 'number' || !blackHoleState.cards[index]) return;
025535: 	  if (blackHoleState.selected.has(index)) return;
025536: 
025537: 	  const cardData = blackHoleState.cards[index];
025538: 	  blackHoleState.selected.add(index);
025539: 	  
025540: 	  const cardEl = blackHoleCardGrid.children[index];
025541: 	  if (cardEl) revealCardVisuals(cardEl, cardData);
025542: 	  const triggerBlackHoleEffect = (effect) => {
025543: 		if (!blackHoleModal || !effect) return;
025544: 		blackHoleModal.classList.remove('effect-pulse', 'effect-spark', 'effect-shake');
025545: 		void blackHoleModal.offsetWidth;
025546: 		blackHoleModal.classList.add(effect);
025547: 		setTimeout(() => {
025548: 			try { blackHoleModal.classList.remove(effect); } catch (_) {}
025549: 		}, 700);
025550: 	  };
025551: 
025552: 	  if (cardData.type === 'blackhole') {
025553: 		blackHoleState.reward = 0;
025554: 		blackHoleState.coins = 0;
025555: 		blackHoleState.gameOver = true;
025556: 		const penalty = Math.min(getSpendableCoinCount(), TRAP_PENALTY || 5);
025557: 		for (let i = 0; i < penalty; i++) removeCoin();
025558: 		showBlackHoleFeedback(penalty > 0 ? `⚫ ZWART GAT! -${penalty}🪙` : '⚫ ZWART GAT!', 'warn');
025559: 		triggerBlackHoleEffect('effect-shake');
025560: 		
025561: 		// Reveal all
025562: 		blackHoleState.cards.forEach((c, i) => {
025563: 			if (!blackHoleState.selected.has(i)) {
025564: 				const el = blackHoleCardGrid.children[i];
025565: 				if (el) revealCardVisuals(el, c);
025566: 			}
025567: 		});
025568: 		
025569: 		const forfeitBtn = document.getElementById('blackhole-forfeit-btn');
025570: 		if (forfeitBtn) forfeitBtn.textContent = 'Sluiten';
025571: 		
025572: 	  } else if (cardData.type === 'multiplier') {
025573: 		blackHoleState.reward *= cardData.value;
025574: 		showBlackHoleFeedback(`Bonus x${cardData.value}!`, 'info');
025575: 		triggerBlackHoleEffect('effect-spark');
025576: 	  } else if (cardData.type === 'coins') {
025577: 		blackHoleState.coins = (blackHoleState.coins || 0) + (Number(cardData.value) || 0);
025578: 		showBlackHoleFeedback(`+${cardData.value}🪙`, 'info');
025579: 		triggerBlackHoleEffect('effect-pulse');
025580: 	  } else {
025581: 		blackHoleState.reward += cardData.value;
025582: 		showBlackHoleFeedback(`+${cardData.value} punten`, 'info');
025583: 		triggerBlackHoleEffect('effect-pulse');
025584: 	  }
025585: 
025586: 	  updateBlackHoleSelectionUI();
025587: 	}

025634: 	function claimBlackHoleReward() {
025635: 	  const baseReward = Math.max(0, blackHoleState.reward || 0);
025636: 	  const coinsReward = Math.max(0, blackHoleState.coins || 0);
025637: 	  const stake = Math.max(0, Number(blackHoleState.stake) || 0);
025638: 	  const mult = getBlackHoleStakeMultiplier(stake);
025639: 	  const reward = baseReward * mult;
025640: 	  const trapRecord = blackHoleState.trap;
025641: 	  if ((baseReward <= 0 && coinsReward <= 0) || !trapRecord) {
025642: 		showBlackHoleFeedback('Selecteer eerst kaarten', 'warn');
025643: 		return;
025644: 	  }
025645: 	  if (stake > 0) {
025646: 		const coinsAvailable = getSpendableCoinCount();
025647: 		if (coinsAvailable < stake) {
025648: 			showBlackHoleFeedback('Niet genoeg munten voor deze inzet.', 'warn');
025649: 			return;
025650: 		}
025651: 		if (!spendCoins(stake)) {
025652: 			showBlackHoleFeedback('Inzet kon niet worden afgeschreven.', 'warn');
025653: 			return;
025654: 		}
025655: 	  }
025656: 	  if (reward > 0) {
025657: 			const zoneId = trapRecord?.zoneId || trapRecord?.cell?.dataset?.zoneId || '';
025658: 			const colorKey = getTrapColorKey(zoneId);
025659: 			if (colorKey && colorKey !== 'other') {
025660: 				colorScoreBonuses[colorKey] = Number(colorScoreBonuses[colorKey] || 0) + reward;
025661: 			} else {
025662: 				// Fallback: add to any available color bonus bucket
025663: 				colorScoreBonuses.yellow = Number(colorScoreBonuses.yellow || 0) + reward;
025664: 			}
025665: 	  }
025666: 	  if (coinsReward > 0) {
025667: 		for (let i = 0; i < coinsReward; i++) addCoin();
025668: 	  }
025669: 	  const stakeLabel = stake > 0 ? ` (inzet ${stake}🪙 ×${mult})` : '';
025670: 	  showObjectiveToast(coinsReward > 0 ? `🌀 Bonus +${reward} en +${coinsReward}🪙!${stakeLabel}` : `🌀 Bonus +${reward}!${stakeLabel}`);
025671: 	  closeBlackHoleModal();
025672: 	  updateScore();
025673: 	  try { if (lastBlackHoleAutosave) saveGameState(); } catch (_) {}
025674: 	}
025675: 
025676: 	function forfeitBlackHoleChallenge() {
025677: 	  if (!blackHoleState.gameOver) {
025678: 		const penalty = Math.min(getSpendableCoinCount(), TRAP_PENALTY || 5);
025679: 		for (let i = 0; i < penalty; i++) removeCoin();
025680: 		if (penalty > 0) showObjectiveToast(`🌀 Gestopt: -${penalty}🪙`);
025681: 	  }
025682: 	  closeBlackHoleModal();
025683: 	  updateScore();
025684: 	  try { if (lastBlackHoleAutosave) saveGameState(); } catch (_) {}
025685: 	}

025753: 	function countShapeBlocks(matrix) {
025754: 	  return matrix.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.reduce((acc, val) => acc + (val ? 1 : 0), 0), 0);
025755: 	}
025756: 
025757: 	function calculateCardCost(cardData) {
025758: 	  const blocks = countShapeBlocks(cardData.matrix);
025759: 	  // Tier-based prijzen per blokgrootte
025760: 	  let baseCost = 2; // 1-3 blocks
025761: 	  if (blocks === 4) baseCost = 4;
025762: 	  else if (blocks === 5) baseCost = 6;
025763: 	  else if (blocks === 6) baseCost = 8;
025764: 	  else if (blocks >= 7) baseCost = 10;
025765: 	  // Golden modifier +2
025766: 	  const isGolden = !!(cardData.isGolden || cardData.color?.isGolden);
025767: 	  if (isGolden) baseCost += 2;
025768: 	  // Bonus Boost modifier
025769: 	  if (cardData && cardData.isBonusBoost) {
025770: 		const extra = (typeof BONUS_BOOST_CARD_COST_BONUS === 'number') ? BONUS_BOOST_CARD_COST_BONUS : 4;
025771: 		baseCost += extra;
025772: 	  }
025773: 	  if (cardData && cardData.isBonusEcho) {
025774: 		const extra = (typeof BONUS_ECHO_CARD_COST_BONUS === 'number') ? BONUS_ECHO_CARD_COST_BONUS : 4;
025775: 		baseCost += extra;
025776: 	  }
025777: 	  // Multikleur modifier +2
025778: 	  if (cardData.color && cardData.color.name === 'multikleur') baseCost += 2;
025779: 	  return baseCost;
025780: 	}

025782: 	function createRandomShopCardWithRarity() {
025783: 		// Random card odds tuning:
025784: 		// - 20% kans op grotere vorm (large)
025785: 		// - Multikleur: 5% basis, 20% met multikleur unlock, 50% met multikleur boost
025786: 		// - Goud: 3% basis, 15% met gouden unlock
025787: 		// - Extra large vormen komen mee in de “large” kans als de upgrade er is
025788: 		const hasWildcardUnlock = hasUpgrade('wildcardCards');
025789: 		const hasWildcardBoost = hasUpgrade('multicolorBoost');
025790: 		const hasGoldUnlock = hasUpgrade('goldenCards');
025791: 		const hasExtraLarge = hasUpgrade('extraLargeBlocks');
025792: 
025793: 		const pickRandom = (list) => (Array.isArray(list) && list.length)
025794: 			? list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)]
025795: 			: null;
025796: 
025797: 		const largePool = shapePool.filter(e => e && e.category === 'large');
025798: 		const basePool = shapePool.filter(e => e && e.category !== 'large');
025799: 		const largeRoll = Math.random();
025800: 		const wantLarge = largeRoll < 0.20;
025801: 		let entry = null;
025802: 		if (wantLarge && largePool.length) {
025803: 			// Mix in extra-large shapes (7+ blokjes) when unlocked.
025804: 			const xlPool = (hasExtraLarge && Array.isArray(EXTRA_LARGE_7_SHAPES)) ? EXTRA_LARGE_7_SHAPES : [];
025805: 			const useXL = xlPool.length && Math.random() < 0.25; // subset of large rolls become XL
025806: 			if (useXL) {
025807: 				const pick = pickRandom(xlPool);
025808: 				entry = pick ? { name: pick.name, matrix: pick.matrix, category: 'large' } : null;
025809: 			}
025810: 			if (!entry) entry = pickRandom(largePool) || getRandomShapeEntry();
025811: 		} else {
025812: 			entry = pickRandom(basePool) || getRandomShapeEntry();
025813: 		}
025814: 
025815: 		const palette = NON_WILDCARD_COLORS.length ? NON_WILDCARD_COLORS : colors;
025816: 		const multicolorChance = hasWildcardBoost ? 0.50 : hasWildcardUnlock ? 0.20 : 0.07;
025817: 		const goldenChance = hasGoldUnlock ? 0.20 : 0.07;
025818: 		const isMulticolor = Math.random() < multicolorChance;
025819: 		const isGolden = Math.random() < goldenChance;
025820: 		const baseColor = isMulticolor
025821: 			? { name: 'multikleur', code: 'rainbow' }
025822: 			: palette[Math.floor(Math.random() * palette.length)];
025823: 		const color = cloneColor(baseColor);
025824: 		return instantiateBlueprint(createCardBlueprint(entry, color, { isGolden }));
025825: 	}

025831: 		const entry = candidates.length
025832: 			? candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)]
025833: 			: getRandomShapeEntry();
025834: 		const palette = NON_WILDCARD_COLORS.length ? NON_WILDCARD_COLORS : colors;
025835: 		const baseColor = palette[Math.floor(Math.random() * palette.length)];
025836: 		const color = cloneColor(baseColor);
025837: 		return instantiateBlueprint(createCardBlueprint(entry, color, { isGolden: true }));
025838: 	}

025895: 	function createShopCard(choice, isRandomCard = false) {
025896: 		if (isRandomCard) {
025897: 			return createRandomShopCardWithRarity();
025898: 		}
025899: 		const entry = choice ?? getRandomShapeEntry();
025900: 		// Multikleur kaarten: beschikbaar vanaf level 1.7
025901: 		// Multicolor boost upgrade verdubbelt de kans (van 0.35 naar 0.70)
025902: 		const baseWildcardChance = 0.35;
025903: 		const wildcardChance = hasUpgrade('multicolorBoost') ? baseWildcardChance * 2 : baseWildcardChance;
025904: 		const allowWildcard = isSpecialModifiersUnlocked() && hasUpgrade('multicolorBoost') && Math.random() < wildcardChance;
025905: 		const palette = allowWildcard ? colors : NON_WILDCARD_COLORS;
025906: 		const color = cloneColor(palette[Math.floor(Math.random() * palette.length)]);
025907: 		const allowModifiers = isSpecialModifiersUnlocked();
025908: 		// Gouden kaarten alleen als je de upgrade hebt
025909: 		const isGolden = allowModifiers && hasUpgrade('goldenCards') && color.name !== 'multikleur' && Math.random() < 0.05;
025910: 		return instantiateBlueprint(createCardBlueprint(entry, color, { isGolden }));
025911: 	}

025913: 	function getPremiumShapeEntry() {
025914: 		const largeShapes = shapePool.filter(entry => entry.category === 'large');
025915: 		const candidates = largeShapes.filter(entry => countShapeBlocks(entry.matrix) >= 6);
025916: 		const pool = candidates.length ? candidates : largeShapes;
025917: 		if (!pool.length) return getRandomShapeEntry();
025918: 		return pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
025919: 	}

025970: 	function setCardSelectionLock(lock, activeCardEl = null, options = {}) {
025971: 		const { allowGolden = false, allowNormal = false, allowedCardIds = null } = options;
025972: 		cardSelectionLocked = !!lock;
025973: 		const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#card-choice-zone .card-option');
025974: 		cards.forEach(card => {
025975: 			const isActive = card === activeCardEl;
025976: 			const isGoldenCard = card.dataset.golden === 'true';
025977: 			const cardId = card.dataset.cardId;
025978: 			
025979: 			// Disable als: locked en niet actief en (niet toegestaan OF niet plaatsbaar)
025980: 			const isAllowedId = Array.isArray(allowedCardIds) && allowedCardIds.includes(cardId);
025981: 			const lockedOut = cardSelectionLocked && !isActive && !isAllowedId && !(
025982: 				(allowGolden && isGoldenCard) || (allowNormal && !isGoldenCard)
025983: 			);
025984: 			// PERFORMANCE:
025985: 			// Do not call `isCardPlayable()` here. That function performs expensive full-board scans
025986: 			// (especially for multikleur), and this lock runs after each placement.
025987: 			const disable = lockedOut;
025988: 			
025989: 			card.classList.toggle('selection-disabled', disable);
025990: 			if (disable) {
025991: 				card.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
025992: 			} else {
025993: 				card.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
025994: 			}
025995: 		});
025996: 	}

026613: 	  if (!newCardsButton) return;

026638: 			newCardsButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Bonusbeurt');

026642: 		newCardsButton.classList.add('complete-round');
026643: 		newCardsButton.classList.remove('ready-for-next-turn');
026644: 		// Never block progression; warnings are handled on click.
026645: 		newCardsButton.disabled = false;
026646: 		newCardsButton.setAttribute('data-label', 'Einde beurt');
026647: 		newCardsButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Einde beurt');

026657: 	  // Once the player has played at least one card this turn, this button should be enabled anyway.
026658: 	  const hasUsableBonuses = getRemainingBonusCharges() > 0;
026659: 	  if (cardsPlayedThisTurn > 0) {

026668: 	  // Never disable the button; if the player skips with playable cards, the click handler shows a warning.

026672: 	function cloneCardForExtraTurn(card) {
026673: 		if (!card) return null;
026674: 		return {
026675: 			id: nextCardInstanceId(),
026676: 			blueprintId: card.blueprintId,
026677: 			shapeName: card.shapeName,
026678: 			matrix: cloneShape(card.matrix),
026679: 			category: card.category,
026680: 			color: cloneColor(card.color),
026681: 			isGolden: !!(card.isGolden || card.color?.isGolden),
026682: 			isBonusBoost: !!card.isBonusBoost,
026683: 			isBonusEcho: !!card.isBonusEcho,
026684: 			bonusEchoVariant: card.bonusEchoVariant || 'replay',
026685: 			bonusEchoReplaysAvailable: 0
026686: 		};
026687: 	}

026689: 	function prepareBonusEchoExtraTurnDeck() {
026690: 		if (!(bonusEchoExtraTurns > 0)) return false;
026691: 		const source = Array.isArray(discardPile) ? discardPile.slice() : [];
026692: 		if (!source.length) return false;
026693: 		const clones = source.map(cloneCardForExtraTurn).filter(Boolean);
026694: 		if (!clones.length) return false;
026695: 		drawPile = shuffleArray(clones);
026696: 		discardPile = [];
026697: 		currentHand = [];
026698: 		bonusEchoExtraTurns = Math.max(0, bonusEchoExtraTurns - 1);
026699: 		bonusEchoFreePlays = 0;
026700: 		bonusEchoStreak = 0;
026701: 		lastCardWasBonusEcho = false;
026702: 		lastBonusEchoVariant = null;
026703: 		cardPlacementHistory = [];
026704: 		cardsPlayedThisTurn = 0;
026705: 		resetTurnCardFlags();
026706: 		updateUndoButton();
026707: 		showObjectiveToast('🔁 Bonusbeurt! Je gespeelde kaarten keren terug voor een extra ronde.');
026708: 		updateDeckPreview();
026709: 		return true;
026710: 	}

026719: 			matrix: cloneShape(sourceCard.matrix),
026720: 			category: sourceCard.category,
026721: 			color,
026722: 			isGolden: !!(sourceCard.isGolden || sourceCard.color?.isGolden),
026723: 			isBonusBoost: !!sourceCard.isBonusBoost,
026724: 			isBonusEcho: !!sourceCard.isBonusEcho,

026726: 			generatedByUpgrade: originTag || null
026727: 		};

026730: 	function finalizeHandDraw(baseHand) {
026731: 		const newHand = (Array.isArray(baseHand) ? baseHand.slice() : []);
026732: 
026733: 		// extraHandSize: maak een kopie van een random kaart uit het deck (blijft in deck)
026734: 		if (hasUpgrade('extraHandSize') && drawPile.length > 0) {
026735: 			const copyIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * drawPile.length);
026736: 			const copySource = drawPile[copyIndex];
026737: 			const extraCopy = createUpgradeCopy(copySource, 'extraHandSize');
026738: 			if (extraCopy) {
026739: 				extraCopy.isDeckCopy = true; // Markeer als kopie
026740: 				newHand.push(extraCopy);
026741: 			}
026742: 		}
026743: 
026744: 		if (hasUpgrade('luckyDraw') && drawPile.length > 0 && Math.random() < LUCKY_DRAW_COPY_CHANCE) {
026745: 			const luckyIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * drawPile.length);
026746: 			const luckySource = drawPile[luckyIndex];
026747: 			const luckyCopy = createUpgradeCopy(luckySource, 'luckyDraw');
026748: 			if (luckyCopy) {
026749: 				luckyCopy.isLuckyCopy = true;
026750: 				newHand.push(luckyCopy);
026751: 			}
026752: 		}
026753: 		currentHand = newHand;
026754: 		turnCount += 1;
026755: 		bonusUseHintShown = false;
026756: 		updateTurnCounterDisplay();
026757: 		renderCurrentHand();
026758: 	}

026760: 	function drawNextHand() {
026761: 	  if (drawPile.length === 0) {
026762: 		if (prepareBonusEchoExtraTurnDeck()) {
026763: 			// Deck is refilled for the extra turn; continue with draw.
026764: 		} else {
026765: 		updateDrawButtonState();
026766: 		return;
026767: 		}
026768: 	  }
026769: 	  cardPlacementHistory = [];
026770: 	  cardsPlayedThisTurn = 0;
026771: 	resetTurnCardFlags();
026772: 	updateUndoButton();
026773: 	bonusEchoFreePlays = 0;
026774: 	  
026775: 	  const BASE_HAND_DRAW = 3;
026776: 	  const drawCount = Math.min(BASE_HAND_DRAW, drawPile.length);
026777: 
026778: 	  const newHand = [];
026779: 	  for (let i = 0; i < drawCount; i++) {
026780: 		newHand.push(drawPile.shift());
026781: 	  }
026782: 	  finalizeHandDraw(newHand);
026783: 	  try {
026784: 		if (!isLoadingGame && window.LocusWorld4?.isWorld4?.()) saveGameState();
026785: 	  } catch (_) {}
026786: 	}

026788: 	function consumeCard(cardId) {
026789: 	  if (!cardId) return null;
026790: 	  const idx = currentHand.findIndex(card => card.id === cardId);
026791: 	  if (idx === -1) return null;
026792: 	  const [played] = currentHand.splice(idx, 1);
026793: 	  // Kopie-kaarten (van extraHandSize of luckyDraw) gaan niet naar discard pile
026794: 	  if (!played.isDeckCopy && !played.isLuckyCopy && !played.isBonusEchoReplayCopy) {
026795: 		discardPile.push(played);
026796: 	  }
026797: 	  selectedCardId = null;
026798: 	  selectedCardElement = null;
026799: 	  selectedShape = null;
026800: 	  selectedColor = null;
026801: 	  if (rotateButton) rotateButton.disabled = true;
026802: 	  // Don't call renderCurrentHand here - let finalizeCardPlacement do it after updating state
026803: 	  return {
026804: 		playedCard: played,
026805: 		handIndex: idx
026806: 	  };
026807: 	}

026809: 	function triggerBonusEchoGoalEffect(placementResult, text = '') {
026810: 		try {
026811: 			const cells = Array.isArray(placementResult?.cells) ? placementResult.cells.filter(Boolean) : [];
026812: 			const anchor = cells.length ? cells[0] : null;
026813: 			let x = window.innerWidth / 2;
026814: 			let y = window.innerHeight / 2;
026815: 			if (anchor && typeof anchor.getBoundingClientRect === 'function') {
026816: 				const rect = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
026817: 				x = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
026818: 				y = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
026819: 			}
026820: 			sparkleEffect(x, y, 10);
026821: 			if (text) {
026822: 				showScoreAnimation(x, y - 10, text, '#f7e58f');
026823: 			}
026824: 		} catch (_) {}
026825: 	}
