026827: 	function applyBonusEchoOutcome(playedCard, placementResult, options = {}) {
026828: 		const wasReplayPlay = !!options.wasReplayPlay;
026829: 		if (!playedCard || !playedCard.isBonusEcho || playedCard.isBonusEchoReplayCopy) {
026830: 			bonusEchoStreak = 0;
026831: 			lastCardWasBonusEcho = false;
026832: 			lastBonusEchoVariant = null;
026833: 			return { replayGranted: false, pointsAwarded: 0, extraTurnGranted: false, colorKey: null, variant: null, bonusRewards: [] };
026834: 		}
026835: 		const variant = playedCard.bonusEchoVariant || 'replay';
026836: 		const bonusClaims = Array.isArray(placementResult?.bonuses) ? placementResult.bonuses.filter(Boolean) : [];
026837: 		const colorKey = getBonusKeyFromColorName(playedCard?.color?.name);
026838: 		const meetsBonusRequirement = bonusClaims.length >= BONUS_ECHO_REQUIRED_BONUSES;
026839: 		const coinsClaimed = Array.isArray(placementResult?.cells)
026840: 			? placementResult.cells.filter(cell => cell && cell.classList && cell.classList.contains('gold-cell')).length
026841: 			: 0;
026842: 		const meetsCoinRequirement = coinsClaimed >= 2;
026843: 		const scoreDelta = Number(placementResult?.scoreDelta || 0) || 0;
026844: 		const scoredPoints = scoreDelta > 0;
026845: 		let pointsAwarded = 0;
026846: 		let extraTurnGranted = false;
026847: 		let replayGranted = false;
026848: 		const bonusRewards = [];
026849: 		switch (variant) {
026850: 			case 'points':
026851: 				if (meetsCoinRequirement) {
026852: 					pointsAwarded = colorKey ? BONUS_ECHO_SCORE_BONUS : 0;
026853: 					if (pointsAwarded > 0 && colorKey) {
026854: 						colorScoreBonuses[colorKey] = Number(colorScoreBonuses[colorKey] || 0) + pointsAwarded;
026855: 						triggerBonusEchoGoalEffect(placementResult, `+${pointsAwarded}`);
026856: 					}
026857: 				}
026858: 				break;
026859: 			case 'bonus': {
026860: 				if (scoredPoints) {
026861: 					for (let i = 0; i < BONUS_ECHO_BONUS_REWARD; i += 1) {
026862: 						const key = BONUS_ORDER[Math.floor(Math.random() * BONUS_ORDER.length)];
026863: 						if (key && BONUS_COLOR_CONFIG[key]) bonusRewards.push(key);
026864: 					}
026865: 					if (bonusRewards.length) triggerBonusEchoGoalEffect(placementResult, `+${BONUS_ECHO_BONUS_REWARD}`);
026866: 				}
026867: 				break;
026868: 			}
026869: 			case 'replay':
026870: 				if (meetsBonusRequirement && !wasReplayPlay && Number(playedCard.bonusEchoReplaysAvailable || 0) <= 0) {
026871: 					replayGranted = true;
026872: 					triggerBonusEchoGoalEffect(placementResult, '↻');
026873: 				}
026874: 				break;
026875: 			default:
026876: 				break;
026877: 		}
026878: 			const label = (BONUS_COLOR_CONFIG[colorKey]?.label) || playedCard?.color?.name || '';
026879: 			if (pointsAwarded > 0) {
026880: 				showObjectiveToast(`🔁 Bonus: +${pointsAwarded} ${label}`);
026881: 			} else if (bonusRewards.length > 0) {
026882: 				showObjectiveToast(`🔁 Bonus: +${bonusRewards.length} bonussen`);
026883: 			}
026884: 		bonusEchoStreak = 0;
026885: 		lastCardWasBonusEcho = false;
026886: 		lastBonusEchoVariant = null;
026887: 		return { replayGranted, pointsAwarded, extraTurnGranted, colorKey, variant, bonusRewards };
026888: 	}

026896: 	function discardCurrentHand() {
026897: 	  if (currentHand.length === 0) return;
026898: 	  // Filter kopie-kaarten uit voordat ze naar discard gaan
026899: 	  currentHand.forEach(card => {
026900: 		if (!card.isDeckCopy && !card.isLuckyCopy && !card.isBonusEchoReplayCopy) {
026901: 			discardPile.push(card);
026902: 		}
026903: 	  });
026904: 	  currentHand = [];
026905: 	  cardPlacementHistory = [];
026906: 	cardsPlayedThisTurn = 0;
026907: 	resetTurnCardFlags();
026908: 	updateUndoButton();
026909: 	  selectedCardId = null;
026910: 	  selectedCardElement = null;
026911: 	  selectedShape = null;

026917: 	function finalizeCardPlacement(placementResult, coinSnapshotBefore) {
026918: 	  if (!selectedCardId || !placementResult) return;
026919: 	  const consumed = consumeCard(selectedCardId);
026920: 	  if (!consumed) return;
026921: 	cardsPlayedThisTurn += 1;
026922: 	const { playedCard, handIndex } = consumed;
026923: 	if (!playedCard?.isBonusEcho) {
026924: 		bonusEchoStreak = 0;
026925: 		lastCardWasBonusEcho = false;
026926: 		lastBonusEchoVariant = null;
026927: 	}
026928: 	const wasReplayPlay = !!(playedCard && playedCard.isBonusEcho && Number(playedCard.bonusEchoReplaysAvailable || 0) > 0);
026929: 	if (playedCard && playedCard.isBonusEcho && playedCard.bonusEchoReplaysAvailable > 0) {
026930: 		playedCard.bonusEchoReplaysAvailable = Math.max(0, playedCard.bonusEchoReplaysAvailable - 1);
026931: 	}
026932: 	let bonusEchoReplayGranted = false;
026933: 	let bonusEchoPointsAdded = 0;
026934: 	let bonusEchoExtraTurnGranted = false;
026935: 	let bonusEchoColorKey = null;
026936: 	let bonusEchoBonusesGranted = [];
026937: 	// Bonus Boost card: after playing it, only that color's bonus is 2× (per level)
026938: 	try {
026939: 		if (playedCard && playedCard.isBonusBoost) {
026940: 			const boostKey = getBonusKeyFromColorName(playedCard?.color?.name);
026941: 			if (boostKey && BONUS_COLOR_CONFIG[boostKey]) {
026942: 				if (!(bonusBoostActiveColors instanceof Set)) bonusBoostActiveColors = new Set();
026943: 				bonusBoostActiveColors.add(boostKey);

027085: 	function getCandidateZonesForColor(colorName) {
027086: 		if (!colorName) return [];
027087: 		const zones = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.zone')).filter(zone => zone.querySelector('.cell') && !zone.classList.contains('red-group'));
027088: 		return zones.filter(zone => {
027089: 			const zoneColor = zone.dataset.color || (zone.id && zone.id.startsWith('red-grid') ? 'rood' : null);
027090: 			if (!zoneColor) return false;
027091: 			if (colorName === 'multikleur') return true;
027092: 			if (colorName === 'rood') return zoneColor === 'rood';
027093: 			return zoneColor === colorName;
027094: 		});
027095: 	}
027096: 
027097: 	function getUniqueRotations(shape) {
027098: 		const rotations = [];
027099: 		const seen = new Set();
027100: 		let current = cloneShape(shape);
027101: 		for (let i = 0; i < 4; i += 1) {
027102: 			const key = JSON.stringify(current);
027103: 			if (!seen.has(key)) {
027104: 				rotations.push(current.map(row => row.slice()));
027105: 				seen.add(key);
027106: 			}
027107: 			current = rotateShape(current);
027108: 		}
027109: 		return rotations;
027110: 	}
027111: 
027112: 	function getUniquePlayableTransforms(shape) {
027113: 		const transforms = [];
027114: 		const seen = new Set();
027115: 		[cloneShape(shape), mirrorShape(cloneShape(shape))].forEach(variant => {
027116: 			getUniqueRotations(variant).forEach(rotation => {
027117: 				const key = JSON.stringify(rotation);
027118: 				if (seen.has(key)) return;
027119: 				seen.add(key);
027120: 				transforms.push(rotation.map(row => row.slice()));
027121: 			});
027122: 		});
027123: 		return transforms;
027124: 	}

027126: 	function cardHasPlayablePlacement(card) {
027127: 		if (!card || !Array.isArray(card.matrix) || !card.matrix.length) return false;
027128: 		const colorName = card.color?.name || null;
027129: 		// Golden is a card modifier (frame-only), not a wildcard for placement.
027130: 		const zones = getCandidateZonesForColor(colorName);
027131: 		if (!zones.length) return false;
027132: 		const rotations = getUniquePlayableTransforms(card.matrix);
027133: 		for (const zone of zones) {
027134: 			const metrics = getZoneMetrics(zone);
027135: 			if (!metrics || metrics.maxX < metrics.minX || metrics.maxY < metrics.minY) continue;
027136: 			for (const shape of rotations) {
027137: 				const shapeHeight = shape.length;
027138: 				const shapeWidth = shape[0].length;
027139: 				const maxStartX = metrics.maxX - shapeWidth + 1;
027140: 				const maxStartY = metrics.maxY - shapeHeight + 1;
027141: 				if (maxStartX < metrics.minX || maxStartY < metrics.minY) continue;
027142: 				for (let baseX = metrics.minX; baseX <= maxStartX; baseX += 1) {
027143: 					for (let baseY = metrics.minY; baseY <= maxStartY; baseY += 1) {
027144: 						if (canPlace(zone, baseX, baseY, shape)) {
027145: 							return true;
027146: 						}
027147: 					}
027148: 				}
027149: 			}
027150: 		}
027151: 		return false;
027152: 	}

027154: 	function isCardAllowedByTurnRules(card) {
027155: 		// Turn rule: you may place at most 1 normal card per turn.
027156: 		// Golden cards are exempt.
027157: 		if (!card) return false;
027158: 		const isGolden = !!(card.isGolden || card.color?.isGolden);
027159: 		const isBonusEchoCard = !!card.isBonusEcho;
027160: 		const hasEchoReplay = isBonusEchoCard && Number(card.bonusEchoReplaysAvailable || 0) > 0;
027161: 		if (isGolden) return true;
027162: 		if (hasEchoReplay) return true;
027163: 		return !nonGoldenCardPlayedThisTurn;
027164: 	}
027165: 
027166: 	function isCardPlayable(card) {
027167: 		if (!card) return false;
027168: 		if (!isWorld4CardAllowed(card)) return false;
027169: 		return isCardAllowedByTurnRules(card) && cardHasPlayablePlacement(card);
027170: 	}

027172: 	function getRemainingBonusCharges() {
027173: 		let total = BONUS_ORDER.reduce((sum, key) => sum + (bonusInventory[key] || 0), 0);
027174: 		// Include free placements ("Gratis")
027175: 		total += Math.max(0, Number(freePlacementsRemaining) || 0);
027176: 		// Include purchased placement (single pending purchased block)
027177: 		if (window.hasPurchasedPlacement) total += 1;
027178: 		return total;
027179: 	}

027185: 			if (isCardPlayable(card)) playableCards += 1;
027186: 		});
027187: 		const remainingBonuses = getRemainingBonusCharges();
027188: 		const hasActiveSelection = !!activeBonusPlacement || !!draggedBlock;
027189: 		return { playableCards, totalCards: cards.length, remainingBonuses, hasActiveSelection };
027190: 	}

027192: 	function buildCompletionWarningDetails(state = getCompletionWarningState()) {
027193: 		const parts = [];
027194: 		// Alleen waarschuwen voor speelbare kaarten
027195: 		if (state.playableCards > 0) {
027196: 			const cardLabel = state.playableCards === 1 ? 'speelbare kaart' : 'speelbare kaarten';
027197: 			parts.push(`${state.playableCards} ${cardLabel}`);
027198: 		}
027199: 		if (state.remainingBonuses > 0) {
027200: 			const bonusLabel = state.remainingBonuses === 1 ? 'bonus' : 'bonussen';
027201: 			parts.push(`${state.remainingBonuses} ${bonusLabel}`);
027202: 		}
027203: 		if (state.hasActiveSelection && parts.length === 0) {
027204: 			parts.push('een bonus of kaart die je net hebt geselecteerd');
027205: 		}
027206: 		if (parts.length === 0) return '';
027207: 		if (parts.length === 1) return `Je hebt nog ${parts[0]}.`;
027208: 		return `Je hebt nog ${parts[0]} en ${parts[1]}.`;
027209: 	}

027273: 	function showRoundModal(success, score, coins, bonusCoins = 0) {
027274: 		if (!roundModalLayer) return;
027275: 	// Prefer a loaded custom objective when present
027276: 	const loadedCustom = (window && window.loadedCustomObjectiveCompiled) ? window.loadedCustomObjectiveCompiled : null;
027277: 	const isScenarioMode = (() => {
027278: 		try { return !!(window && window._locusScenarioMode); } catch (e) { return false; }
027279: 	})();
027280: 	
027281: 	// Prefer a loaded custom objective when present
027282: 	const activeObjective = loadedCustom || getObjectiveById(currentObjectiveId) || getObjectiveForLevel(currentLevel);
027283: 	const objectiveLabel = activeObjective ? (activeObjective.short || activeObjective.description) : null;
027284: 	// Compute cleared state: custom objective exposes .check(scores), otherwise use existing completed set
027285: 	let objectiveCleared = true;
027286: 	if (loadedCustom) {
027287: 		try { objectiveCleared = !!loadedCustom.check(); } catch (e) { objectiveCleared = false; }
027288: 	} else if (window.LocusWorld4?.isWorld4?.()) {
027289: 		try { objectiveCleared = !!window.LocusWorld4.isPrimaryComplete(currentLevel, latestScoreSnapshot); } catch (_) { objectiveCleared = false; }
027290: 	} else {
027291: 		objectiveCleared = activeObjective ? isObjectiveCompleted(activeObjective.id) : true;
027292: 	}
027293: 	// Scenario: if the objective is not cleared, treat this as a failed completion.
027294: 	const scenarioObjectiveFailed = !!(isScenarioMode && loadedCustom && !objectiveCleared);
027295: 	const effectiveSuccess = !!(success && !scenarioObjectiveFailed);
027296: 	lastRoundWasSuccess = effectiveSuccess;
027297: 	if (roundModalTitle) {
027298: 		if (scenarioObjectiveFailed) {
027299: 			roundModalTitle.textContent = (window.loadedCustomLevelMeta && window.loadedCustomLevelMeta.name)
027300: 				? ('Niet voltooid - ' + window.loadedCustomLevelMeta.name)
027301: 				: 'Niet voltooid -';
027302: 		} else if (loadedCustom && window.loadedCustomLevelMeta && window.loadedCustomLevelMeta.name) {
027303: 			roundModalTitle.textContent = (effectiveSuccess ? 'Ronde voltooid' : 'Game Over') + ' — ' + window.loadedCustomLevelMeta.name;
027304: 		} else {
027305: 			roundModalTitle.textContent = effectiveSuccess ? 'Ronde voltooid' : 'Game Over';
027306: 		}
027307: 	}
027308: 	  if (effectiveSuccess) {
027309: 		if (objectiveLabel) {
027310: 			roundModalMessage.textContent = `Doel behaald: ${objectiveLabel}. Kies wat je nu wilt doen.`;
027311: 		} else {
027312: 			roundModalMessage.textContent = 'Je hebt het level gehaald! Maak je keuze hieronder.';
027313: 		}
027314: 	  } else {
027315: 		if (scenarioObjectiveFailed) {
027316: 			roundModalMessage.textContent = 'Helaas.. Doel niet behaald';
027317: 		} else {
027318: 		switch (lastRoundFailureReason) {
027319: 			case 'objective':
027320: 				roundModalMessage.textContent = objectiveLabel ? `Doel nog niet gehaald: ${objectiveLabel}.` : 'Er is nog een leveldoel dat niet gehaald is.';
027321: 				break;
027322: 			default:
027323: 				roundModalMessage.textContent = 'Niet gehaald... Je deck wordt teruggezet naar de standaard set.';
027324: 				break;
027325: 		}
027326: 		}
027327: 	  }
027328: 		if (roundModalSummary) {
027329: 		let summaryHTML = buildCardSummaryHTML(score, coins, bonusCoins);
027330: 		if (activeObjective) {
027331: 			const statusLabel = objectiveCleared ? 'Voltooid' : 'Niet voltooid';
027332: 			const objDesc = (loadedCustom && loadedCustom.description) ? loadedCustom.description : (activeObjective.short || activeObjective.description);
027333: 			summaryHTML += `<div class="modal-summary-line"><strong>Doel</strong><span>${objDesc} - ${statusLabel}</span></div>`;
027334: 		}
027335: 		try {
027336: 			if (window.LocusWorld4?.isWorld4?.()) {
027337: 				if (effectiveSuccess) window.LocusWorld4.commitStars?.(latestScoreSnapshot);
027338: 				summaryHTML += window.LocusWorld4.buildRoundStarsHTML?.(effectiveSuccess, latestScoreSnapshot) || '';
027339: 			}
027340: 		} catch (_) {}
027341: 		roundModalSummary.innerHTML = summaryHTML;
027342: 	}
027343: 	  if (roundModalNext) {
027344: 		roundModalNext.textContent = effectiveSuccess ? `Naar level ${currentLevel + 1}` : 'Opnieuw proberen';
027345: 		roundModalNext.disabled = false;
027346: 		// Scenario objective fail: no next/continue option.
027347: 		roundModalNext.style.display = scenarioObjectiveFailed ? 'none' : '';
027348: 	  }
027349: 	  if (roundModalRestart) {
027350: 		roundModalRestart.textContent = effectiveSuccess ? 'Nieuwe run' : 'Reset deck';
027351: 	  }
027352: 	  if (roundModalCurrentRun) {
027353: 		const canReturn = !!(isScenarioMode && hasPreviousNormalRunSnapshot());
027354: 		roundModalCurrentRun.style.display = canReturn ? '' : 'none';
027355: 	  }
027356: 	  roundModalLayer.classList.add('show');
027357: 	}

027456: 		function getLevel2UpgradeCandidates() {
027457: 			return ownedDeckBlueprints.filter(bp => bp && !bp.isBonusEchoUpgrade && !bp.isBonusEcho && !bp.isBonusBoost);

027460: 		function applyBonusEchoUpgradeToBlueprint(blueprint, variantKey) {
027461: 			if (!blueprint || blueprint.isBonusEchoUpgrade) return false;
027462: 			const variant = variantKey || pickBonusEchoVariant();
027463: 			blueprint.isBonusEchoUpgrade = true;
027464: 			blueprint.isBonusEcho = true;
027465: 			blueprint.bonusEchoVariant = variant;
027466: 			blueprint.bonusEchoReplaysAvailable = 0;
027467: 			const syncCard = (card) => {
027468: 				if (card && card.blueprintId === blueprint.blueprintId) {
027469: 					card.isBonusEchoUpgrade = true;
027470: 					card.isBonusEcho = true;
027471: 					card.bonusEchoVariant = variant;
027472: 					card.bonusEchoReplaysAvailable = 0;
027473: 				}
027474: 			};
027475: 			[currentHand, drawPile, discardPile].forEach(pile => {
027476: 				if (!Array.isArray(pile)) return;
027477: 				pile.forEach(syncCard);
027478: 			});
027479: 			return true;
027480: 		}

027482: 		function startBonusEchoUpgradeFlow(options = {}) {
027483: 			const { free = false, forcedVariant = null, markUsed = true } = options;
027484: 			if (markUsed && shopLevel2Used) {
027485: 				if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = 'Je kunt maar 1 kaart upgraden per shop.';
027486: 				return;
027487: 			}
027488: 			const candidates = getLevel2UpgradeCandidates();
027489: 			if (!candidates.length) {
027490: 				if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = 'Geen kaarten om te upgraden.';
027491: 				return;
027492: 			}
027493: 			const coinsAvailable = getSpendableCoinCount();
027494: 			if (!debugMode && !free && coinsAvailable < BONUS_ECHO_UPGRADE_COST) {
027495: 				if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = 'Onvoldoende munten voor Level 2.';
027496: 				return;
027497: 			}
027498: 			if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = 'Kies een kaart om te upgraden.';
027499: 			const variant = forcedVariant || shopLevel2Variant || pickBonusEchoVariant();
027500: 			openLevel2UpgradeModal(candidates, (pickedBlueprint) => {
027501: 				if (!pickedBlueprint) return;
027502: 				if (!debugMode && !free && !spendCoins(BONUS_ECHO_UPGRADE_COST)) {
027503: 					if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = 'Munten konden niet worden afgeschreven.';
027504: 					return;
027505: 				}
027506: 				if (!applyBonusEchoUpgradeToBlueprint(pickedBlueprint, variant)) return;
027507: 				if (UPGRADES.bonusEcho) UPGRADES.bonusEcho.purchased = true;
027508: 				if (markUsed) shopLevel2Used = true;
027509: 				const variantLabel = (getBonusEchoUiCopy(variant).sub || variant).toUpperCase();
027510: 				showObjectiveToast(`🔁 Level 2 (${variantLabel}) toegevoegd aan je kaart!`);
027511: 				updateDeckPreview();
027512: 				renderCurrentHand();
027513: 				updateShopCoinDisplay();
027514: 				updateShopUpgradeUI();
027515: 				refreshShopCardButtons();
027516: 				try { saveGameState(); } catch (_) {}
027517: 			}, variant);
027518: 		}

027652: function purchaseBonusUpgrade(colorKey) {
027653: 		const meta = getBonusMeta(colorKey);
027654: 		if (!meta || isBonusUpgraded(colorKey)) return;
027655: 		const cost = BONUS_UPGRADE_COSTS[colorKey] ?? 6;
027656: 		
027657: 		// In debugMode zijn bonus upgrades gratis
027658: 		if (!debugMode) {
027659: 			const coinsAvailable = getSpendableCoinCount();
027660: 			if (coinsAvailable < cost) {
027661: 				if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = 'Onvoldoende munten voor deze upgrade.';
027662: 				return;
027663: 			}
027664: 			if (!spendCoins(cost)) {
027665: 				if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = 'Munten konden niet worden afgeschreven.';
027666: 				return;
027667: 			}
027668: 		}
027669: 		
027670: 		setBonusUpgraded(colorKey, true);
027671: 		updateBonusInventoryUI();
027672: 		if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = `${meta.label} bonus geüpgraded!`;
027673: 		showObjectiveToast(`🌟 ${meta.label} bonus verbeterd!`);
027674: 		updateShopUpgradeUI();
027675: 		updateShopBonusUI();
027676: 		refreshShopCardButtons();
027677: 	}

027679: function purchaseUpgrade(upgradeId) {
027680: 		const upgrade = UPGRADES[upgradeId];
027681: 		if (!upgrade || upgrade.purchased) return;
027682: 		const effectiveCost = getEffectiveUpgradeCost(upgradeId);
027683: 		
027684: 		// In debugMode zijn alle upgrades gratis
027685: 		if (!debugMode) {
027686: 			const coins = getSpendableCoinCount();
027687: 			if (coins < effectiveCost) {
027688: 				if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = 'Je hebt niet genoeg munten voor deze upgrade.';
027689: 				return;
027690: 			}
027691: 			
027692: 			if (!spendCoins(effectiveCost)) {
027693: 				if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = 'Munten konden niet worden afgeschreven.';
027694: 				return;
027695: 			}
027696: 		}
027697: 		
027698: 	upgrade.purchased = true;
027699: 	
027700: 	// In scenario mode, upgrades should not trigger onPurchase side effects
027701: 	// (which can rebuild boards, open reward modals, or save to localStorage).
027702: 	try {
027703: 		if (!(window && window._locusScenarioMode) && upgrade.onPurchase) {
027704: 			upgrade.onPurchase();
027705: 		}
027706: 	} catch (e) {}
027707: 	
027708: 	if (shopModalMessage) {
027709: 		shopModalMessage.textContent = `${upgrade.icon} ${upgrade.name} aangekocht!`;
027710: 	}
027711: 	updateShopUpgradeUI();
027712: 	updateShopBonusUI();
027713: 	refreshShopCardButtons();
027714: 	showObjectiveToast(`${upgrade.icon} ${upgrade.name} ontgrendeld!`);
027715: }
027716: 
027717: function openShopModal(callback) {
027718: 	  pendingShopCallback = callback;
027719: 	  if (!shopModalLayer || getSpendableCoinCount() === 0) {
027720: 		if (typeof pendingShopCallback === 'function') pendingShopCallback();
027721: 		pendingShopCallback = null;
027722: 		return;
027723: 	  }
027724: 	  if (shopCardOptions) {
027725: 		shopCardOptions.innerHTML = '';
027726: 		const largeShopUnlocked = (UNLOCK_PROGRESSION && typeof UNLOCK_PROGRESSION.isCategoryUnlocked === 'function')
027727: 			? UNLOCK_PROGRESSION.isCategoryUnlocked('large', currentLevel)
027728: 			: (currentLevel >= 3);
027729: 		
027730: 		// SHOP: max 3 kaart-opties.
027731: 		// Grotere blokken (large/xl/xxl) vervangen soms een kleinere optie i.p.v. extra bij te komen.
027732: 		// Vanaf level 2 komt er 1 "random" (mystery) kaart bij, plus 2 andere aanbiedingen.
027733: 		const offers = [];
027734: 
027735: 		// Helper: pick N unieke entries.
027736: 		function pickUnique(list, count) {
027737: 			const pool = list.slice();
027738: 			const out = [];
027739: 			while (pool.length && out.length < count) {
027740: 				const idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length);
027741: 				out.push(pool.splice(idx, 1)[0]);
027742: 			}
027743: 			return out;
027744: 		}
027745: 
027746: 		// Build tier factories (deterministic cost per tier).
027747: 		const tierFactories = {
027748: 			mini: () => {
027749: 				const miniChoices = (CARD_BLUEPRINTS && Array.isArray(CARD_BLUEPRINTS.mini)) ? CARD_BLUEPRINTS.mini : [];
027750: 				const miniPick = miniChoices.length
027751: 					? miniChoices[Math.floor(Math.random() * miniChoices.length)]
027752: 					: { name: 'Domino verticaal', matrix: [[1],[1]] };
027753: 				const entry = { name: miniPick.name, matrix: cloneShape(miniPick.matrix), category: 'mini' };
027754: 				return { option: createShopCard(entry), cost: 2, fixed: true };
027755: 			},
027756: 			standard: () => {
027757: 				const standardChoices = (CARD_BLUEPRINTS && Array.isArray(CARD_BLUEPRINTS.standard)) ? CARD_BLUEPRINTS.standard : [];
027758: 				const standardPick = standardChoices.length
027759: 					? standardChoices[Math.floor(Math.random() * standardChoices.length)]
027760: 					: { name: 'O', matrix: [[1,1],[1,1]] };
027761: 				const entry = { name: standardPick.name, matrix: cloneShape(standardPick.matrix), category: 'standard' };
027762: 				return { option: createShopCard(entry), cost: 4, fixed: true };
027763: 			},
027764: 			large: () => {
027765: 				const largeBlueprints = (CARD_BLUEPRINTS && Array.isArray(CARD_BLUEPRINTS.large)) ? CARD_BLUEPRINTS.large : [];
027766: 				const fiveBlockPool = largeBlueprints
027767: 					.filter(entry => entry && entry.matrix)
027768: 					.map(entry => ({ name: entry.name, matrix: entry.matrix, blocks: countShapeBlocks(entry.matrix) }))
027769: 					.filter(entry => entry.blocks === 5);
027770: 				const pickedLarge = fiveBlockPool.length
027771: 					? fiveBlockPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * fiveBlockPool.length)]
027772: 					: { name: 'Plus', matrix: [[0,1,0],[1,1,1],[0,1,0]] };
027773: 				const entry = { name: pickedLarge.name, matrix: cloneShape(pickedLarge.matrix), category: 'large' };
027774: 				return { option: createShopCard(entry), cost: 6, fixed: true };
027775: 			},
027776: 			xl: () => {
027777: 				const xlPick = XL_6_SHAPES[Math.floor(Math.random() * XL_6_SHAPES.length)];
027778: 				const entry = { name: xlPick.name, matrix: cloneShape(xlPick.matrix), category: 'large' };
027779: 				return { option: createShopCard(entry), cost: 8, fixed: true };
027780: 			},
027781: 			xxl: () => {
027782: 				const xxlPick = EXTRA_LARGE_7_SHAPES[Math.floor(Math.random() * EXTRA_LARGE_7_SHAPES.length)];
027783: 				const entry = { name: xxlPick.name, matrix: cloneShape(xxlPick.matrix), category: 'large' };
027784: 				return { option: createShopCard(entry), cost: 10, fixed: true };
027785: 			}
027786: 		};
027787: 
027788: 		const MINI_SHOP_DISABLE_LEVEL = 4;
027789: 		const miniShopDisabled = currentLevel >= MINI_SHOP_DISABLE_LEVEL && largeShopUnlocked;
027790: 		const SIZE_TIER_WEIGHTS = {
027791: 			mini: miniShopDisabled ? 0 : 0.45,
027792: 			standard: 1.1,
027793: 			large: 1.35,
027794: 			xl: 0.35,
027795: 			xxl: 0.2
027796: 		};
027797: 
027798: 		function pickWeightedSize(keys, exclude = new Set()) {
027799: 			const pool = keys.filter(key => !exclude.has(key) && (SIZE_TIER_WEIGHTS[key] ?? 1) > 0);
027800: 			if (!pool.length) return null;
027801: 			const total = pool.reduce((sum, key) => sum + (SIZE_TIER_WEIGHTS[key] ?? 1), 0);
027802: 			let target = Math.random() * total;
027803: 			for (const key of pool) {
027804: 				target -= (SIZE_TIER_WEIGHTS[key] ?? 1);
027805: 				if (target <= 0) return key;
027806: 			}
027807: 			return pool[pool.length - 1];
027808: 		}
027809: 
027810: 		// Which size tiers are available right now?
027811: 		const availableSizeKeys = ['mini', 'standard'];
027812: 		if (largeShopUnlocked) availableSizeKeys.push('large');
027813: 		if (hasUpgrade('xlBlocks') && Array.isArray(XL_6_SHAPES) && XL_6_SHAPES.length) availableSizeKeys.push('xl');
027814: 		if (hasUpgrade('extraLargeBlocks') && Array.isArray(EXTRA_LARGE_7_SHAPES) && EXTRA_LARGE_7_SHAPES.length) availableSizeKeys.push('xxl');
027815: 		if (miniShopDisabled) {
027816: 			const idx = availableSizeKeys.indexOf('mini');
027817: 			if (idx >= 0 && availableSizeKeys.length > 1) availableSizeKeys.splice(idx, 1);
027818: 		}
027819: 
027820: 		// Specials are allowed but should not explode the amount of options.

027833: 				return { option: goldenCard, cost: calculateCardCost(goldenCard), fixed: false };
027834: 			});

027837: 			availableSpecialFactories.push(() => {

027840: 				return { option: premiumCard, cost: calculateCardCost(premiumCard), fixed: false };

028042: 	function handleShopPurchase(option, cost, cardIndex) {
028043: 	  if (!shopModalLayer) return;
028044: 	  const coinsAvailable = getSpendableCoinCount();
028045: 	  if (coinsAvailable < cost) {
028046: 		if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = 'Onvoldoende munten voor deze kaart.';
028047: 		return;
028048: 	  }
028049: 	  if (!spendCoins(cost)) {
028050: 		if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = 'Munten konden niet worden afgeschreven.';
028051: 		return;
028052: 	  }
028053: 	  
028054: 	  updateShopUpgradeUI();
028055: 	  updateShopBonusUI();
028056: 	  refreshShopCardButtons();
028057: 	  
028058: 	  // Check of dit een mystery/random card is
028059: 	  if (option && option.isRandomShopCard) {
028060: 		const mysteryInner = document.querySelector(`.mystery-card-inner[data-card-index="${cardIndex}"]`);
028061: 		if (mysteryInner) {
028062: 		  // Disable alle knoppen tijdens animatie
028063: 		  const allBuyButtons = shopCardOptions.querySelectorAll('button');
028064: 		  allBuyButtons.forEach(btn => btn.disabled = true);
028065: 		  
028066: 		  // Trigger flip animatie
028067: 		  mysteryInner.classList.add('flipped');
028068: 		  
028069: 		  // Wacht 1.5 seconden voordat we de kaart toevoegen

028072: 			  blueprintId: option.blueprintId,

028078: 			  isBonusBoost: !!option.isBonusBoost
028079: 			});
028080: 			
028081: 			// Shop blijft open - markeer mystery kaart als gekocht
028082: 			if (shopModalMessage) shopModalMessage.textContent = 'Mystery kaart gekocht! Koop meer of klik "Sla over".';
028083: 			const shopCards = shopCardOptions.querySelectorAll('.shop-card');
028084: 			if (shopCards[cardIndex]) {
028085: 			  shopCards[cardIndex].style.opacity = '0.5';
028086: 			  shopCards[cardIndex].style.pointerEvents = 'none';
028087: 			  const btn = shopCards[cardIndex].querySelector('button');
028088: 			  if (btn) {
028089: 				btn.disabled = true;
028090: 				btn.textContent = 'Gekocht!';

028098: 				btn.disabled = false;
028099: 			  }
028100: 			});

028159: function resetWorldLayoutStyles() {
028160: 	const zoneIds = ['yellow-zone', 'purple-zone', 'green-zone', 'blue-zone', 'red-zone'];
028161: 	const gridIds = ['yellow-grid', 'purple-grid', 'green-grid', 'blue-grid', 'red-grid'];
028162: 	const redSubGridIds = ['red-grid1', 'red-grid2', 'red-grid3', 'red-grid4', 'red-grid5', 'red-grid6'];
028163: 	zoneIds.forEach(id => {
028164: 		const el = document.getElementById(id);
028165: 		if (!el || !el.style) return;
028166: 		['width','height','min-width','max-width','min-height','max-height','overflow','overflow-x','overflow-y','transform','transform-origin','position','top','left','right','bottom'].forEach(prop => {
028167: 			try { el.style.removeProperty(prop); } catch (_) {}
028168: 		});
028169: 	});
028170: 	gridIds.forEach(id => {
028171: 		const el = document.getElementById(id);
028172: 		if (!el || !el.style) return;
028173: 		['margin','margin-left','margin-right','margin-top','margin-bottom','justify-content','transform','transform-origin','width','height'].forEach(prop => {
028174: 			try { el.style.removeProperty(prop); } catch (_) {}
028175: 		});
028176: 	});
028177: 	// Reset red subgrids visibility to default (1-4 visible, 5-6 hidden)
028178: 	['red-grid1','red-grid2','red-grid3','red-grid4'].forEach(id => {
028179: 		const el = document.getElementById(id);
028180: 		if (el) el.style.display = '';
028181: 	});
028182: 	['red-grid5','red-grid6'].forEach(id => {
028183: 		const el = document.getElementById(id);
028184: 		if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
028185: 	});
028186: 	// Reset world3 red lock visibility
028187: 	const lockEl = document.getElementById('world3-red-lock');
028188: 	if (lockEl) lockEl.style.display = '';
028189: 	// Also reset board columns
028190: 	const columns = document.querySelectorAll('#board > .column');
028191: 	columns.forEach(col => {
028192: 		if (!col || !col.style) return;
028193: 		['width','height','min-width','max-width','min-height','max-height','transform','transform-origin','position'].forEach(prop => {
028194: 			try { col.style.removeProperty(prop); } catch (_) {}
028195: 		});
028196: 	});
028197: }

028199: 	function rebuildGameBoards() {
028200: 	  // Scenario sessions use an imported board; never regenerate the level boards in that mode.
028201: 	  // This prevents upgrade callbacks (e.g., blackHoleAccess) from overwriting the imported layout.
028202: 	  try {
028203: 		if (window && window._locusScenarioMode && !isLoadingGame) {
028204: 			return;
028205: 		}
028206: 	  } catch (e) {}
028207: 	  closeZoom();
028208: 	  resetScoreState();
028209: 	  historyStack.length = 0;
028210: 	  bumpGridVersion();
028211: 	  
028212: 	  // Bepaal in welke world we zitten
028213: 	  const { world, subLevel } = getWorldAndSubLevel(currentLevel);
028214: 	  currentWorld = world;
028215: 	  document.body.classList.toggle('world-2', world === 2);
028216: 	  document.body.classList.toggle('world-1', world === 1);
028217: 	  document.body.classList.toggle('world-3', world === 3);
028218: 	  document.body.classList.toggle('world-4', world === 4);
028219: 	  if (world !== 4) {
028220: 		setWorld4AllowedColors(null);
028221: 		clearWorld4Locks();
028222: 	  }
028223: 	  
028224: 	  // World 1: disable scrolling in green zone
028225: 	  const greenZone = document.getElementById('green-zone');
028226: 	  if (greenZone) {
028227: 		if (world === 1) {
028228: 		  greenZone.classList.add('no-scroll');
028229: 		} else {
028230: 		  greenZone.classList.remove('no-scroll');
028231: 		}
028232: 	  }
028233: 	  
028234: 	  if (world === 1) {
028235: 		rebuildGameBoards_World1();
028236: 	  } else if (world === 2) {
028237: 		rebuildGameBoards_World2();
028238: 	  } else if (world === 3) {
028239: 		rebuildGameBoards_World3();
028240: 	  } else if (world === 4) {
028241: 		rebuildGameBoards_World4();
028242: 	  } else {
028243: 		// Fallback naar World 3 voor toekomstige worlds
028244: 		rebuildGameBoards_World3();
028245: 	  }
028246: 	  // World 3 red progression visibility (and ensure 5/6 stay hidden in other worlds)
028247: 	  try { applyWorld3RedStage(world === 3 ? world3RedStage : 0); } catch (e) {}
028248: 	  // Ensure layout is rebuilt after world switches (prevents stale sizing/layout state).
028249: 	  try {
028250: 		if (typeof scheduleLayoutReflow === 'function') {
028251: 			// Force reflow even if viewport hasn't changed (level change at same window size).
028252: 			if (typeof lastLayoutViewportKey !== 'undefined') lastLayoutViewportKey = '';
028253: 			scheduleLayoutReflow(0);
028254: 		}
028255: 	  } catch (e) {}
028256: 	}

028258: 	// WORLD 4: Board layout = World 3 sizing/layout, plus doors/keys gating
028259: 	function withWorld4Seed(seed, fn) {
028260: 		const originalRandom = Math.random;
028261: 		const rng = world4Mulberry32((Number(seed) || 1) >>> 0);
028262: 		try {
028263: 			Math.random = rng;
028264: 			return fn(rng);
028265: 		} finally {
028266: 			Math.random = originalRandom;
028267: 		}
028268: 	}

028270: 	function getWorld4YellowShape(subLevel = 1, generationVersion = 2) {
028271: 		// Ten deliberately different silhouettes. World 4 should feel authored rather
028272: 		// than like World 3 with doors stamped on top of it. These variants are also
028273: 		// intentionally denser/larger so the yellow citadel occupies more of the board.
028274: 		const shapes = [
028275: 			{ name:'sleutelgat', pattern:[8,10,12,14,16,18,16,14,12,10,8,8,10,12] },
028276: 			{ name:'schild', pattern:[8,10,12,14,16,18,18,16,16,14,12,10,8,6] },
028277: 			{ name:'zandloper', pattern:[8,10,12,14,12,10,8,10,12,14,16,14,12,10,8] },
028278: 			{ name:'poort', pattern:[10,12,14,16,18,18,16,14,12,10,10,12,14,12,10] },
028279: 			{ name:'kroon', pattern:[7,11,9,13,15,17,19,17,15,13,11,13,11,9,7] },

028291: 			// Small terraces shift the outline without cutting holes through playable rows.

028294: 		});

028300: 			return [r, x];
028301: 		});
028302: 		return { ...raw, offsets, boldCells };
028303: 	}

028386: 	function buildWorld4BlueRiverLegacy(subLevel = 1) {
028387: 		const p=getWorld4BlueProfile(subLevel), rng=world4Mulberry32(0x4300 + subLevel * 173);
028388: 		const lengths=[], offsets=[], voidCells=new Set();
028389: 		let width=3, offset=Math.max(0,Math.floor((p.cols-width)/2));
028390: 		const splitWindows=[];
028391: 		if(p.splitCount>=1) splitWindows.push([Math.floor(p.rows*.28),Math.floor(p.rows*.28)+10+subLevel]);
028392: 		if(p.splitCount>=2) splitWindows.push([Math.floor(p.rows*.62),Math.min(p.rows-5,Math.floor(p.rows*.62)+9+Math.floor(subLevel/2))]);
028393: 		for(let y=0;y<p.rows;y++){
028394: 			width=2+Math.floor(rng()*3);
028395: 			const maxOffset=Math.max(0,p.cols-width);
028396: 			if(rng()>.28) offset += rng()>.5?1:-1;
028397: 			offset=Math.max(0,Math.min(maxOffset,offset));
028398: 			let rowStart=offset,rowEnd=offset+width;
028399: 			const win=splitWindows.find(([a,b])=>y>=a&&y<=b);
028400: 			if(win){
028401: 				const [a,b]=win, progress=(y-a)/Math.max(1,b-a);
028402: 				const edge=Math.min(progress,1-progress);
028403: 				const gap=edge<.16?0:(edge<.3?1:2);
028404: 				const branchWidth=2+(subLevel%2);
028405: 				let branchStart=offset+width-1+gap;
028406: 				let branchOnRight=true;
028407: 				if(branchStart+branchWidth>p.cols){ branchOnRight=false; branchStart=offset-branchWidth+1-gap; }
028408: 				branchStart=Math.max(0,Math.min(p.cols-branchWidth,branchStart));
028409: 				rowStart=Math.min(offset,branchStart); rowEnd=Math.max(offset+width,branchStart+branchWidth);
028410: 				const leftEnd=Math.min(offset+width,branchStart+branchWidth), rightStart=Math.max(offset,branchStart);
028411: 				if(branchOnRight && offset+width<branchStart){ for(let x=offset+width;x<branchStart;x++) voidCells.add(`${x},${y}`); }
028412: 				if(!branchOnRight && branchStart+branchWidth<offset){ for(let x=branchStart+branchWidth;x<offset;x++) voidCells.add(`${x},${y}`); }
028413: 			}
028414: 			lengths.push(rowEnd-rowStart); offsets.push(rowStart);
028415: 		}
028416: 		return { ...p, lengths, offsets, voidCells };
028417: 	}
028418: 
028419: 	function buildWorld4BlueRiver(subLevel = 1, generationVersion = 2) {
028420: 		if (generationVersion < 2) return buildWorld4BlueRiverLegacy(subLevel);
028421: 		const p = getWorld4BlueProfile(subLevel);
028422: 		const rng = world4Mulberry32(0x4300 + subLevel * 173);
028423: 		const phase = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
028424: 		const lengths = [], offsets = [], voidCells = new Set();
028425: 		const splitWindows = [];
028426: 		if (p.splitCount >= 1) splitWindows.push([Math.floor(p.rows*.28), Math.floor(p.rows*.28)+10+subLevel]);
028427: 		if (p.splitCount >= 2) splitWindows.push([Math.floor(p.rows*.62), Math.min(p.rows-5, Math.floor(p.rows*.62)+9+Math.floor(subLevel/2))]);
028428: 		let previousCenter = Math.floor(p.cols / 2);
028429: 		for (let y = 0; y < p.rows; y++) {
028430: 			// Broad, continuous bends with periodic pools, instead of a noisy random walk.
028431: 			const bend = Math.sin(y*.16 + phase) * (p.cols*.25) + Math.sin(y*.065 - phase)*1.3;
028432: 			const target = Math.round((p.cols-1)/2 + bend);
028433: 			const center = Math.max(2, Math.min(p.cols-3, previousCenter + Math.sign(target-previousCenter)));
028434: 			previousCenter = center;
028435: 			const width = 3 + (Math.sin(y*.24 + phase) > .55 ? 1 : 0);
028436: 			const trunkStart = Math.max(0, Math.min(p.cols-width, center-Math.floor(width/2)));
028437: 			let rowStart = trunkStart, rowEnd = trunkStart + width;
028438: 			const win = splitWindows.find(([a,b]) => y >= a && y <= b);
028439: 			if (win) {
028440: 				const [a,b] = win, progress = (y-a)/(b-a);
028441: 				// Two three-cell channels open around an island and reunite at both ends.
028442: 				const gap = Math.min(3, Math.floor(Math.sin(progress*Math.PI)*4));
028443: 				const forkWidth = 6 + gap;
028444: 				rowStart = Math.max(0, Math.min(p.cols-forkWidth, center-Math.floor(forkWidth/2)));
028445: 				rowEnd = rowStart + forkWidth;
028446: 				for (let x = rowStart+3; x < rowStart+3+gap; x++) voidCells.add(x+','+y);
028447: 			}
028448: 			lengths.push(rowEnd-rowStart);
028449: 			offsets.push(rowStart);
028450: 		}
028451: 		return {...p, lengths, offsets, voidCells};
028452: 	}

028515: 	function rebuildGameBoards_World4() {
028516: 		// World 3 is no longer the visible generator for World 4. It is called once to
028517: 		// keep legacy score/config plumbing initialized, then every playable zone is
028518: 		// replaced by a dedicated Citadel generator below.
028519: 		rebuildGameBoards_World3();
028520: 		try {
028521: 			const info=(typeof getWorldAndSubLevel==='function')?getWorldAndSubLevel(currentLevel):null;
028522: 			const subLevel=Number(info?.subLevel||1);
028523: 			applyWorld4YellowGeneration(subLevel);
028524: 			applyWorld4PurpleGeneration(subLevel);
028525: 			applyWorld4BlueGeneration(subLevel);
028526: 			applyWorld4GreenGeneration(subLevel);
028527: 			applyWorld4RedGeneration(subLevel);
028528: 			try { bumpGridVersion(); } catch (_) {}
028529: 		} catch(e){ console.warn('World 4 generation failed',e); }
028530: 		try { applyWorld4LocksForLevel(currentLevel); } catch(e){ console.warn('World 4 locks failed',e); }
028531: 		try { window.LocusTable?.schedule?.(); } catch(_) {}
028532: 		try { requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>applyInitialZoneAnchorsForCurrentLevel({force:true}))); } catch(_) {}
028533: 	}

028535: 	function applyWorld4LocksForLevel(level) {
028536: 		// Clear any previous state for this level (board is already rebuilt at this point)
028537: 		try { clearWorld4Locks(); } catch (e) {}
028538: 
028539: 			// World 4: start with a limited palette (random 3 of 5 zones per level).
028540: 			// IMPORTANT: keys/doors should only involve the active colors (no references to inactive zones).
028541: 			const activeColors = getWorld4ActiveColorsForLevel(level);
028542: 			const inactiveColors = WORLD4_ALL_COLORS.filter(c => !activeColors.includes(c));
028543: 			try { setWorld4AllowedColors(activeColors); } catch (e) {}
028544: 			try { if (!(world4UnlockedColors instanceof Set)) world4UnlockedColors = new Set(); world4UnlockedColors.clear(); window.world4UnlockedColors = world4UnlockedColors; } catch (e) {}
028545: 
028546: 		const worldInfo = (typeof getWorldAndSubLevel === 'function') ? getWorldAndSubLevel(level) : null;
028547: 		if (!worldInfo || Number(worldInfo.world) !== 4) return;
028548: 
028549: 		const greenZone = document.getElementById('green-zone');
028550: 		const purpleZone = document.getElementById('purple-zone');
028551: 		const blueZone = document.getElementById('blue-zone');
028552: 		const yellowZone = document.getElementById('yellow-zone');
028553: 		const redZone = document.getElementById('red-zone');
028554: 		if (!greenZone) return;
028555: 
028556: 		// Hide inactive zones at the start of the level.
028557: 		try {
028558: 			const hideZone = (colorKey) => {
028559: 				const c = String(colorKey || '').toLowerCase();
028560: 				if (c === 'rood') {
028561: 					if (redZone) redZone.style.display = 'none';
028562: 					return;
028563: 				}
028564: 				const z = document.querySelector(`.zone[data-color="${c}"]`) || document.getElementById(`${c}-zone`);
028565: 				if (z) z.style.display = 'none';
028566: 			};
028567: 			inactiveColors.forEach(hideZone);
028568: 		} catch (e) {}
028569: 
028570: 		// Ensure active zones are visible (in case a previous level hid them).
028571: 		try {
028572: 			const showZone = (colorKey) => {
028573: 				const c = String(colorKey || '').toLowerCase();
028574: 				if (c === 'rood') {
028575: 					if (redZone) redZone.style.display = '';
028576: 					return;
028577: 				}
028578: 				const z = document.querySelector(`.zone[data-color="${c}"]`) || document.getElementById(`${c}-zone`);
028579: 				if (z) z.style.display = '';
028580: 			};
028581: 			activeColors.forEach(showZone);
028582: 		} catch (e) {}

028584: 		function ensureCellSymbol(cell, cls, html) {
028585: 			if (!cell) return;
028586: 			try {
028587: 				let el = cell.querySelector(`.${cls}`);
028588: 				if (!el) {
028589: 					el = document.createElement('span');
028590: 					el.className = cls;
028591: 					cell.appendChild(el);
028592: 				}
028593: 				el.innerHTML = html;
028594: 			} catch (e) {}
028595: 		}

028597: 		// Use the nicer 4.2-style glyphs (emoji) for immediate readability.
028598: 		const ICON_KEY = '<span class="key-glyph" aria-hidden="true">🗝️</span>';
028599: 		const ICON_DOOR = '<span class="door-glyph" aria-hidden="true">🚪</span>';

028601: 		function isStampableCell(cell) {
028602: 			if (!cell) return false;
028603: 			if (cell.classList.contains('void-cell')) return false;
028604: 			if (cell.dataset.disabled === 'true') return false;
028605: 			if (cell.classList.contains('bold-cell')) return false;
028606: 			if (cell.classList.contains('active')) return false;
028607: 			if (cell.classList.contains('key-cell') || cell.classList.contains('door-cell')) return false;
028608: 			return true;
028609: 		}
028610: 
028611: 		function findNearestStampableCell(zone, preferredX, preferredY, maxRadius = 10) {
028612: 			if (!zone) return null;
028613: 			let metrics = null;
028614: 			try { metrics = (typeof getZoneMetrics === 'function') ? getZoneMetrics(zone) : null; } catch (e) { metrics = null; }
028615: 			const inBounds = (x, y) => {
028616: 				if (!metrics) return true;
028617: 				return x >= metrics.minX && x <= metrics.maxX && y >= metrics.minY && y <= metrics.maxY;
028618: 			};
028619: 			// Ring search around the preferred coordinate
028620: 			for (let r = 0; r <= maxRadius; r++) {
028621: 				for (let dy = -r; dy <= r; dy++) {
028622: 					for (let dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) {
028623: 						if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) !== r) continue;
028624: 						const x = preferredX + dx;
028625: 						const y = preferredY + dy;
028626: 						if (!inBounds(x, y)) continue;
028627: 						const c = getCell(zone, x, y);
028628: 						if (c && isStampableCell(c)) return c;
028629: 					}
028630: 				}
028631: 			}
028632: 			// Fallback: any stampable cell in zone
028633: 			try {
028634: 				const all = Array.from(zone.querySelectorAll('.cell')).filter(isStampableCell);
028635: 				return all.length ? all[0] : null;
028636: 			} catch (e) {
028637: 				return null;
028638: 			}
028639: 		}
028640: 
028641: 		function getZoneMetricsSafe(zone) {
028642: 			try {
028643: 				return (typeof getZoneMetrics === 'function') ? getZoneMetrics(zone) : null;
028644: 			} catch (e) {
028645: 				return null;
028646: 			}
028647: 		}
028648: 
028649: 		function clampRegionToMetrics(region, metrics) {
028650: 			if (!metrics || !region) return region;
028651: 			const minX = Number(metrics.minX);
028652: 			const maxX = Number(metrics.maxX);
028653: 			const minY = Number(metrics.minY);
028654: 			const maxY = Number(metrics.maxY);
028655: 			if (!Number.isFinite(minX) || !Number.isFinite(maxX) || !Number.isFinite(minY) || !Number.isFinite(maxY)) return region;
028656: 			const w = Math.max(1, Math.min(region.w, (maxX - minX + 1)));
028657: 			const h = Math.max(1, Math.min(region.h, (maxY - minY + 1)));
028658: 			const x0 = Math.max(minX, Math.min(region.x0, maxX - w + 1));
028659: 			const y0 = Math.max(minY, Math.min(region.y0, maxY - h + 1));
028660: 			return { x0, y0, w, h };
028661: 		}
028662: 
028663: 		function buildDoorPlacementForZone(zone, colorKey, index, doorCount, subLevel) {
028664: 			const metrics = getZoneMetricsSafe(zone);
028665: 			const minX = Number(metrics?.minX ?? 0);
028666: 			const maxX = Number(metrics?.maxX ?? 10);
028667: 			const minY = Number(metrics?.minY ?? 0);
028668: 			const maxY = Number(metrics?.maxY ?? 10);
028669: 			const width = Math.max(1, maxX - minX + 1);
028670: 			const height = Math.max(1, maxY - minY + 1);
028671: 			const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (Number(subLevel || 1) - 1) / 9));
028672: 			const doorX = minX + Math.round(width * (0.55 + (index % 2 === 0 ? 0.08 : -0.06)));
028673: 			const doorY = minY + Math.round(height * (0.35 + (index % 3) * 0.12));
028674: 			const baseW = Math.max(4, Math.round(width * (0.26 + t * 0.08)));
028675: 			const baseH = Math.max(4, Math.round(height * (0.24 + t * 0.10)));
028676: 			const regions = [
028677: 				{ x0: minX + Math.round(width * 0.62), y0: minY + Math.round(height * 0.12), w: baseW, h: baseH },
028678: 				{ x0: minX + Math.round(width * 0.12), y0: minY + Math.round(height * 0.62), w: baseW, h: baseH },
028679: 				{ x0: minX + Math.round(width * 0.58), y0: minY + Math.round(height * 0.58), w: baseW, h: baseH }
028680: 			].map(r => clampRegionToMetrics(r, metrics));
028681: 			return { x: doorX, y: doorY, regions };
028682: 		}
028683: 
028684: 		function lockRegionBehindDoor(zone, doorId, x0, y0, w, h) {
028685: 			if (!zone) return 0;
028686: 			let locked = 0;
028687: 			for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
028688: 				for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
028689: 					const cell = getCell(zone, x0 + x, y0 + y);
028690: 					if (!cell) continue;
028691: 					if (cell.dataset.doorId && String(cell.dataset.doorId) === String(doorId)) continue;
028692: 					if (cell.classList.contains('bold-cell')) continue;
028693: 					if (cell.classList.contains('active')) continue;
028694: 					cell.dataset.lockedDoorId = String(doorId);
028695: 					cell.classList.add('locked-behind-door');
028696: 					locked++;
028697: 				}
028698: 			}
028699: 			return locked;
028700: 		}
028701: 
028702: 		function tryLockRegion(zone, doorId, candidates) {
028703: 			if (!zone || !candidates || !candidates.length) return 0;
028704: 			for (const c of candidates) {
028705: 				const locked = lockRegionBehindDoor(zone, doorId, c.x0, c.y0, c.w, c.h);
028706: 				if (locked > 0) return locked;
028707: 			}
028708: 			return 0;
028709: 		}
028710: 
028711: 		function lockRegions(zone, doorId, candidates, maxRegions = 1) {
028712: 			if (!zone || !candidates || !candidates.length) return 0;
028713: 			let total = 0;
028714: 			let used = 0;
028715: 			for (const c of candidates) {
028716: 				if (used >= maxRegions) break;
028717: 				const locked = lockRegionBehindDoor(zone, doorId, c.x0, c.y0, c.w, c.h);
028718: 				if (locked > 0) {
028719: 					total += locked;
028720: 					used += 1;
028721: 				}
028722: 			}
028723: 			return total;
028724: 		}

028726: 		function placeDoor(zone, x, y, doorId, colorKey) {
028727: 			let cell = getCell(zone, x, y);
028728: 			if (!cell || !isStampableCell(cell)) {
028729: 				cell = findNearestStampableCell(zone, x, y, 12);
028730: 			}
028731: 			if (!cell) return null;
028732: 			// Visual ink: always match the zone this door is placed in (active color).
028733: 			try {
028734: 				const ink = String(zone && zone.dataset ? (zone.dataset.color || '') : '').toLowerCase();
028735: 				if (ink) cell.dataset.w4Ink = ink;
028736: 			} catch (_) {}
028737: 			// Ensure door cells don't also act as bonus/coin/trap cells
028738: 			try {
028739: 				cell.classList.remove('gold-cell', 'trap-cell');
028740: 				delete cell.dataset.trap;
028741: 				delete cell.dataset.trapType;
028742: 				delete cell.dataset.trapTriggered;
028743: 				cell.querySelectorAll('.symbol,.trap-symbol').forEach(s => s.remove());
028744: 			} catch (e) {}
028745: 			cell.classList.add('door-cell');
028746: 			cell.dataset.doorId = String(doorId);
028747: 			cell.dataset.doorColor = String(colorKey);
028748: 			ensureCellSymbol(cell, 'door-symbol', ICON_DOOR);
028749: 			return cell;
028750: 		}

028815: 		const pickKeyCellBehindDoor = (doorId) => {
028816: 			try {

028818: 				const viable = locked.filter(c => c && !c.classList.contains('door-cell') && !c.classList.contains('key-cell') && !c.classList.contains('bold-cell'));
028819: 				if (!viable.length) return null;
028820: 				const idx = Math.floor(rng() * viable.length);
028821: 				return viable[idx] || null;
028822: 			} catch (e) { return null; }

028825: 		const pickZoneKeyAnchor = (zone, anchor = null) => {
028826: 			const metrics = getZoneMetricsSafe(zone);
028827: 			const minX = Number(metrics?.minX ?? 1);
028828: 			const maxX = Number(metrics?.maxX ?? 8);
028829: 			const minY = Number(metrics?.minY ?? 1);
028830: 			const maxY = Number(metrics?.maxY ?? 8);
028831: 			const fx = Array.isArray(anchor) ? Number(anchor[0]) : 0.15;
028832: 			const fy = Array.isArray(anchor) ? Number(anchor[1]) : 0.15;
028833: 			const x = minX + Math.max(0, Math.round((maxX - minX) * (Number.isFinite(fx) ? fx : 0.15)));
028834: 			const y = minY + Math.max(0, Math.round((maxY - minY) * (Number.isFinite(fy) ? fy : 0.15)));
028835: 			return { x, y };
028836: 		};
028837: 
028838: 		if (campaignConfig && Array.isArray(campaignConfig.doors)) {

028854: 			});
028855: 
028856: 			// Keys may live in another zone or, in later levels, behind an earlier door.
028857: 			specs.forEach((spec, idx) => {
028858: 				const targetColor = String(spec.keyColor || spec.zone || '').toLowerCase();
028859: 				let placed = false;
028860: 				if (spec.keyBehind) {

028863: 				}
028864: 				if (!placed) {

028866: 					if (keyZone) {

028871: 			});
028872: 		} else {

028874: 			const doorColors = shuffleWithRng(activeColors.slice(), rng).slice(0, doorCount);

028876: 			doorColors.forEach((doorColor, idx) => {

028891: 					const lockedCell = prev ? pickKeyCellBehindDoor(prev.doorId) : null;
028892: 					if (lockedCell && placeKeyOnCell(lockedCell, targetDoorColor)) placed = true;
028893: 				}
028894: 				if (placed) return;

028896: 				const fallbackZones = activeColors.map(c => activeZonesByColor[c]).filter(Boolean);

028899: 					const z = zones[(zi + i) % zones.length];
028900: 					const coord = pickZoneKeyAnchor(z);
028901: 					if (placeKey(z, coord.x, coord.y, targetDoorColor)) placed = true;
028902: 				}
028903: 			});
028904: 		}

029789: 	// Pas zone groottes dynamisch aan voor World 2 grids
029790: 	function enableZoneDragScroll(zoneEl, opts = {}) {
029791: 		if (!zoneEl) return;
029792: 		if (zoneEl.dataset.dragScrollEnabled === 'true') return;
029793: 		zoneEl.dataset.dragScrollEnabled = 'true';
029794: 		const ignoreSelectors = opts.ignoreSelectors || '.card,.card-option,#controls,#bottom-bar';
029795: 		const threshold = typeof opts.threshold === 'number' ? opts.threshold : 6;
029796: 		let activePointerId = null;
029797: 		let startX = 0;
029798: 		let startY = 0;
029799: 		let startScrollLeft = 0;
029800: 		let startScrollTop = 0;
029801: 		let moved = false;
029802: 		let dragRaf = null;
029803: 		let pendingDx = 0;
029804: 		let pendingDy = 0;
029805: 
029806: 		zoneEl.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
029807: 			if (window.LocusTable?.enabled()) return; // The table owns mouse pan; touch stays native.
029808: 			if (e.button !== undefined && e.button !== 0) return; // left button only
029809: 			if (e.pointerType === 'touch') return; // allow native touch scrolling/swiping on mobile
029810: 			// Don't hijack pointer drags while placing a block.
029811: 			if (typeof draggedBlock !== 'undefined' && draggedBlock) return;
029812: 			if (typeof draggedShape !== 'undefined' && draggedShape) return;
029813: 			if (typeof activeBonusPlacement !== 'undefined' && activeBonusPlacement) return;
029814: 			if (ignoreSelectors && e.target.closest(ignoreSelectors)) return;
029815: 			activePointerId = e.pointerId;
029816: 			moved = false;
029817: 			startX = e.clientX;
029818: 			startY = e.clientY;
029819: 			startScrollLeft = zoneEl.scrollLeft;
029820: 			startScrollTop = zoneEl.scrollTop;
029821: 			zoneEl.dataset.dragScrolling = 'false';
029822: 			zoneEl.classList.add('drag-scroll-active');
029823: 			try { zoneEl.setPointerCapture(activePointerId); } catch (_) {}
029824: 		});
029825: 
029826: 		zoneEl.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
029827: 			if (activePointerId === null || e.pointerId !== activePointerId) return;
029828: 			const dx = e.clientX - startX;
029829: 			const dy = e.clientY - startY;
029830: 			if (!moved && (Math.abs(dx) > threshold || Math.abs(dy) > threshold)) {
029831: 				moved = true;
029832: 				zoneEl.dataset.dragScrolling = 'true';
029833: 			}
029834: 			if (!moved) return;
029835: 			e.preventDefault();
029836: 			pendingDx = dx;
029837: 			pendingDy = dy;
029838: 			if (!dragRaf) {
029839: 				dragRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
029840: 					zoneEl.scrollLeft = startScrollLeft - pendingDx;
029841: 					zoneEl.scrollTop = startScrollTop - pendingDy;
029842: 					dragRaf = null;
029843: 				});
029844: 			}
029845: 		}, { passive: false });
029846: 
029847: 		const endDrag = () => {
029848: 			if (activePointerId === null) return;
029849: 			activePointerId = null;
029850: 			zoneEl.classList.remove('drag-scroll-active');
029851: 			// Keep the "dragScrolling" flag briefly so pointerup on a cell can detect it.
029852: 			if (zoneEl.dataset.dragScrolling === 'true') {
029853: 				setTimeout(() => { zoneEl.dataset.dragScrolling = 'false'; }, 0);
029854: 			}
029855: 		};
029856: 		zoneEl.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
029857: 		zoneEl.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
029858: 	}
029859: 
029860: 	function adjustZoneSizesForWorld2() {
029861: 		if (window.LocusTable?.enabled()) { window.LocusTable.schedule(); return; }
029862: 	  // Mobile zoom: sizing is handled by CSS to keep all zoomed zones uniform across worlds.
029863: 	  // IMPORTANT: Inline styles override CSS, so we must clear any previously-set widths/heights while zoomed.
029864: 	  try {
029865: 		const isZoomedIn = document.body.classList.contains('zoomed-in');
029866: 		const isMobileZoomSizing = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia)
029867: 			? window.matchMedia('(max-width: 650px), (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)').matches
029868: 			: (window.innerWidth <= 650);
029869: 		if (isZoomedIn && isMobileZoomSizing) {
029870: 			['yellow-zone', 'green-zone', 'blue-zone', 'purple-zone', 'red-zone'].forEach(id => {
029871: 				const el = document.getElementById(id);
029872: 				if (!el || !el.style) return;
029873: 				el.style.removeProperty('width');
029874: 				el.style.removeProperty('height');
029875: 				el.style.removeProperty('min-width');
029876: 				el.style.removeProperty('max-width');
029877: 				el.style.removeProperty('min-height');
029878: 				el.style.removeProperty('max-height');
029879: 			});
029880: 			return;
029881: 		}
029882: 	  } catch (e) {}
029883: 	  // Gebruik de echte --cell-size CSS variabele voor consistente sizing tussen werelden
029884: 	  const computedCellSize = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--cell-size')) || 26;
029885: 	  const cellSize = Math.max(18, Math.min(30, computedCellSize)); // Clamp between 18 and 30

029889: 	  const isWorld3 = !!(worldInfo && worldInfo.world === 3);
029890: 	  const isWorld4 = !!(worldInfo && worldInfo.world === 4);
029891: 	  const isPortrait = window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth;
029892: 	  const isShortHeight = window.innerHeight <= 925;
029893: 	  const isDesktopPortraitLayout = document.body.classList.contains('desktop-portrait')
029894: 			&& !document.body.classList.contains('mobile-sidebar-layout')
029895: 			&& !document.body.classList.contains('touch-portrait');
029896: 	  // Purple needs extra vertical chrome so it never clips (header/padding/outline).
029897: 	  const purpleChromePx = isDesktopPortraitLayout ? 50 : 40;
029898: 	  const tallZoneMaxVh = isPortrait ? '52vh' : (isShortHeight ? '65vh' : '85vh');
029899: 	  // Green should be visibly shorter so the rest of the UI fits, but still scrollable.
029900: 	  // User request: make it ~40px shorter.
029901: 	  const greenZoneMaxVh = isPortrait ? 'calc(40vh - 40px)' : (isShortHeight ? 'calc(50vh - 40px)' : 'calc(52vh - 40px)');
029902: 	  const tallZoneMaxPx = isPortrait ? 600 : (isShortHeight ? 800 : 1200);
029903: 	  
029904: 	  // Geel zone - iets korter
029905: 	  const yellowGrid = document.getElementById('yellow-grid');

030631: // Sanitize a board HTML snapshot so it never contains runtime-placed cells or inline styles.
030632: // IMPORTANT: Preserve inline styles for grids using absolute positioning (green/red).
030633: function sanitizeBoardHtml(html) {
030634: 	try {
030635: 		const tmp = document.createElement('div');
030636: 		tmp.innerHTML = html || '';
030637: 		tmp.querySelectorAll('.cell').forEach(cell => {
030638: 			// Preserve symbols/bonus visuals; only clear runtime-filled state
030639: 			try { cell.classList.remove('active', 'edge-cell'); } catch (e) {}
030640: 			// Check if this cell uses absolute positioning (green/red zones)
030641: 			// These rely on inline left/top for placement - do NOT remove their styles
030642: 			// Red subgrids (red-grid1, red-grid2, etc.) have cells directly inside, no .grid child
030643: 			const grid = cell.closest('.grid');
030644: 			const zone = cell.closest('.zone');
030645: 			const isGreenGrid = (grid && grid.id === 'green-grid') || (zone && zone.dataset && zone.dataset.color === 'groen');
030646: 			const isRedGrid = (zone && zone.id && zone.id.startsWith('red-grid')) ||
030647: 				(zone && zone.dataset && zone.dataset.color === 'rood') ||
030648: 				(zone && zone.classList && zone.classList.contains('red-group'));
030649: 			const usesAbsolutePositioning = isAbsolutePositionedGrid(cell);
030650: 			// Only remove inline styles for CSS Grid-based zones, not absolute-positioned ones
030651: 			if (!usesAbsolutePositioning) {
030652: 				try { cell.removeAttribute('style'); } catch (e) {}
030653: 			}
030654: 		});
030655: 		// Also remove any floating info popovers in zones
030656: 		tmp.querySelectorAll('.zone-info-btn, .zone-info-popover, .zone-handle, .grid-resizer, .zone-delete').forEach(n => n.remove());
030657: 		return tmp.innerHTML;
030658: 	} catch (e) {
030659: 		return html;
030660: 	}
030661: }

030672: function clearWorld4Locks() {
030673: 	try {
030674: 		try { window.LocusWorld4?.cleanup?.(); } catch (_) {}
030675: 		world4UnlockedColors = new Set();
030676: 		window.world4UnlockedColors = world4UnlockedColors;

030678: 		try {
030679: 			['yellow-zone','green-zone','blue-zone','purple-zone','red-zone'].forEach(id => {
030680: 				const z = document.getElementById(id);
030681: 				if (z) z.style.display = '';
030682: 			});
030683: 		} catch (e) {}
030684: 		// Remove any lingering door/key visuals + locked regions

030691: 				delete el.dataset.keyColor;

030706: function setWorld4UnlockedColors(colors) {
030707: 	try {

030709: 		window.world4UnlockedColors = world4UnlockedColors;
030710: 		document.querySelectorAll('.cell.door-cell[data-door-color]').forEach(cell => {

030713: 		});

030717: function unlockWorld4Color(color) {
030718: 	const key = String(color || '').toLowerCase();
030719: 	if (!key) return;
030720: 	if (!(world4UnlockedColors instanceof Set)) world4UnlockedColors = new Set();
030721: 	if (world4UnlockedColors.has(key)) return;
030722: 	world4UnlockedColors.add(key);
030723: 	window.world4UnlockedColors = world4UnlockedColors;
030724: 	// Add to the allowed palette (hand cards become playable) and reveal the zone.
030725: 	try {
030726: 		if (!world4AllowedColors || !world4AllowedColors.length) {
030727: 			setWorld4AllowedColors([key]);
030728: 		} else if (!world4AllowedColors.includes(key)) {
030729: 			setWorld4AllowedColors(world4AllowedColors.concat([key]));
030730: 		}
030731: 	} catch (e) {}
030732: 	try {
030733: 		if (key === 'rood') {
030734: 			const rz = document.getElementById('red-zone');
030735: 			if (rz) rz.style.display = '';
030736: 		} else {
030737: 			const z = document.querySelector(`.zone[data-color="${key}"]`) || document.getElementById(`${key}-zone`);
030738: 			if (z) z.style.display = '';
030739: 		}
030740: 	} catch (e) {}
030741: 	// Arm matching doors (visual cue); door still requires activation to open.
030742: 	try {
030743: 		document.querySelectorAll(`.cell.door-cell[data-door-color]`).forEach(cell => {
030744: 			const c = String(cell.dataset.doorColor || '').toLowerCase();
030745: 			if (c !== key) return;
030746: 			cell.classList.add('door-armed');
030747: 		});
030748: 	} catch (e) {}
030749: 	try { if (typeof renderCurrentHand === 'function') renderCurrentHand(); } catch (e) {}
030750: 	try { if (typeof updateBonusInventoryUI === 'function') updateBonusInventoryUI(); } catch (e) {}
030751: 	try { window.LocusWorld4?.onKeyActivated?.(key); } catch (_) {}
030752: }

030754: function isWorld4DoorOpen(doorId) {
030755: 	const id = String(doorId || '').trim();
030756: 	if (!id) return false;
030757: 	try {
030758: 		const door = document.querySelector(`.cell.door-cell[data-door-id="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`);
030759: 		return !!(door && door.classList.contains('door-open'));
030760: 	} catch (e) {
030761: 		// Fallback if CSS.escape isn't available
030762: 		try {
030763: 			const door = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cell.door-cell')).find(el => String(el.dataset.doorId || '') === id);
030764: 			return !!(door && door.classList.contains('door-open'));
030765: 		} catch (_) { return false; }
030766: 	}
030767: }

030769: function openWorld4Door(doorId) {
030770: 	const id = String(doorId || '').trim();
030771: 	if (!id) return;
030772: 	let door = null;
030773: 	try {
030774: 		door = document.querySelector(`.cell.door-cell[data-door-id="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`);
030775: 	} catch (e) {
030776: 		door = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cell.door-cell')).find(el => String(el.dataset.doorId || '') === id) || null;
030777: 	}
030778: 	if (!door) return;
030779: 	const wasOpen = door.classList.contains('door-open');
030780: 	if (!wasOpen) {
030781: 		door.classList.add('door-open');
030782: 		door.classList.remove('door-armed');
030783: 		try { showObjectiveToast('🚪 Deur geopend!'); } catch (e) {}
030784: 		// World 4 upgrade: opening a door grants a free placement
030785: 		try {
030786: 			if (hasUpgrade('world4DoorSurge')) {
030787: 				freePlacementsRemaining += 1;
030788: 				updateBonusInventoryUI();
030789: 				showObjectiveToast('⚡ Gratis plaatsing ontvangen!');
030790: 			}
030791: 		} catch (e) {}
030792: 	}
030793: 	// Unlock the region behind this door
030794: 	try {
030795: 		document.querySelectorAll(`.cell[data-locked-door-id]`).forEach(cell => {
030796: 			if (String(cell.dataset.lockedDoorId || '') !== id) return;
030797: 			try { delete cell.dataset.lockedDoorId; } catch (_) {}
030798: 			cell.classList.remove('locked-behind-door');
030799: 		});
030800: 	} catch (e) {}
030801: 	if (!wasOpen) {
030802: 		try { window.LocusWorld4?.onDoorOpened?.(id); } catch (_) {}
030803: 	}
030804: }

030807: 	if (!world4AllowedColors || !world4AllowedColors.length) return true;

030809: 	if (name === 'multikleur') return true;
030810: 	return world4AllowedColors.includes(name);
030811: }

030813: 	function loadGameState() {
030814: 	  try {
030815: 		const saved = localStorage.getItem('locusGameSave');
030816: 		if (!saved) {
030817: 		  return false;
030818: 		}
030819: 		
030820: 		const gameState = JSON.parse(saved);
030821: 		if (!gameState) {
030822: 		  console.error('❌ Failed to parse save data');
030823: 		  return false;
030824: 		}
030825: 		const savedBonusEchoState = gameState.bonusEchoState ? { ...gameState.bonusEchoState } : null;
030826: 		const savedWorld4State = gameState.world4State || null;
030827: 		const savedPreLevelStarterPicksDone = (typeof gameState.preLevelStarterPicksDone === 'boolean') ? gameState.preLevelStarterPicksDone : null;
030828: 		const savedStarterPicksDoneByWorld = (gameState && gameState.starterPicksDoneByWorld && typeof gameState.starterPicksDoneByWorld === 'object')
030829: 			? gameState.starterPicksDoneByWorld
030830: 			: null;
030831: 		
030832: 		if (gameState.version !== '1.0') {
030833: 		  console.warn('⚠️ Save version mismatch:', gameState.version);
030834: 		  return false;
030835: 		}
030836: 		
030837: 		
030838: 		// Determine if this save represents an editor/scenario/custom-board session.
030839: 		// IMPORTANT: Old saves may contain boardHtml snapshots from normal runs; we must ignore those.
030840: 		const isCustomBoardSave = (() => {
030841: 			try {
030842: 				if (gameState.customBoard === true) return true;
030843: 				if (gameState.loadedCustomLevelMeta) return true;
030844: 				if (Array.isArray(gameState.scenarioAllowedColors) && gameState.scenarioAllowedColors.length) return true;
030845: 			} catch (e) {}
030846: 			return false;
030847: 		})();
030848: 		// Apply run mode flags for this session.
030849: 		try {
030850: 			const runMode = String(gameState.runMode || (isCustomBoardSave ? 'custom' : 'normal'));
030851: 			if (window) {
030852: 				window._locusScenarioMode = (runMode === 'scenario');
030853: 				window._locusScenarioLoaded = (runMode === 'scenario');
030854: 				window._locusRunMode = runMode;
030855: 			}
030856: 		} catch (e) {}
030857: 		
030858: 		// Restore level (world will be derived from level for normal runs)
030859: 		// IMPORTANT: do not use `|| 1` here; level 0 is a valid intro level.
030860: 		const rawSavedLevel = (gameState && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(gameState, 'currentLevel'))
030861: 			? gameState.currentLevel
030862: 			: null;
030863: 		let loadedLevel = Number(rawSavedLevel);
030864: 		if (!Number.isFinite(loadedLevel)) loadedLevel = 1;
030865: 		loadedLevel = Math.max(0, loadedLevel);
030866: 		// Heuristic: if a save claims level 0 but contains evidence of later-level progress,
030867: 		// infer the most likely level from objective history and purchased upgrades.
030868: 		if (loadedLevel === 0) {
030869: 			let inferred = 0;
030870: 			try {
030871: 				const parseLevelFromObjectiveId = (id) => {
030872: 					if (!id) return null;
030873: 					const s = String(id);
030874: 					const m = s.match(/\blevel[-_](\d{1,2})\b/i);
030875: 					if (!m) return null;
030876: 					const n = Number(m[1]);
030877: 					return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
030878: 				};
030879: 
030880: 				let maxCompletedLevel = 0;
030881: 				// First: infer from saved objective IDs directly (works even when OBJECTIVES is randomized).
030882: 				const ids = [];
030883: 				if (gameState.currentObjectiveId) ids.push(gameState.currentObjectiveId);
030884: 				if (Array.isArray(gameState.completedObjectiveIds)) ids.push(...gameState.completedObjectiveIds);
030885: 				if (Array.isArray(gameState.completedObjectives)) {
030886: 					gameState.completedObjectives.forEach(o => { if (o && o.id) ids.push(o.id); });
030887: 				}
030888: 				ids.forEach(id => {
030889: 					const lvl = parseLevelFromObjectiveId(id);
030890: 					if (Number.isFinite(lvl)) maxCompletedLevel = Math.max(maxCompletedLevel, lvl);
030891: 				});
030892: 
030893: 				// If currentObjectiveId maps to a known objective, that can also hint the current level.
030894: 				try {
030895: 					if (typeof getObjectiveById === 'function' && gameState.currentObjectiveId) {
030896: 						const obj = getObjectiveById(gameState.currentObjectiveId);
030897: 						const lvl = Number(obj && obj.level);
030898: 						if (Number.isFinite(lvl) && lvl > 0) inferred = Math.max(inferred, lvl);
030899: 					}
030900: 				} catch (e) {}
030901: 
030902: 				// If we have any objective evidence beyond 0, assume we're at least that level (or next).
030903: 				if (maxCompletedLevel > 0) inferred = Math.max(inferred, maxCompletedLevel + 1);
030904: 
030905: 				// Second: infer from purchased upgrades (world2/world3-only upgrades imply higher levels).
030906: 				try {
030907: 					let minByUpgrades = 0;
030908: 					if (gameState.upgrades && typeof gameState.upgrades === 'object') {
030909: 						Object.entries(gameState.upgrades).forEach(([key, purchased]) => {
030910: 							if (!purchased) return;
030911: 							const meta = (typeof UNLOCK_PROGRESSION === 'object' && UNLOCK_PROGRESSION && UNLOCK_PROGRESSION.upgrades)
030912: 								? UNLOCK_PROGRESSION.upgrades[key]
030913: 								: null;
030914: 							const lvl = Number(meta && meta.unlockedAtLevel);
030915: 							if (Number.isFinite(lvl)) minByUpgrades = Math.max(minByUpgrades, lvl);
030916: 						});
030917: 					}
030918: 					if (minByUpgrades > 0) inferred = Math.max(inferred, minByUpgrades);
030919: 				} catch (e) {}
030920: 			} catch (e) { inferred = 0; }
030921: 			if (inferred > 0) {
030922: 				console.warn('⚠️ Save reported level 0, inferred level from objectives:', inferred);
030923: 				loadedLevel = inferred;
030924: 			}
030925: 		}
030926: 		currentLevel = loadedLevel;
030927: 		// World 3 red progression: always start at stage 1 on load (do not carry stage 2 across reloads).
030928: 		world3RedStage = 1;
030929: 		turnCount = gameState.turnCount || 0;
030930: 		// Loading a non-intro level should never keep the intro deck flag.
030931: 		if (currentLevel > 0) {
030932: 			introDeckActive = false;
030933: 		}
030934: 		
030935: 		// Restore scenario/editor meta early so startLevel can filter decks if needed
030936: 		try { window.scenarioAllowedColors = isCustomBoardSave ? (gameState.scenarioAllowedColors || null) : null; } catch (e) {}
030937: 		try {
030938: 			if (isCustomBoardSave && gameState.loadedCustomLevelMeta) {
030939: 				window.loadedCustomLevelMeta = gameState.loadedCustomLevelMeta;
030940: 				window.loadedCustomObjectiveCompiled = null;
030941: 				window.loadedCustomLevelMetaCompleted = false;
030942: 				if (window.loadedCustomLevelMeta && window.loadedCustomLevelMeta.objective) {
030943: 					try { window.loadedCustomObjectiveCompiled = parseObjectiveTextToObjective(String(window.loadedCustomLevelMeta.objective || '').trim()); } catch (e) { window.loadedCustomObjectiveCompiled = null; }
030944: 				}
030945: 			} else {
030946: 				window.loadedCustomLevelMeta = null;
030947: 				window.loadedCustomObjectiveCompiled = null;
030948: 				window.loadedCustomLevelMetaCompleted = false;
030949: 			}
030950: 		} catch (e) {}
030951: 		
030952: 		// Restore upgrades
030953: 		if (gameState.upgrades) {
030954: 		  Object.keys(gameState.upgrades).forEach(key => {
030955: 			if (UPGRADES[key]) {
030956: 			  UPGRADES[key].purchased = gameState.upgrades[key];
030957: 			  return;
030958: 			}
030959: 			// Back-compat: compactCards was renamed/merged into miniPack34.
030960: 			if (key === 'compactCards' && UPGRADES.miniPack34) {
030961: 			  UPGRADES.miniPack34.purchased = gameState.upgrades[key];
030962: 			}
030963: 		  });
030964: 		}
030965: 		
030966: 		// Restore bonuses
030967: 		if (gameState.bonusInventory) {
030968: 		  Object.keys(gameState.bonusInventory).forEach(key => {
030969: 			bonusInventory[key] = gameState.bonusInventory[key];
030970: 		  });
030971: 		}
030972: 		if (gameState.bonusMasteryState) {
030973: 		  Object.keys(gameState.bonusMasteryState).forEach(key => {
030974: 			bonusMasteryState[key] = gameState.bonusMasteryState[key];
030975: 		  });
030976: 		}
030977: 		if (gameState.bonusEchoState) {
030978: 			try {
030979: 				const savedEcho = gameState.bonusEchoState || {};
030980: 				colorScoreBonuses = { ...colorScoreBonuses, ...(savedEcho.colorScoreBonuses || {}) };
030981: 				bonusEchoExtraTurns = Number(savedEcho.bonusEchoExtraTurns || 0);
030982: 				bonusEchoStreak = Number(savedEcho.bonusEchoStreak || 0);
030983: 				bonusEchoFreePlays = Number(savedEcho.bonusEchoFreePlays || 0);
030984: 				lastCardWasBonusEcho = !!savedEcho.lastCardWasBonusEcho;
030985: 				lastBonusEchoVariant = savedEcho.lastBonusEchoVariant || null;
030986: 			} catch (e) { resetBonusEchoState(); }
030987: 		} else {
030988: 			resetBonusEchoState();
030989: 		}
030990: 		// Restore starter pick completion so world-start pickers are respected after load
030991: 		starterPicksDoneByWorld = {};
030992: 		if (savedStarterPicksDoneByWorld) {
030993: 			try {
030994: 				Object.keys(savedStarterPicksDoneByWorld).forEach((k) => {
030995: 					starterPicksDoneByWorld[String(k)] = !!savedStarterPicksDoneByWorld[k];
030996: 				});
030997: 			} catch (e) { starterPicksDoneByWorld = {}; }
030998: 			// Back-compat: ensure old boolean applies to world 1.
030999: 			if (typeof savedPreLevelStarterPicksDone === 'boolean') {
031000: 				starterPicksDoneByWorld['1'] = !!savedPreLevelStarterPicksDone;
031001: 			}
031002: 		} else {
031003: 			// Back-compat + anti-surprise: older saves didn't track this per world.
031004: 			// Infer that already-passed worlds are done, and if we're mid-world, mark the current world as done
031005: 			// so loading doesn't immediately pop a picker.
031006: 			try {
031007: 				const info = getWorldAndSubLevel(Number(currentLevel) || 0);
031008: 				const wNow = Number(info && info.world) || 1;
031009: 				const sNow = Number(info && info.subLevel) || 1;
031010: 				for (let w = 1; w < wNow; w += 1) starterPicksDoneByWorld[String(w)] = true;
031011: 				if (sNow > 1) starterPicksDoneByWorld[String(wNow)] = true;
031012: 			} catch (e) {}
031013: 			if (typeof savedPreLevelStarterPicksDone === 'boolean') {
031014: 				starterPicksDoneByWorld['1'] = !!savedPreLevelStarterPicksDone;
031015: 			}
031016: 		}
031017: 		preLevelStarterPicksDone = !!starterPicksDoneByWorld['1'];
031018: 		preLevelStarterPicksInProgress = false;
031019: 		
031020: 		// Restore objectives
031021: 		currentObjectiveId = gameState.currentObjectiveId || null;
031022: 		completedObjectives.length = 0;
031023: 		if (gameState.completedObjectives) {
031024: 		  gameState.completedObjectives.forEach(obj => completedObjectives.push(obj));
031025: 		}
031026: 		completedObjectiveIds.clear();
031027: 		if (gameState.completedObjectiveIds) {
031028: 		  gameState.completedObjectiveIds.forEach(id => completedObjectiveIds.add(id));
031029: 		}
031030: 		
031031: 		// Restore deck
031032: 		if (gameState.ownedDeckBlueprints && gameState.ownedDeckBlueprints.length > 0) {
031033: 		  ownedDeckBlueprints = gameState.ownedDeckBlueprints.map(bp => {
031034: 			const colorObj = bp.color ? 
031035: 			  (bp.color.isGolden ? 
031036: 				{ name: bp.color.name, code: bp.color.code, isGolden: true } : 
031037: 				colors.find(c => c.name === bp.color.name) || bp.color
031038: 			  ) : null;
031039: 			
031040: 			// Valideer dat matrix bestaat
031041: 			if (!bp.matrix || !Array.isArray(bp.matrix)) {
031042: 			  console.error('Invalid matrix in blueprint:', bp);
031043: 			  return null;
031044: 			}
031045: 			
031046: 			return {
031047: 			  blueprintId: bp.blueprintId || nextBlueprintId(),
031048: 			  shapeName: bp.shapeName || 'unknown',
031049: 			  matrix: bp.matrix,
031050: 			  category: bp.category || 'standard',
031051: 			  color: colorObj,
031052: 			  isGolden: bp.isGolden || false,
031053: 			  isBonusBoost: bp.isBonusBoost || false,
031054: 			  isBonusEcho: bp.isBonusEcho || false,
031055: 			  bonusEchoVariant: bp.bonusEchoVariant || (bp.isBonusEcho ? 'replay' : null)
031056: 			};
031057: 		  }).filter(bp => bp !== null);
031058: 		  
031059: 		  // Als er geen valide blueprints zijn, reset naar standard
031060: 		  if (ownedDeckBlueprints.length === 0) {
031061: 			console.warn('No valid blueprints loaded, resetting to standard deck');
031062: 			resetDeckToStandard();
031063: 		  }

031345: 	function completeRound() {
031346: 	  if (currentHand.length !== 0 || drawPile.length !== 0) {
031347: 		return;
031348: 	  }
031349: 	  if (bonusEchoExtraTurns > 0 && Array.isArray(discardPile) && discardPile.length > 0) {
031350: 		if (prepareBonusEchoExtraTurnDeck()) {
031351: 			drawNextHand();
031352: 			updateDeckPreview();
031353: 			return;
031354: 		}
031355: 	  }
031356: 		const score = Number(document.getElementById('total-score')?.textContent || '0') || 0;
031357: 		const coinsBeforeBonus = getSpendableCoinCount();
031358: 		grantRoundScoreCoins(score);
031359: 		const coinsAfterBonus = getSpendableCoinCount();
031360: 		const bonusCoins = Math.max(0, coinsAfterBonus - coinsBeforeBonus);
031361: 		const coins = coinsAfterBonus;
031362: 		const objectiveCleared = isCurrentObjectiveCompleted();
031363: 		const success = objectiveCleared;
031364: 		lastRoundFailureReason = success ? null : 'objective';
031365: 		showRoundModal(success, score, coins, bonusCoins);
031366: 	}

031368: 	function finalizeRoundCompletion() {
031369: 		let handWasDiscarded = false;
031370: 		if (currentHand.length > 0) {
031371: 			const objectiveComplete = isCurrentObjectiveCompleted();
031372: 			if (cardsPlayedThisTurn === 0 && !objectiveComplete) return;
031373: 			discardCurrentHand();
031374: 			handWasDiscarded = true;
031375: 		}
031376: 		cardsPlayedThisTurn = 0;
031377: 		if (!handWasDiscarded) {
031378: 			renderCurrentHand();
031379: 		}
031380: 		completeRound();
031381: 	}
