031465: 	function selectCard(card, shape, color, options = {}) {
031466: 		if (!card) return;
031467: 		if (card.classList.contains('selection-disabled') && card !== selectedCardElement) return;
031468: 		// BUG FIX: Als er een bonusblokje actief is en we klikken op een kaart,
031469: 		// moet het bonusblok eerst geannuleerd worden om transformatie/kopiëren te voorkomen.
031470: 		if (activeBonusPlacement) {
031471: 			cancelActiveBonusPlacement({ updateInventory: true, hidePreview: true });
031472: 		}
031473: 		const forceDrag = !!options.forceDrag;
031474: 		const isMobileLayout = isMobileViewport();
031475: 		const isTouchDevice = ('ontouchstart' in window || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0);
031476: 		// Touch UX: alleen een draggable block spawnen als forceDrag true is (bij slepen/long-press).
031477: 		// Een normale tap moet alleen selecteren en floating preview + control buttons tonen.
031478: 		const shouldSpawnBlock = forceDrag;
031479: 		const isSameCard = (selectedCardElement === card) || (!!selectedCardId && !!card?.dataset?.cardId && selectedCardId === card.dataset.cardId);
031480: 		if (isSameCard && !forceDrag) {
031481: 			cancelDesktopHoverDragKeepSelection({ showPreview: false });
031482: 			// Clear any selected styling (DOM can be re-rendered, so be defensive).
031483: 			document.querySelectorAll('.card-option.selected').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('selected'));
031484: 			selectedCardId = null;
031485: 			selectedCardElement = null;
031486: 			selectedShape = null;
031487: 			selectedColor = null;
031488: 			if (rotateButton) rotateButton.disabled = true;
031489: 			if (mirrorButton) mirrorButton.disabled = true;
031490: 			if (draggedBlock) cleanupDragState({ clearBonus: false });
031491: 			hideFloatingPreview();
031492: 			removeCardControlButtons();
031493: 			// UX: deselecting a card should also exit zoomed-in view.
031494: 			closeZoom();
031495: 			applyTurnCardLocks();
031496: 			// Voorkom dat een snelle tweede klik direct weer selecteert
031497: 			suppressCardSelectUntil = Date.now() + 500;
031498: 			return;
031499: 		}
031500: 		// For any other selection, always allow switching to a new card immediately.
031501: 		// If we are starting a drag from the currently selected card, remove the old drag
031502: 		// block without clearing the card selection.

034879: 	function tryLoadScenarioFromUrl() {
034880: 		try {
034881: 			try {
034882: 				if (window._locusScenarioLoaded) return true;
034883: 			} catch (e) {}
034884: 			const href = String(window.location && window.location.href || '');
034885: 			const url = new URL(href);
034886: 			let token = url.searchParams.get('scenario') || '';
034887: 			if (!token) {
034888: 				// Support hash: #scenario=...
034889: 				const h = String(url.hash || '').replace(/^#/, '');
034890: 				if (h.startsWith('scenario=')) token = h.slice('scenario='.length);
034891: 				else {
034892: 					const m = h.match(/(?:^|&)scenario=([^&]+)/);
034893: 					if (m && m[1]) token = m[1];
034894: 				}
034895: 			}
034896: 			token = String(token || '').trim();
034897: 			if (!token) return false;
034898: 			const payload = decodeScenarioPayload(token);
034899: 			if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return false;
034900: 
034901: 			// Back-compat: some payloads used 'w'
034902: 			if (payload.world == null && payload.w != null) payload.world = payload.w;
034903: 			return loadScenarioLikeToGame(payload, { source: 'URL-scenario' });
034904: 		} catch (e) {
034905: 			console.error('Scenario URL load failed', e);
034906: 			return false;
034907: 		}
034908: 	}

034921: 				const scenario = JSON.parse(text);
034922:

034924: 				if (!scenario || scenario._type !== 'locus-scenario') {
034925: 					alert('Dit is geen geldig Locus scenario bestand.');
034926: 					return;
034927: 				}
034928: 				
034929: 				loadScenarioLikeToGame(scenario, { source: 'Bestand' });
034930: 				
034931: 				// Close menu if open
034932: 				try {
034933: 					const menuOverlay = document.getElementById('menu-overlay');
034934: 					const menuBtn = document.getElementById('menu-toggle');
034935: 					if (menuOverlay) menuOverlay.classList.remove('open');
034936: 					if (menuBtn) menuBtn.classList.remove('open');
034937: 				} catch (e) {}
034938: 				
034939: 			} catch (err) {
034940: 				console.error('Scenario import failed:', err);
034941: 				alert('Kon scenario niet laden: ' + (err.message || 'onbekende fout'));
034942: 			}
034943: 		});
034944: 		document.body.appendChild(input);
034945: 		input.click();
034946: 		document.body.removeChild(input);
034947: 	}

034951: 	window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
034952: 		// Only respond to the opener/child channel we use.
034953: 		const data = event && event.data ? event.data : {};
034954: 		if (!data) return;
034955: 		// Editor requests catalogs so it can show selectable deck/upgrades.
034956: 		if (data.type === 'LOCUS_EDITOR_REQUEST_CATALOG') {
034957: 			try {
034958: 				const cards = buildScenarioCardCatalog();
034959: 				const upgrades = buildScenarioUpgradeCatalog();
034960: 				const meta = { currentWorld: (typeof currentWorld !== 'undefined') ? currentWorld : null, currentLevel: (typeof currentLevel !== 'undefined') ? currentLevel : null };
034961: 				event.source && event.source.postMessage({ type: 'LOCUS_EDITOR_CATALOG', cards, upgrades, meta }, '*');
034962: 			} catch (e) {}
034963: 			return;
034964: 		}
034965: 		if (data.type === 'LOCUS_EDITOR_REQUEST_STARTER_DECK') {
034966: 			try {
034967: 				const blueprints = buildStandardDeckBlueprint();
034968: 				const deckTemplateIds = Array.isArray(blueprints)
034969: 					? blueprints.map(scenarioTemplateIdFromBlueprint).filter(Boolean)
034970: 					: [];
034971: 				event.source && event.source.postMessage({ type: 'LOCUS_EDITOR_STARTER_DECK', deckTemplateIds }, '*');
034972: 			} catch (e) {}
034973: 			return;
034974: 		}
034975: 		if (data.type === 'LOCUS_EDITOR_REQUEST_BOARD') {
034976: 			const boardHtml = getEditorBoardHtml();
034977: 			try { localStorage.setItem(LOCUS_EDITOR_STORAGE_KEY, boardHtml); } catch (e) {}
034978: 			try { event.source && event.source.postMessage({ type: 'LOCUS_EDITOR_BOARD', boardHtml }, '*'); } catch (e) {}
034979: 			return;
034980: 		}
034981: 		// Accept boards sent from the external editor window
034982: 		if (data.type === 'LOCUS_EDITOR_BOARD' && typeof data.boardHtml === 'string') {
034983: 			try {
034984: 				// Use unified loader so board + settings + meta always stay in sync.
034985: 				const merged = {
034986: 					boardHtml: data.boardHtml,
034987: 					name: data.name || '',
034988: 					objective: data.objective || '',
034989: 					scenarioSettings: (data.scenarioSettings && typeof data.scenarioSettings === 'object') ? data.scenarioSettings : null
034990: 				};
034991: 				// If no settings were sent, just apply the board (old behavior).
034992: 				if (merged.scenarioSettings || merged.name || merged.objective) {
034993: 					loadScenarioLikeToGame(merged, { source: 'Editor' });
034994: 				} else {
034995: 					applyBoardHtmlToGame(data.boardHtml);
034996: 					try { window._locusEditorApplied = true; } catch (e) {}
034997: 					if (typeof setStatus === 'function') setStatus('Speelveld geladen vanuit editor.');
034998: 				}
034999: 			} catch (e) { console.error(e); }
035000: 			return;
035001: 		}
035002: 	});

035007: 	function mulberry32(seed) {
035008: 		let a = seed >>> 0;
035009: 		return function() {
035010: 			a |= 0;
035011: 			a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
035012: 			let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
035013: 			t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
035014: 			return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
035015: 		};
035016: 	}

036292: 	function moveGameElements() {
036293: 		if (window.LocusTable?.enabled()) { window.LocusTable.layout(); return; }
036294: 		window.LocusTable?.suspend();
036295: 	  const width = window.innerWidth;
036296: 	  const height = window.innerHeight;
036297: 	  const isMobile = width <= MOBILE_BREAKPOINT;
036298: 	  
036299: 	  // Bepaal portrait/landscape primair op basis van afmetingen (iPad/Safari matchMedia kan misrapporteren).
036300: 	  const ORIENTATION_EPS = 24; // px tolerance to avoid flapping near-square viewports
036301: 	  const effectiveLandscape = (width - height) > ORIENTATION_EPS;
036302: 	  const effectivePortrait = (height - width) > ORIENTATION_EPS;
036303: 	  // Fallback if near-square
036304: 	  const isPortrait = effectivePortrait || (!effectiveLandscape && height >= width);
036305: 	  
036306: 	  // Touch device check - belangrijk voor onderscheid desktop vs tablet/telefoon
036307: 	  // isCoarsePointer() checkt voor touch-primaire devices
036308: 	  const isTouchDevice = isCoarsePointer();
036309: 	  const isLargeTouchScreen = isTouchDevice && Math.min(width, height) >= 700;
036310: 	  
036311: 	  // Desktop breakpoints - voor wanneer bottom layout beter is
036312: 	  // V4 responsive architecture: below this width the interface becomes the
036313: 	  // tablet/compact layout instead of squeezing two side rails around the board.
036314: 	  const DESKTOP_NARROW_BREAKPOINT = 1240;
036315: 	  const DESKTOP_SHORT_HEIGHT_BREAKPOINT = 500;
036316: 	  
036317: 	  // BELANGRIJK: Verschil maken tussen:
036318: 	  // 1. Desktop/laptop (muis) → gebruikt normale desktop layout (sidebars of bottom)
036319: 	  // 2. Tablet/telefoon (touch) in landscape → gebruikt compacte mobile sidebar layout
036320: 	  
036321: 	  // Compact touch-landscape is based on the SHORT side, not viewport width.
036322: 	  // A modern phone can be 844x390 in landscape and must not fall into desktop mode.
036323: 	  // Large tablets (short side >= 700px) keep the tablet/desktop layout.
036324: 	  const isCompactTouchScreen = isTouchDevice && Math.min(width, height) < 700;
036325: 	  const useMobileSidebarLayout = isCompactTouchScreen && effectiveLandscape && height >= 350;
036326: 	  
036327: 	  const useDesktopLayout = !isMobile && !useMobileSidebarLayout;
036328: 	  // Desktop sidebar layout: landscape met voldoende breedte
036329: 	  const useDesktopLandscape = useDesktopLayout && effectiveLandscape && width > DESKTOP_NARROW_BREAKPOINT;
036330: 	  // Bottom layout: portrait of te smal
036331: 	  const isNarrowDesktop = useDesktopLayout && width <= DESKTOP_NARROW_BREAKPOINT;
036332: 	  const isShortDesktop = useDesktopLayout && height <= DESKTOP_SHORT_HEIGHT_BREAKPOINT;
036333: 	  
036334: 	  // Touch device in portrait mode
036335: 	  const isTouchPortrait = isTouchDevice && !useMobileSidebarLayout && !effectiveLandscape;
036336: 	  
036337: 	  // Desktop bottom layout: alleen in portrait of als echt te smal
036338: 	  // NIET meer gebaseerd op short height - sidebars werken goed met scroll
036339: 	  const useDesktopPortrait = useDesktopLayout && (isPortrait || isNarrowDesktop);
036340: 	  
036341: 	  // Add body classes for CSS targeting
036342: 	  document.body.classList.toggle('mobile-sidebar-layout', useMobileSidebarLayout);
036343: 	  document.body.classList.toggle('touch-portrait', isTouchPortrait);
036344: 	  document.body.classList.remove('mobile-landscape'); // deprecated class
036345: 	  const layoutName = useMobileSidebarLayout ? 'phone-landscape' : (isMobile ? 'phone-portrait' : (useDesktopPortrait ? 'compact' : 'desktop'));
036346: 	  document.body.dataset.locusLayout = layoutName;
036347: 	  
036348: 	  // Desktop classes - ook voor grote tablets (iPad) zodat portrait/landscape correct werkt
036349: 	  if (useDesktopLayout) {
036350: 		  document.body.classList.toggle('desktop-portrait', useDesktopPortrait);
036351: 		  document.body.classList.toggle('desktop-landscape', useDesktopLandscape && !useDesktopPortrait);
036352: 	  } else {
036353: 		  document.body.classList.remove('desktop-portrait', 'desktop-landscape');
036354: 	  }
036355: 	logLayout('moveGameElements:mode', {
036356: 		width,
036357: 		height,
036358: 		isMobile,
036359: 		isTouchDevice,

036629: 	function scrollChildIntoView(container, child, opts = {}) {
036630: 	  if (!container || !child) return;
036631: 	  const alignX = opts.alignX || 'center';
036632: 	  const alignY = opts.alignY || 'center';
036633: 	  const paddingY = Number.isFinite(opts.paddingY) ? opts.paddingY : 16;
036634: 	  const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
036635: 	  const childRect = child.getBoundingClientRect();
036636: 	  const currentLeft = container.scrollLeft;
036637: 	  const currentTop = container.scrollTop;
036638: 	  const deltaLeft = childRect.left - containerRect.left;
036639: 	  const deltaTop = childRect.top - containerRect.top;
036640: 	  let targetLeft = currentLeft;
036641: 	  let targetTop = currentTop;
036642: 	  if (alignX === 'center') {
036643: 		targetLeft = currentLeft + deltaLeft - (containerRect.width / 2 - childRect.width / 2);
036644: 	  }
036645: 	  if (alignY === 'center') {
036646: 		targetTop = currentTop + deltaTop - (containerRect.height / 2 - childRect.height / 2);
036647: 	  } else if (alignY === 'bottom') {
036648: 		targetTop = currentTop + deltaTop - (containerRect.height - childRect.height - paddingY);
036649: 	  }
036650: 	  container.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, targetLeft);
036651: 	  container.scrollTop = Math.max(0, targetTop);
036652: 	}
036653:

036656: 		yellowZone.scrollLeft = 0;

036658: 	}

036699: 	function autoCenterScrollableZones() {
036700: 		if (window.LocusTable?.enabled()) { window.LocusTable.schedule(); return; }
036701: 		// Do not auto-center while zoomed-in; it causes jumps on mobile.
036702: 		if (document.body.classList.contains('zoomed-in')) return;
036703: 	  // Only auto-center when the user hasn't scrolled yet (prevents fighting the player).
036704: 	  const greenZone = document.getElementById('green-zone');
036705: 	  const greenMem = (() => {
036706: 		try { return getZoneScrollMemory('green-zone'); } catch (_) { return null; }
036707: 	  })();
036708: 	  // World 1: green zone is intentionally non-scrollable (overflow hidden).
036709: 	  // Avoid programmatically scrolling it, because that looks like a late layout shift.
036710: 	  const greenScrollDisabled = (() => {
036711: 		if (!greenZone) return true;
036712: 		if (greenZone.classList.contains('no-scroll')) return true;
036713: 		try {
036714: 			const st = getComputedStyle(greenZone);
036715: 			const ox = st.overflowX;
036716: 			const oy = st.overflowY;
036717: 			return (ox === 'hidden' || ox === 'clip') && (oy === 'hidden' || oy === 'clip');
036718: 		} catch (_) {
036719: 			return false;
036720: 		}
036721: 	  })();
036722: 	  const greenShouldAutoCenter = !(greenMem && greenMem.normal && greenMem.normal.initialized);
036723: 	  if (greenZone && !greenScrollDisabled && greenShouldAutoCenter) {
036724: 		try { scheduleGreenCenter({ force: false, allowZoom: false, fallback: true, fallbackDelay: 140 }); } catch (_) {}
036725: 	  }
036726: 
036727: 	  const blueZone = document.getElementById('blue-zone');
036728: 	  const blueShouldAutoCenter = (() => {
036729: 		try {
036730: 			const mem = getZoneScrollMemory('blue-zone');
036731: 			return !(mem && mem.normal && mem.normal.initialized);
036732: 		} catch (_) {
036733: 			return true;
036734: 		}
036735: 	  })();
036736: 	  if (blueZone && blueShouldAutoCenter && blueZone.scrollTop <= 2) {
036737: 		const boldCells = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#blue-grid .cell.bold-cell'));
036738: 		if (boldCells.length) {
036739: 			const maxY = Math.max(...boldCells.map(cell => Number(cell.dataset.y) || 0));
036740: 			const bottomCells = boldCells.filter(cell => (Number(cell.dataset.y) || 0) === maxY);
036741: 			bottomCells.sort((a, b) => (Number(a.dataset.x) || 0) - (Number(b.dataset.x) || 0));
036742: 			const target = bottomCells[Math.floor(bottomCells.length / 2)] || boldCells[0];
036743: 			scrollChildIntoView(blueZone, target, { alignX: 'center', alignY: 'bottom', paddingY: 18 });
036744: 		} else {
036745: 			blueZone.scrollTop = blueZone.scrollHeight;
036746: 			blueZone.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, (blueZone.scrollWidth - blueZone.clientWidth) / 2);
036747: 		}
036748: 	  }

000219:     level:null,
000220:     phase:0,

000224:     restoring:false,

000228:   function clone(value) {
000229:     try { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)); } catch (_) { return value; }
000230:   }
000231: 
000232:   function currentLevelNumber() {
000233:     try { return Number(currentLevel) || 0; } catch (_) { return 0; }
000234:   }
000235:   function isWorld4(level = currentLevelNumber()) { return level >= 31 && level <= 40; }
000236:   function getLevelConfig(level = currentLevelNumber()) { return LEVELS[Number(level)] || null; }
000237:   function getRuntime() { return runtime; }
000238: 
000239:   function resetRuntime(level = currentLevelNumber()) {
000240:     runtime = { level:Number(level)||0, phase:0, stats:freshStats(), lastScores:null, lockedCardReserve:[], restoring:false, built:false };
000241:     return runtime;
000242:   }
000243: 
000244:   function getScoresFallback() {
000245:     try {
000246:       if (typeof latestScoreSnapshot !== 'undefined' && latestScoreSnapshot) return latestScoreSnapshot;
000247:     } catch (_) {}
000248:     const read = id => Number(document.getElementById(id)?.textContent || 0) || 0;
000249:     const yellow = read('yellow-score'), red = read('red-score'), green = read('green-score'), purple = read('purple-score'), blue = read('blue-score');
000250:     return { yellow, red, green, purple, blue, bonus:0, total:yellow+red+green+purple+blue };
000251:   }
000252: 
000253:   function activeCellCount() {
000254:     if (!isWorld4()) return 0;
000255:     try {
000256:       return document.querySelectorAll('#yellow-zone .cell.active:not(.void-cell),#green-zone .cell.active:not(.void-cell),#blue-zone .cell.active:not(.void-cell),#purple-zone .cell.active:not(.void-cell),#red-zone .cell.active:not(.void-cell)').length;
000257:     } catch (_) { return 0; }
000258:   }
000259: 
000260:   function scoreTotal(scores = runtime.lastScores || getScoresFallback()) {
000261:     const cfg = getLevelConfig();
000262:     if (!cfg) return Number(scores?.total || 0);
000263:     const visible = allowedColors();
000264:     let total = 0;
000265:     for (const c of visible) total += Number(scores?.[SCORE_KEY[c]] || 0);
000266:     return total;
000267:   }
000268: 
000269:   function allowedColors() {
000270:     try {
000271:       if (Array.isArray(world4AllowedColors) && world4AllowedColors.length) return world4AllowedColors.slice();
000272:     } catch (_) {}
000273:     const cfg = getLevelConfig();
000274:     return cfg ? cfg.startColors.slice() : [];
000275:   }
000276: 
000277:   function isDoorOpen(id) {
000278:     try { return typeof isWorld4DoorOpen === 'function' && isWorld4DoorOpen(id); } catch (_) { return false; }
000279:   }
000280:   function isKeyUsed(color) {
000281:     try { return typeof isWorld4ColorUnlocked === 'function' && isWorld4ColorUnlocked(color); } catch (_) { return false; }
000282:   }
000283:   function isColorVisible(color) { return allowedColors().includes(String(color||'').toLowerCase()); }
000284: 
000285:   function ruinComplete() {
000286:     const cfg = getLevelConfig();
000287:     if (!cfg?.ruin) return true;
000288:     const required = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cell.w4-ruin-required')];
000289:     const forbidden = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cell.w4-ruin-forbidden')];
000290:     return required.length > 0 && required.every(c => c.classList.contains('active')) && forbidden.every(c => !c.classList.contains('active'));
000291:   }
000292: 
000293:   function coreComplete() {
000294:     const cfg = getLevelConfig();
000295:     if (!cfg?.core) return true;
000296:     const core = document.querySelector('.cell.w4-citadel-core');
000297:     return !!(core && core.classList.contains('active'));
000298:   }
000299: 
000300:   function requiredDoorsOpen(cfg = getLevelConfig()) {
000301:     if (!cfg) return false;
000302:     return (cfg.doors || []).every(d => isDoorOpen(d.id));
000303:   }
000304: 
000305:   function isPrimaryComplete(level = currentLevelNumber(), scores = runtime.lastScores || getScoresFallback()) {
000306:     const cfg = getLevelConfig(level);
000307:     if (!cfg) return false;
000308:     const totalOk = scoreTotal(scores) >= Number(cfg.scoreTarget || 0);
000309:     const doorsOk = requiredDoorsOpen(cfg);
000310:     const ruinOk = cfg.ruin ? ruinComplete() : true;
000311:     const coreOk = cfg.core ? coreComplete() : true;
000312:     return totalOk && doorsOk && ruinOk && coreOk;
000313:   }
000314: 
000315:   function primaryProgressText(level = currentLevelNumber(), scores = runtime.lastScores || getScoresFallback()) {
000316:     const cfg = getLevelConfig(level);
000317:     if (!cfg) return '';
000318:     const open = (cfg.doors || []).filter(d => isDoorOpen(d.id)).length;
000319:     const bits = [];
000320:     if (cfg.doors?.length) bits.push(`${open}/${cfg.doors.length} poorten`);
000321:     if (cfg.ruin) bits.push(ruinComplete() ? 'ruïne ✓' : 'ruïne');
000322:     if (cfg.core) bits.push(coreComplete() ? 'kern ✓' : 'kern');
000323:     bits.push(`${Math.min(scoreTotal(scores), cfg.scoreTarget)}/${cfg.scoreTarget} p`);
000324:     return bits.join(' · ');
000325:   }
000326: 
000327:   function phaseComplete(phase, scores = runtime.lastScores || getScoresFallback()) {
000328:     if (!phase) return false;
000329:     switch (phase.type) {
000330:       case 'key': return isKeyUsed(phase.color);
000331:       case 'door': return isDoorOpen(phase.doorId);
000332:       case 'ruin': return ruinComplete();
000333:       case 'core': return coreComplete();
000334:       case 'colorVisible': return isColorVisible(phase.color);
000335:       case 'score': return scoreTotal(scores) >= Number(phase.value || 0);
000336:       default: return false;
000337:     }
000338:   }
000339: 
000340:   function recalcPhase() {
000341:     const cfg = getLevelConfig();
000342:     if (!cfg) return 0;
000343:     let p = 0;
000344:     const phases = cfg.phases || [];
000345:     while (p < phases.length && phaseComplete(phases[p])) p += 1;
000346:     runtime.phase = p;
000347:     return p;
000348:   }
000349: 
000350:   function evaluateStar(star, scores = runtime.lastScores || getScoresFallback(), atRoundEnd = false) {
000351:     if (!star) return false;
000352:     const stats = runtime.stats || freshStats();
000353:     switch (star.type) {
000354:       case 'primary': return isPrimaryComplete(currentLevelNumber(), scores);
000355:       case 'noBonus': return stats.bonusesUsed === 0;
000356:       case 'maxBonuses': return stats.bonusesUsed <= Number(star.value || 0);
000357:       case 'maxActive': return activeCellCount() <= Number(star.value || 0);
000358:       case 'precision': {
000359:         const total = scoreTotal(scores);
000360:         return total >= Number(star.min || 0) && total <= Number(star.max || Infinity);
000361:       }
000362:       case 'noLarge': return stats.largeCardsUsed === 0;
000363:       case 'noGolden': return stats.goldenCardsUsed === 0;
000364:       case 'doorsByTurn': {
000365:         const cfg = getLevelConfig();
000366:         return !!cfg && (cfg.doors || []).every(d => {
000367:           const t = Number(stats.doorOpenTurns?.[d.id]);
000368:           return Number.isFinite(t) && t <= Number(star.value || 0);
000369:         });
000370:       }
000371:       case 'finalCard': {
000372:         if (!atRoundEnd) return stats.primaryCompletedOnCard != null;
000373:         return stats.primaryCompletedOnCard != null && Number(stats.primaryCompletedOnCard) === Number(stats.cardsPlayed);
000374:       }
000375:       default: return false;
000376:     }
000377:   }
000378: 
000379:   function getStarResults(scores = runtime.lastScores || getScoresFallback(), atRoundEnd = false) {
000380:     const cfg = getLevelConfig();
000381:     if (!cfg) return [];
000382:     return (cfg.stars || []).map((star, i) => ({ ...star, index:i, earned:evaluateStar(star, scores, atRoundEnd) }));
000383:   }
000384: 
000385:   function getSavedStars() {
000386:     try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STAR_STORE_KEY) || '{}') || {}; } catch (_) { return {}; }
000387:   }
000388:   function commitStars(scores = runtime.lastScores || getScoresFallback()) {
000389:     const cfg = getLevelConfig();
000390:     if (!cfg || !isPrimaryComplete(currentLevelNumber(), scores)) return 0;
000391:     const count = getStarResults(scores, true).filter(x => x.earned).length;
000392:     try {
000393:       const saved = getSavedStars();
000394:       const key = String(currentLevelNumber());
000395:       saved[key] = Math.max(Number(saved[key] || 0), count);
000396:       localStorage.setItem(STAR_STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(saved));
000397:     } catch (_) {}
000398:     return count;
000399:   }

000401:   function ensureHud() {
000402:     if (!isWorld4()) return null;
000403:     const zone = document.getElementById('objective-zone');
000404:     if (!zone) return null;
000405:     let strip = document.getElementById('world4-star-strip');
000406:     if (!strip) {
000407:       strip = document.createElement('div');
000408:       strip.id = 'world4-star-strip';
000409:       strip.setAttribute('aria-label','Sterdoelen voor Wereld 4');
000410:       zone.appendChild(strip);
000411:     }
000412:     return strip;
000413:   }
000414: 
000415:   function ensurePhaseBar() {
000416:     if (!isWorld4()) return null;
000417:     let host = document.getElementById('table-world') || document.getElementById('board')?.parentElement;
000418:     if (!host) return null;
000419:     let bar = document.getElementById('world4-phase-bar');
000420:     if (!bar) {
000421:       bar = document.createElement('div');
000422:       bar.id = 'world4-phase-bar';
000423:       host.appendChild(bar);
000424:     }
000425:     return bar;
000426:   }
000427: 
000428:   function renderHud(scores = runtime.lastScores || getScoresFallback()) {
000429:     if (!isWorld4()) {
000430:       document.getElementById('world4-star-strip')?.remove();
000431:       document.getElementById('world4-phase-bar')?.remove();
000432:       return;
000433:     }
000434:     const cfg = getLevelConfig();
000435:     if (!cfg) return;
000436:     recalcPhase();
000437:     const strip = ensureHud();
000438:     if (strip) {
000439:       const results = getStarResults(scores, false);
000440:       strip.innerHTML = results.map((s, i) => {
000441:         const isPrimary = i === 0;
000442:         const primaryDone = isPrimary && s.earned;
000443:         const optionalOnTrack = !isPrimary && s.earned;
000444:         const cls = [isPrimary ? 'is-primary' : '', primaryDone ? 'is-complete' : '', optionalOnTrack ? 'is-on-track' : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
000445:         return `<div class="w4-star-card ${cls}" title="${escapeHtml(s.detail || s.label)}"><span class="w4-star-icon">${isPrimary ? '★' : '☆'}</span><span><strong>${escapeHtml(s.label)}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(s.detail || '')}</small></span></div>`;
000446:       }).join('');
000447:     }
000448:     const bar = ensurePhaseBar();
000449:     if (bar) {
000450:       const phases = cfg.phases || [];
000451:       bar.classList.toggle('is-boss', !!cfg.boss);
000452:       bar.innerHTML = `<span class="w4-phase-kicker">${cfg.boss ? 'FASE VAN DE CITADEL' : escapeHtml(cfg.title)}</span><div class="w4-phase-track">${phases.map((p,i) => {
000453:         const done = phaseComplete(p, scores);
000454:         const current = i === runtime.phase && !done;
000455:         return `<div class="w4-phase-step ${done?'is-done':''} ${current?'is-current':''}"><span>${done?'✓':(i+1)}</span><small>${escapeHtml(p.label || '')}</small></div>`;
000456:       }).join('')}</div>`;
000457:     }

000568:   function findCellNearCenter(zone, predicate = () => true) {
000569:     if (!zone) return null;
000570:     const cells = [...zone.querySelectorAll('.cell:not(.void-cell)')].filter(predicate);
000571:     if (!cells.length) return null;
000572:     const xs = cells.map(c => Number(c.dataset.x)).filter(Number.isFinite);
000573:     const ys = cells.map(c => Number(c.dataset.y)).filter(Number.isFinite);
000574:     const cx = xs.length ? (Math.min(...xs)+Math.max(...xs))/2 : 0;
000575:     const cy = ys.length ? (Math.min(...ys)+Math.max(...ys))/2 : 0;
000576:     cells.sort((a,b) => {
000577:       const da = Math.hypot((Number(a.dataset.x)||0)-cx,(Number(a.dataset.y)||0)-cy);
000578:       const db = Math.hypot((Number(b.dataset.x)||0)-cx,(Number(b.dataset.y)||0)-cy);
000579:       return da-db;
000580:     });
000581:     return cells[0] || null;
000582:   }
